Building upon this, it then injects predictive observation latents into action decoding as explicit predictive priors via a lightweight adaptive side-path, enabling adaptive predictive guidance under a single action-centric objective. Extensive experiments on both simulation and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate that ATI-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance with faster convergence.

</details>


### [126] [FFBL-Coop: Association-Decoupled Cooperative 3D Multi-Object Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01750)
*Haoxin Wu,Xiaokai Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出先融合后绑定的协同3D跟踪框架FFBL-Coop，将实例准入与身份管理解耦，在V2X-Seq和Griffin-25M上取得领先跟踪性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协同3D跟踪需跨智能体与时间整合互补观测并保持身份一致。当证据融合与身份继承共享同一匹配决策时，跨视角外观差异和空间错位引发的错误会同时损害特征融合与跟踪连续性。

Method: 提出FFBL-Coop“先融合、后绑定”框架：CSA（置信度排序槽位准入）按置信度与空间邻近度将协同查询分配到自车可用槽位；URA（统一表示聚合）用协同语义特征和对齐锚点引导自车特征检索，在共享Transformer解码器中精炼增强查询库；CPIA（协同优先身份锚定）将学习关联与持久映射结合，跨帧建立可接受的身份分配；并用共享码本降低传输开销。

Result: 在V2X-Seq上AMOTA/AP为0.611/0.548，在Griffin-25M上为0.688/0.653；共享码本在保留接近未压缩版本的AP与AMOTA的同时减少传输负载。

Conclusion: 将实例准入与身份管理分离可有效缓解跨视角与空间错位带来的误差传播，兼顾跟踪精度与通信效率，代码将开源。

Abstract: Cooperative 3D tracking must integrate complementary observations across agents and time while maintaining consistent identities. When evidence integration and identity inheritance share a matching decision, errors arising from cross-view appearance differences and spatial misalignment can compromise both feature fusion and track continuity. We propose FFBL-Coop, a fuse first, bind later framework that separates instance admission from identity management. Confidence-ranked Slot Admission (CSA) allocates cooperative queries to available ego slots using confidence and spatial proximity. Unified Representation Aggregation (URA) uses cooperative semantic features and aligned anchors to guide ego-feature retrieval, refining the augmented query bank within a shared transformer decoder. After refinement, Cooperative-Priority Identity Anchoring (CPIA) combines learned association with persistent mappings to establish accepted identity assignments across frames. A shared codebook reduces transmitted payload while retaining AP and AMOTA close to the uncompressed variant. FFBL-Coop achieves AMOTA/AP of 0.611/0.548 on V2X-Seq and 0.688/0.653 on Griffin-25M. Code will be released.

</details>


### [127] [Cog-VADU: A Training-Free Cognitive Reasoning Framework for Video Anomaly Detection and Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01754)
*Mohd Ubaid Wani,Sara Atito,Josef Kittler,Muhammad Awais*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Cog-VADU 全免训练框架，将视频异常检测重构为序列化认知推理任务，通过 CoADTP 提示与跨模态重排序实现零样本检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VAD 方法多依赖特定数据集训练与人工标注，开放场景泛化差；基于 LVLM 的零样本方法虽缓解依赖，但缺乏时间连续性与结构化推理。

Method: Cog-VADU 为完全免训练框架：1) 提出 CoADTP（异常检测思维链提示），将 LVLM 展开为跨视频片段的循环推理链，通过随时间传播结构化理由维持隐式时间记忆；2) 设计跨模态重排序阶段，将文本理由与视觉嵌入对齐，强化语义一致性与时间连贯性以精炼预测。

Result: 在多个公开 VAD 基准上取得有竞争力的零样本性能；跨模型评估显示 CoADTP 以模型无关方式持续提升基于推理的异常检测效果。

Conclusion: Cog-VADU 为真实应用提供了可解释、可泛化的异常理解方案，且 CoADTP 具备良好的通用性与模型无关性。

Abstract: Video Anomaly Detection (VAD) aims to temporally localize abnormal events in videos. Most existing approaches rely on dataset-specific training and curated annotations, limiting generalization in open-set scenarios. Recent zero-shot methods based on Large Vision- Language Models (LVLMs) alleviate this dependency but often lack temporal continuity and structured reasoning. We propose Cog-VADU, a fully training-free framework that reformulates VAD as a sequential cognitive reasoning task. Cog-VADU introduces Chain-of- Anomaly Detection Thought Prompting (CoADTP), which unrolls an LVLM into a recurrent reasoning chain across video segments. By propagating structured rationales over time, the model maintains implicit temporal memory, enabling robust discrimination between com- plex anomalies and high-motion normal activities. To improve reliability, we further design a cross-modal re-ranking stage that aligns textual rationales with visual embeddings, enforcing semantic consistency and temporal coherence for refined and stable predictions. Extensive experiments on multiple public VAD benchmarks demonstrate that Cog-VADU achieves competitive zero-shot performance. Moreover, cross-model evaluations show that CoADTP consistently enhances reasoning-based anomaly detection in a model-agnostic manner, pro- viding interpretable and generalizable anomaly understanding for real-world applications.

</details>


### [128] [GenCOPE: Syn2Real Generalized Category-Level Object Pose Estimation for Robotic Picking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01758)
*Jian Liu,Wei Sun,Zhenqi Dai,Hui Yang,Jian Xiao,Nicu Sebe,Na Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Syn2Real泛化的类别级物体位姿估计方法，仅用合成数据训练即可直接泛化到真实场景，通过语义一致性约束与轻量端到端回归框架实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有类别级物体位姿估计（COPE）方法在新类别上仍需耗费大量人力采集真实训练数据，扩展性差。本文希望实现合成到真实（Syn2Real）的泛化，即仅用渲染的合成数据训练，直接部署到真实世界，核心难点在于合成与真实数据（尤其纹理外观）存在显著域差异。

Method: 提出学习域不变表示以捕捉同类物体的语义共性：引入2D与3D语义一致性约束，降低特征编码器对域特定特征的敏感性；并设计端到端位姿回归框架，进行2D-3D交叉一致性学习，利用密集跨模态融合进一步优化位姿估计。模型仅基于全局特征，结构轻量高效。

Result: 在REAL275和Wild6D基准以及真实机器人操作场景上的大量实验表明，该范式具有优越的Syn2Real泛化性能。

Conclusion: 通过语义一致性约束与2D-3D交叉一致性学习的轻量框架，可有效缩小合成与真实域差距，实现无需真实数据采集的类别级位姿估计泛化，适合真实机器人部署。

Abstract: Category-level object pose estimation (COPE), capable of generalizing to intra-class unknown objects, has become a core technique for robotic 3D scene understanding. However, existing COPE methods still require labor-intensive recollection of real-world training data for novel object categories, which limits their scalability in practical applications. This paper aims to achieve synthetic-to-real (Syn2Real) generalized COPE, where a model is trained solely on rendered synthetic data and directly generalized to real-world deployments. The central challenge lies in the significant domain gap between synthetic and real-world data, particularly in texture appearance. To address this, we aim to enhance domain generalization by learning domain-invariant representations that capture semantic commonalities among objects within the same category. We introduce 2D and 3D semantic consistency constraints to reduce the sensitivity of feature encoders to domain-specific features. In addition, we propose an end-to-end pose regression framework that performs 2D-3D cross consistency learning, leveraging dense cross-modality fusion to further refine pose estimation. Since simplicity and effectiveness are essential for real-world robotic deployment, our model operates exclusively on global features, yielding a highly lightweight and efficient architecture. Extensive experiments on the REAL275 and Wild6D benchmarks, as well as real-world robotic manipulation scenes, show superior Syn2Real generalization performance of our paradigm. Code and demos are released at https://paperreview99.github.io/GenCOPE/.

</details>


### [129] [PhysDEM: Physics-Defined Energy-Matching Diffusion for Spatiotemporal Field Generation under Scarce Measurements](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01759)
*Zhenyu Liang,Yining Huang,Yubo Zhao,Jack C. P. Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhysDEM是一个物理定义扩散框架，结合控制方程与稀疏观测生成多个合理的时空物理场，无需完整场数据集且支持摊销采样。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从稀缺测量生成和预测时空物理场具有挑战性，因为观测不足以刻画完整场的分布，这限制了依赖全场数据的传统数据驱动扩散模型。

Method: 首先，通过对测量条件高斯参考分布以PDE残差能量重加权构建Gibbs目标；其次，推导精确条件均值恒等式，将去噪简化为对标准化能量诱导均值修正的监督学习；第三，物理位移概率流抵消高斯参考项，通过高斯条件化实现随测量变化的摊销采样，无需重新训练。

Result: 在合成PDE系统和真实世界相关应用上的实验表明，PhysDEM支持一致的场恢复和高效采样，并在测试噪声水平下保持稳定诊断，展示了其在场评估中的实用价值。

Conclusion: PhysDEM是首个无需预组装全场数据集即可实现摊销时空场推断的物理定义扩散模型。

Abstract: Generating and predicting spatiotemporal physical fields from scarce measurements is challenging, as observations are insufficient to characterize a distribution over complete fields. This limits conventional data-driven diffusion models that rely on full-field datasets. We introduce PhysDEM, a physics-defined diffusion framework that combines governing equations with spatially sparse observations to generate multiple plausible fields. First, we construct a Gibbs target by reweighting a measurement-conditioned Gaussian reference with PDE residual energy. Second, we derive an exact conditional-mean identity that reduces denoising to supervised learning of the standardized energy-induced mean correction. Third, a physics-displacement probability flow cancels Gaussian reference terms and enables amortized sampling with changing measurements through Gaussian conditioning, without retraining. Experiments on synthetic PDE systems and real-world-informed applications demonstrate that PhysDEM supports coherent field recovery and efficient sampling while maintaining stable diagnostics under tested noise levels, illustrating its practical value for field assessment. To our knowledge, PhysDEM is the first physics-defined diffusion model enabling amortized spatiotemporal field inference without preassembled full-field datasets.

</details>


### [130] [OneStreamer: Unifying Perception, Memory, and Proactive Response in Streaming Video Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01762)
*Xiangyu Zeng,Yuandong Yang,Zhiqiu Zhang,Yuhan Zhu,Xinhao Li,Qingyi Si,Dingyu Yao,Changlian Ma,Haoran Chen,Xinyu Chen,Yansong Shi,Junhao Zhou,Yifei Li,Jun Zhang,Chuanyu Qin,Chenxu Yang,Xinlei Yu,Kun Ouyang,Yuchen Shao,Qianshan Wei,Changhai Zhou,Jun Gao,Jiaqi Wang,Limin Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出OneStreamer，通过共享的主动生成过程联合学习查询无关的证据记录与任务响应，实现流式视频大模型的可复用事实记忆与实时感知兼顾，并在8个流式视频理解基准上取得最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式视频LLM必须在证据与未来任务的相关性未知时就加以保留，并在证据充分时及时响应。核心挑战在于：如何在不损害实时感知的前提下形成可复用的事实记忆。

Method: 提出OneStreamer，包含三个关键组件：(1) 主动层次化字幕记忆（PHCM），生成时间锚定的局部细节字幕与已完成事件的摘要，训练时以流式字幕目标监督对已观测视频前缀的解读，推理时用模型生成记录补充近期视觉窗口；(2) 主动状态转移学习（PSTL），通过保留所有输出锚点的监督并选取代表性状态变化与状态保持token，缓解重复等待状态的主导问题；(3) 流式数据合成管线，使输出内容与时序与可用证据对齐。结合流式字幕与QA及清洗后的开源数据构建了OneStreamer-1M数据集。

Result: 4B模型在所有8个评测的流式视频理解基准上均优于对比方法。消融实验表明，保留生成的字幕能在不降低实时感知的情况下提升历史QA；PSTL仅监督27.5%的标注状态token即优于稠密状态监督。

Conclusion: 这些结果支持将主动生成作为连接感知、记忆形成与及时响应的共享学习接口，用于流式视频交互。

Abstract: Streaming video LLMs must retain evidence before its relevance to future tasks is known and respond when sufficient evidence becomes available. The challenge is to form reusable factual memory without compromising real-time perception. We introduce OneStreamer, which jointly learns query-independent evidence recording and task response through a shared proactive generation process. Its Proactive Hierarchical Caption Memory (PHCM) produces time-grounded local-detail captions and summaries of completed events. Streaming caption targets supervise the interpretation of observed video prefixes during training. At inference, model-generated records complement a recent visual window, providing reusable factual context without revisiting historical visual features. Proactive State Transition Learning (PSTL) reduces the dominance of repeated waiting states by preserving supervision at all output anchors and selecting representative state-change and state-persistence tokens. We further develop a streaming data synthesis pipeline that aligns output content and timing with available evidence. Combining the resulting streaming captions and QA with cleaned open-source data yields OneStreamer-1M, a broad-coverage streaming video interaction dataset with over one million records spanning diverse tasks. Our 4B model achieves the best results among the compared methods across all eight evaluated streaming video understanding benchmarks. Ablations show that retaining generated captions improves historical QA without degrading real-time perception. PSTL also outperforms dense state supervision while supervising only 27.5% of annotated state tokens. Together, these results support proactive generation as a shared learning interface connecting perception, memory formation, and timely response in streaming video interaction.

</details>


### [131] [GIFTBench: Diagnosing Generalization in Image Forgery Localization and Informing Model Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01778)
*Baoke Dou,Ziye Wang,Hao Wang,Guoqing Cai,Wende Tan,Chenyang Si,Liucheng Guo,Yueming Lyu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出GIFTBench多轴图像伪造定位基准（115,013张带像素级标注图像，覆盖伪造来源、语义目标、编辑操作与合成复杂度四个维度），支持轴向迁移分析与12个外部数据集评测；并基于诊断结论开发ForenScope框架，在保持图像级检测能力的同时提升跨数据集定位性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有IFL基准覆盖的篡改条件有限，且跨数据集评测常将多种因素纠缠在一起，导致聚合性能无法完整反映定位泛化能力，因此需要一个能解耦多轴因素、覆盖更广分布变化的评测与训练资源。

Method: 构建GIFTBench多轴基准，涵盖伪造来源、语义目标、编辑操作、合成复杂度四轴，共115,013张像素级标注图像，支持轴特异迁移分析与12个外部数据集评测；基于诊断发现设计ForenScope框架，融合分类适配表征与多深度、多尺度空间特征，采用可学习层融合与选择性粗尺度条件化。

Result: 诊断实验揭示非对称跨源迁移、以召回为主导的失败模式，以及语义、操作、组合变化下的异质退化；在GIFTBench上训练代表性定位器可持续提升对外部数据集的聚合迁移效果；ForenScope在跨数据集定位上取得提升，同时保留图像级检测能力。

Conclusion: GIFTBench不仅是诊断性评测工具，也是有效的跨域训练资源；其诊断发现可指导模型设计，ForenScope即为例证，说明多轴基准对推动IFL泛化研究具有双重价值。

Abstract: Reliable evaluation of image forgery localization (IFL) requires assessing models under diverse distribution changes, yet existing benchmarks often cover limited manipulation conditions or entangle multiple factors in cross-dataset evaluation. Consequently, aggregate performance provides an incomplete view of localization generalization. We introduce GIFTBench, a multi-axis benchmark of 115,013 manipulated images with pixel-level annotations spanning manipulation source, semantic target, editing operation, and composition complexity. GIFTBench supports axis-specific transfer analysis and evaluation on twelve external datasets. Its diagnostic studies reveal asymmetric cross-source transfer, recall-dominated failures, and heterogeneous degradation across semantic, operational, and compositional changes. Beyond diagnosis, the scale and diversity of GIFTBench provide a substantially broader training distribution than conventional IFL datasets. Training representative localizers on GIFTBench consistently improves their aggregate transfer to external datasets, showing that the benchmark serves not only as an evaluation tool but also as an effective training resource for cross-domain localization. Guided by the diagnostic findings, we further develop ForenScope, a detection and localization framework combining classification-adapted representations with multi-depth, multi-scale spatial features, learned layer fusion, and selective coarse-scale conditioning. Experiments show improved cross-dataset localization while retaining image-level detection capability. The GIFTBench dataset showcase page is available at https://giftbench-preview.doudoudouya337.chatgpt.site.

</details>


### [132] [VETO: Video Efficient Token Optimization for Vision Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01785)
*Gueter Josmy Faure,Hao Ping Wang,Min-Hung Chen,Winston H. Hsu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VETO 是一种训练可选的插件式方法，通过双轴压缩（帧内语义合并 + 帧间冗余帧合并）解决长视频 VLM 推理成本过高的问题，实现最高 45% 推理加速且保持或提升准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长视频处理受限于视觉 token 的二次成本，导致长格式推理极其昂贵。现有的单轴压缩方法因独立处理空间与时间冗余而遭遇效率下限瓶颈。

Method: 提出 VETO（视频高效 Token 优化），一个训练可选的插件。包含两部分：(i) 帧内压缩器，通过最优传输启发的匹配合并帧内语义相似的 token；(ii) 帧间压缩器，识别并合并时间上冗余的帧。核心设计是层级排序：先压缩空间维度，大幅降低后续全局时间匹配成本，从而绕过单轴方法的效率墙。

Result: 在 LLaVA-OneVision-7B 上实现最高 45% 推理加速，同时保持或提升准确率。在极端 token 预算（10%）下，VETO 以 55.7% 准确率超越 VFlowOpt (54.9%)、VisionZip (52.6%) 和 FastV (47.9%)。在 LLaVA-OneVision、InternVL-2.5 和 LongVA 上均验证了通用适用性，零样本准确率全部保持或提升。

Conclusion: VETO 通过双轴层级压缩有效突破单轴方法的效率瓶颈，且优势随现代全融合注意力基础设施的发展而增长，具备跨多种 VLM 的通用性。

Abstract: Processing long videos with Vision-Language Models (VLMs) is bottlenecked by the quadratic cost of visual tokens, making long-form inference prohibitively expensive. While single-axis compression methods mitigate this, they hit a hard efficiency floor because they treat spatial and temporal redundancy independently. We present VETO (Video Efficient Token Optimization for Vision-Language Models), a training-optional plug-in that eliminates this bottleneck through dual-axis compression: (i) an intra-frame compressor that merges semantically similar tokens within each frame via optimal-transport inspired matching, and (ii) an inter-frame compressor that identifies and merges temporally redundant frames. The key design insight is hierarchical ordering: by first compressing spatial dimensions, VETO drastically reduces the cost of subsequent global temporal matching, bypassing the efficiency wall of single-axis approaches, with an advantage that grows with modern fully-fused attention infrastructure. Empirically, VETO achieves up to 45% faster inference (e.g., on LLaVA-OneVision-7B) while preserving or improving accuracy. Under extreme token starvation (10% budget), VETO outperforms VFlowOpt (54.9%), VisionZip (52.6%), and FastV (47.9%) with 55.7% accuracy. We demonstrate universal applicability across LLaVA-OneVision, InternVL-2.5, and LongVA, with zero-shot accuracy preserved or improved in all cases.

</details>


### [133] [PhaseAT: Fourier Phase Adversarial Training for Medical Image Domain Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01807)
*Ahmed Sharshar,Asif Hanif,Naveen Kumar Kummari,Mohammad Yaqub,Mohsen Guizan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhaseAT是一个相位感知的对抗训练框架，通过在傅里叶域生成相位扰动视图来提升医学图像模型的域泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨扫描仪、站点和采集协议的分布偏移阻碍了深度医学图像模型的可靠临床部署。现有域泛化方法多关注风格或强度多样化，但仍可能使网络依赖域特定的纹理相关性。

Method: 受傅里叶相位编码语义结构的启发，提出PhaseAT：在傅里叶域迭代更新有界相位扰动并保持幅度谱不变，生成相位扰动训练视图；扰动仅施加于YCbCr的亮度通道以避免色彩伪影；使用相位显著性掩码聚焦最具影响力的频率；以干净样本与相位扰动样本的加权损失训练，支持单源和多源DG。

Result: 在两个具有挑战性的医学数据集上验证，单源域泛化性能提升超过20%，优于多个现有最先进DG方法。

Conclusion: PhaseAT通过相位感知的对抗训练有效提升医学图像域泛化能力，代码已开源。

Abstract: Reliable clinical deployment of deep medical image models is hindered by distribution shifts across scanners, sites, and acquisition protocols. Existing domain generalization (DG) methods often focus on style or intensity diversification, but they can still leave networks dependent on domain-specific texture correlations. Inspired by evidence that Fourier phase encodes semantic structure, we introduce PhaseAT, a phase-aware adversarial training framework for medical DG. PhaseAT forms phase-perturbed training views in the Fourier domain by iteratively updating a bounded phase perturbation while keeping the amplitude spectrum unchanged, thereby stressing spatial organization under matched appearance statistics. Perturbations are applied only to the luminance channel in YCbCr color space to avoid chromatic artifacts. Additionally, a simple phase-saliency mask concentrates updates on the most influential frequencies. The model is trained with a weighted combination of losses on clean and phase-perturbed samples, supporting both single-source and multi-source DG. We validate our method on two challenging medical datasets and demonstrate that PhaseAT achieves over 20% improvement in single-source domain generalization, outperforming several state-of-the-art DG methods. The code implementation is available at: https://github.com/ahmed-sharshar/PhaseAT.

</details>


### [134] [From Pixels to Policy: A Multi-Agent System for Intervention and Geo-Spatial Decision Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01870)
*Hosam Elgendy,Utkarsh Mall*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"干预发现"新问题，并构建多智能体系统VIDA-Geo，通过协调分割、扩散修复与指标评分模型，为给定航拍或街景图像生成既真实又符合政策的城市干预方案，在8项指标上优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市设计决策对健康、安全和生活质量有长期影响，但评估拟议干预成本高、耗时长且往往不切实际。现有地理空间视觉方法主要从航拍和街景图像中"监测"城市指标，而非"提出"干预并估计其对指标的影响。因此本文希望超越识别任务，探索能够改善目标指标的干预方案发现。

Method: 作者提出将黑盒指标模型与生成式编辑模型结合，作为隐式数字孪生来测试干预假设。具体实现为多智能体系统VIDA-Geo，协调分割模型、基于扩散的修复（inpainting）模型和指标评分模型，从而在干预空间中搜索，生成感知真实且符合现实政策的干预方案。

Result: 在航拍与街景图像上针对8项指标（如感知安全性和绿化程度）进行评估。该方法在多数情况下优于现有基线，感知质量和政策一致性得分最高提升2倍。

Conclusion: 该系统可为用户提供多个候选干预方案，支持"专家城市规划师在环"的工作流程，展示了隐式数字孪生范式在城市干预发现中的可行性。

Abstract: Urban environments are shaped by design choices with long-term implications for health, safety, and quality of life, yet evaluating proposed interventions remains costly, time-consuming, and often impractical. Existing geospatial vision methods largely focus on monitoring urban indicators from aerial and street-view imagery, rather than proposing interventions and estimating their effects on such indicators. Moving beyond recognition, we introduce the problem of discovering interventions that improve target indicators for a given aerial or street-view image. We argue that a black-box indicator model, combined with a generative editing model, can serve as an implicit digital twin for testing intervention hypotheses. We present VIDA-Geo , a multi-agent system that explores this intervention space by coordinating segmentation, diffusion-based inpainting, and indicator scoring models to produce interventions that are both perceptually realistic and aligned with real-world policies. We evaluate our system on 8 indicators across aerial and street-view imagery, measuring changes in factors such as perceived safety and greenery. Our approach outperforms existing baselines in many cases, achieving up to 2X higher perceptual quality and policy alignment scores. Finally, our model provides users with multiple candidate interventions, supporting an expert city-planner-in-the-loop workflow.

</details>


### [135] [EvenSplat: Coupled 2D-3D Decomposition for Gaussian Splatting under Exposure and Illumination Variation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01876)
*Tongyu Wu,Jacob Edwards,Ziteng Cui,Caigui Jiang,Cheng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EvenSplat提出一种将光照与场景几何/颜色解耦的多视图重建框架，结合图像空间光照分解与高斯携带的光照场，并引入相机响应网络和局部曝光补偿模块，在多种不均匀光照下优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实表面在均匀光照下各视角外观一致，但在不均匀光照下则不一致：不同视角间曝光变化、单张图像内光照不均、局部强光源造成明暗对比。现有方法如3D高斯泼溅将这些光照伪影当作场景属性，把采集相关光照与几何、颜色纠缠在一起，影响重建质量。

Method: EvenSplat将图像空间的光照分解与高斯携带的光照场耦合，使二维与三维视角共享同一光照解释；并引入相机响应网络和局部曝光补偿模块，吸收跨训练图像残留的全局与局部差异。

Result: 在多个数据集和多种不均匀光照形式（跨视角曝光、空间光照变化、高对比光照）上，针对真实拍摄与模拟基准进行广泛实验，EvenSplat总体优于现有最优方法，尤其在高对比光照下表现突出。

Conclusion: 通过分离光照与场景固有属性，EvenSplat有效缓解多视图重建中的光照伪影问题，提升了不均匀光照条件下的重建鲁棒性与质量。

Abstract: A surface photographed under even light presents nearly the same appearance from every angle; the same surface under uneven light does not. Exposure changes between views, illumination varies within a single image, and locally strong light sources leave one region bright and its neighbor in shadow. Multi-view reconstruction methods such as 3D Gaussian Splatting treat these lighting artifacts as if they were properties of the scene, entangling capture-specific illumination with the geometry and color they recover. We present EvenSplat, a framework that separates the two. EvenSplat couples an image-space illumination decomposition with an illumination field carried by the Gaussians, so that the same explanation of the lighting is shared between the two-dimensional and three-dimensional views of the scene; a camera-response network and a local exposure-compensation module absorb the global and residual differences that remain across training images. Through extensive experiments across multiple datasets and diverse forms of uneven illumination (cross-view exposure, spatial illumination variation, and high-contrast lighting) on both real-world captured and simulated benchmarks, EvenSplat generally outperforms state-of-the-art methods, particularly under high-contrast illumination.

</details>


### [136] [Memory-Guided B-Roll Generation from User Video Collections](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01884)
*Cusuh Ham,Fabian Caba Heilbron,Josef Sivic,Bryan Russell*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出MemComposer，一个基于用户视频集合生成B-roll序列的三阶段系统，通过构建实体中心记忆、规划与检索、迭代生成与评判，实现与用户素材在角色、场景、物体和风格上的一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有B-roll生成需要从数小时素材中选取合适的视觉证据来指导每个镜头的生成，同时要保持用户视频集合中角色、场景、物体和风格的一致性，这一任务具有挑战性。

Method: MemComposer包含三个阶段：1）一次性离线阶段，从原始视频构建以实体为中心的记忆（角色、场景、物体、风格）；2）利用记忆和用户指令规划有依据的序列，并为每个镜头检索条件帧；3）迭代生成和评判序列，以强制实现身份、场景和序列级一致性。

Result: 用户偏好研究显示：与无依据的文本到视频规划器相比，MemComposer在提示遵循上胜出60.0%，在视觉对齐上胜出92.8%；与仅检索的序列相比，MemComposer在提示遵循上胜出94.5%，而仅检索序列在58.2%的比较中更受偏好于视觉对齐。

Conclusion: 集合记忆与参考检索能带来显著的依据增益；生成缺失镜头在提示遵循方面具有价值，而仅检索方法在视觉对齐上仍有优势。

Abstract: We introduce an approach for collection-grounded B-roll sequence generation. Given a user's video collection, a directive given in natural language, and a target duration, the goal is to produce a multi-shot sequence that complements the user's primary footage (A-roll) while preserving the collection's characters, settings, objects, and style. This task is challenging as one must choose the visual evidence from hours of captured footage that should guide the generation of each shot in the sequence. We address this challenge with MemComposer, a three-stage system that turns raw footage into a structured memory with visual references (characters, settings, objects, and style) and uses it to plan, retrieve, and generate grounded B-roll sequences. First, in a one-time offline stage, MemComposer constructs an entity-centric memory from raw video. Second, it uses the memory and user directive to plan a grounded sequence and retrieve conditioning frames for each shot. Third, it iteratively generates and critiques the sequence to enforce identity, setting, and sequence-level consistency. We evaluate MemComposer in a user preference study along two dimensions: prompt adherence and visual alignment to the user's collection. Against an ungrounded text-to-video planner, MemComposer wins 60.0\% of prompt-adherence and 92.8\% of visual-alignment comparisons, showing the grounding benefit of collection memory and reference retrieval. Against retrieval-only sequences assembled from captured footage, MemComposer wins 94.5\% of prompt-adherence comparisons, showing the value of generating missing shots, while retrieval-only sequences are preferred for visual alignment in 58.2\% of comparisons.

</details>


### [137] [Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Enhanced Radiometer Image Precipitation Estimation using Conditional Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01890)
*Victor Enescu,Assaad Zeghina,Matthieu Meignin,Nicolas Viltard,Cécile Mallet*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于流匹配模型的无监督域自适应方法，通过对确定性常微分方程的部分利用，实现卫星辐射计图像在不同仪器间的精确域对齐，并在GPM-Core星座上验证了其在降水估计上的改进效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度生成网络在图像与视频编辑中表现出色，但严重依赖大规模有标注数据。卫星仪器数据尤为困难：标注数据极少与观测重叠，且偶有重叠时也存在域偏移。因此需要一种无需标注的域自适应手段，使不同卫星仪器的辐射计图像能够对齐。

Method: 作者研究流匹配模型在卫星辐射计图像无监督域自适应中的潜力。核心贡献是一种新的无监督方法：利用流匹配模型中确定性常微分方程（ODE）的部分环节，并以不同卫星仪器为条件，实现域对齐。由于扰动在理论上具有双射性，方法能够在跨域适应时保留关键信息。

Result: 在GPM-Core星座上的大量实验表明，所提出的条件域自适应方法具有明显收益，尤其在改善基于辐射计影像的降雨降水估计方面效果显著。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了流匹配模型可用于卫星辐射计图像的无监督域自适应，借助ODE的可逆性实现信息保持的跨域对齐，并在降水估计任务中体现价值。

Abstract: Deep generative networks have recently achieved unprecedented performance in precise image and video editing using sophisticated textual prompts. However, the effectiveness of such models heavily depends on access to very large supervised and annotated image datasets, which can be very difficult to obtain. This is particularly true for satellite instruments, which very rarely overlap with labelled data, and suffer from domain shifts in the rare occasions they do. In this paper, we investigate the potential of flow matching models for unsupervised domain adaptation of satellite radiometer images. Our main contribution is a novel unsupervised method that achieves precise domain alignment by leveraging parts of the deterministic ordinary differential equations in flow matching models, conditioned on different satellite instruments. A key strength of our approach is its ability to preserve essential information while adapting across any domains since the perturbations are in theory bijective. Extensive experiments conducted on the GPM-Core constellation show the benefit of our conditional domain adaptation, particularly in improving rain precipitation estimation from radiometer imagery.

</details>


### [138] [MapLightning: Online Vectorized HD Map Construction with 1D Map Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01905)
*Shen Zheng,Anurag Ghosh,Mani Ramanagopal,Srinivasa Narasimhan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MapLightning 用紧凑的 1D 可学习地图 token 替代稠密 BEV 网格，通过图像与地图 token 的联合自注意力实现高效、精确、实时的在线矢量化高精地图构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线矢量化 HD 地图构建对自动驾驶的可扩展性与安全至关重要，需实时且准确的推理。已有方法多依赖稠密 BEV 网格作为中间表示，存在 token 数量多、内存占用高、推理慢的缺点。

Method: 提出 MapLightning，用一组紧凑的 1D 可学习地图 token 替代稠密 BEV 网格。为从图像特征构建地图 token，采用自注意力而非普通交叉注意力，以支持图像与地图 token 的联合交互和上下文聚合。基于 Transformer 的 mapper 将地图 token 与图像 token 拼接后做完整自注意力，丢弃图像 token、保留更新后的地图 token 进行解码。该轻量设计允许 map decoder 使用完整交叉注意力（而非可变形注意力）以获得更好的全局上下文，且不使用相机投影参数，从而对相机外参扰动鲁棒。

Result: 相比稠密 BEV 方法，中间 token 数量最多减少 16.7 倍；在 nuScenes 与 Argoverse 2 上取得最优的精度与效率。轻量变体在 nuScenes 上超过 MapTRv2 +10.1 mAP，在 Argoverse 2 上 +16.2 mAP，同时推理快 1.73 倍（40+ FPS）、内存减少 53%。在不确定性感知地图构建与下游轨迹预测上也展现出改进。

Conclusion: MapLightning 通过紧凑 1D 地图 token 与自注意力聚合机制，在显著降低 token 数、内存与推理时间的同时达到 SOTA 精度，并具备对外参扰动的鲁棒性，可扩展至不确定性建模与下游任务。

Abstract: Online vectorized HD map construction is essential for scaling safe autonomous driving and requires accurate, real-time inference. Prior methods typically rely on dense bird's-eye-view (BEV) grids as the intermediate representation. We propose \textit{MapLightning}, which replaces the dense BEV grid with a compact set of 1D learnable map tokens. To construct map tokens from image features, we choose self-attention over vanilla cross-attention because it enables joint interactions and contextual aggregation among image and map tokens. Our transformer-based mapper concatenates map and image tokens, applies full self-attention, discards the image tokens, and retains the updated map tokens for decoding. This design offers three advantages. First, our representation is efficient, using fewer tokens, consuming less memory, and running faster. Second, the lightweight design allows the map decoder to use full rather than deformable cross-attention for better global context. Third, unlike BEV-based methods, our network does not use camera projection parameters, making it robust to camera-extrinsic perturbations. MapLightning uses up to 16.7$\times$ fewer intermediate tokens than dense BEV-based methods and achieves state-of-the-art accuracy and efficiency on nuScenes and Argoverse~2. Its lightweight variant surpasses MapTRv2 by +10.1 mAP on nuScenes and +16.2 mAP on Argoverse~2, while delivering 1.73$\times$ faster inference (40+ FPS) with 53\% less memory. We further show improvements on uncertainty-aware map construction and downstream trajectory prediction. Code and models will be released.

</details>


### [139] [DecomVoxel: Harnessing 3D-Native Priors with Guided In-situ Denoising Optimization for Decompositional Scene Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01914)
*Junfeng Ni,Zirui Zhou,Yixin Chen,Yu Liu,Nan Jiang,Zhifei Yang,Song-Chun Zhu,Siyuan Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 DecomVoxel，将物体补全建模为引导式的原位去噪优化，结合 3D 原生先验与神经场景重建，实现重遮挡场景下的高质量分解式重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分解式场景重建旨在重建高质量物体与背景，但现有方法在严重遮挡下质量不佳。2D 图像先验缺乏 3D 感知导致多视角不一致，而 3D 原生先验虽具强结构归纳偏置，却常在复杂场景中产生空间漂移与错位。

Method: 提出 DecomVoxel：将物体补全表述为引导式原位去噪优化，桥接 3D 原生先验与神经场景重建；引入重表述的基于 epsilon 的蒸馏损失以保证隐变量精炼稳定；并采用自适应空间引导，利用占据与空置锚点结合时间退火，抑制生成幻觉、缓解空间漂移。

Result: 在 Replica 和 ScanNet++ 数据集上，DecomVoxel 显著优于当前最先进方法，同时忠实保留原始空间布局、结构保真度与风格一致的纹理。

Conclusion: 该方法通过提供具有干净拓扑、几何与外观的高质量带纹理网格，拓展了分解式重建的边界，为复杂真实场景的分解式重建提供了稳健方案。代码已开源。

Abstract: Decompositional scene reconstruction aims to reconstruct high-quality objects and background, yet existing methods still struggle with the level of quality under heavy occlusions. While generative priors offer a potential solution, 2D image-based priors often suffer from multi-view inconsistency due to a lack of 3D awareness. Conversely, 3D-native priors provide stronger structural inductive biases but frequently lead to spatial drift and misalignment within complex scenes. To address these issues, we propose DecomVoxel, formulating object completion as a guided in-situ denoising optimization that bridges 3D-native priors with neural scene reconstruction. Our framework introduces a reformulated epsilon-based distillation loss to ensure stable latent refinement, alongside adaptive spatial guidance that utilizes occupied and vacant anchors with temporal annealing to suppress generative hallucinations and mitigate spatial drift. Experiments on Replica and ScanNet++ show that DecomVoxel significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods while faithfully preserving the original spatial layout, structural fidelity, and style-consistent texture. Our method pushes the boundary of decompositional reconstruction by delivering high-quality textured meshes with clean topology, geometry, and appearance, providing a robust solution for the decompositional reconstruction of complex real-world scenes. Code is available at https://github.com/DecomVoxel/DecomVoxel.

</details>


### [140] [MoLE: Mixture of Latent Experts for Complementary Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01917)
*Yingcheng Liu,Tianyi Jiang,Yujuan Ding,jiangbo Ai,Xun Jiang,Guoqing Wang,Wei Ye,Yi Bin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 MoLE（Mixture of Latent Experts）框架，通过隔离潜在视觉专家的证据提取并用专门的潜在摘要专家聚合互补表示，使不同潜在 token 成为专门的视觉专家，从而提升视觉推理效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有潜在视觉推理方法中，多个潜在 token 通过共享价值投影访问同一视觉证据，缺乏提取互补视觉信息的机制，简单增加潜在 token 数量只会产生冗余表示。作者认为有效的潜在推理应鼓励不同潜在 token 提取互补视觉信息，充当专门的视觉专家。

Method: MoLE 控制每个潜在视觉专家观察哪些视觉证据以及如何转换这些证据：在证据提取阶段隔离潜在视觉专家，并使用专门的潜在摘要专家聚合互补表示。采用两阶段训练流程，先强制视觉证据通过该潜在通路，再恢复直接视觉访问，无需预定义专家角色或中间视觉目标。

Result: 在五个视觉推理基准上，MoLE 平均得分 78.6，比数据匹配的监督微调高 4.9，比相同潜在预算下最强基线高 3.6。表示分析显示潜在状态相似度更低、视觉注意力更多样；屏蔽潜在通路使平均性能下降 9.2。

Conclusion: 结果表明，专门化潜在计算比单纯增加潜在 token 数量更有效。

Abstract: Latent visual reasoning equips vision--language models with continuous intermediate states that can process visual evidence without explicit textual reasoning traces or repeated image operations. However, existing methods often allow multiple latent tokens to access the same visual evidence through shared value projections, providing no mechanism for them to extract complementary visual information; simply increasing the latent budget can therefore yield redundant latent representations. We argue that effective latent reasoning should encourage different latent tokens to extract complementary visual information, and thereby act as specialized visual experts. Based on this insight, we propose MoLE, a Mixture of Latent Experts framework that controls both what visual evidence each latent visual expert observes and how it transforms that evidence. MoLE isolates latent visual experts during evidence extraction and uses dedicated latent summary experts to aggregate the complementary representations of latent visual experts. A two-stage training pipeline first forces visual evidence through this latent pathway and then restores direct visual access, requiring neither predefined expert roles nor intermediate visual targets. Across five visual reasoning benchmarks, MoLE achieves an average score of 78.6, outperforming data-matched supervised fine-tuning by 4.9 and the strongest evaluated latent visual reasoning baseline at the same latent budget by 3.6. Representation analyses show lower latent-state similarity and more diverse visual attention, while masking the latent pathway reduces average performance by 9.2. These results demonstrate that specializing latent computation is more effective than merely increasing the number of latent tokens.

</details>


### [141] [Fewer Tokens, Better Action: GPT-6 Astra Robot Agents with 14% Higher Success Rate but 65% Fewer Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01939)
*Ruiyang Si,Jianxin Bi,Shunyu Yang,Rui Ni,Wenbo Huang,Qiang Wang,Shulong Jiang,Duomin Wang,Xiuyu Li,Haiwen Feng,Zhen Dong,Daquan Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PyRUA-Lean是一个交互式代码执行框架，通过反馈驱动的原语组合与选择性观察，显著降低VLM智能体控制机器人时的token开销并提升成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLM智能体虽能通过视觉反馈和动作原语控制机器人，但重复的模型调用和冗余观察带来大量token开销。

Method: 将经典机器人原语与学习型VLA策略组合成Python单元，执行条件检查和局部重试，仅返回显式请求的图像与状态反馈用于重新规划；使用相同GPT-6 Astra规划器和机器人原语，与工具调用基线对比。

Result: 在LIBERO-PRO、RoboTwin 2.0和RoboCasa365共700个模拟任务中，相同LLM调用预算下成功率从63.1%提升至71.7%；在双方均解决的任务上，LLM调用减少49%，输入token减少65%。

Conclusion: 代码执行式框架能更高效地利用观测与模型调用，在提升任务成功率的同时大幅降低计算成本。

Abstract: Vision language model (VLM) agents can control robots through visual feedback and action primitives, but repeated model invocations and redundant observations incur substantial token overhead. We introduce PyRUA-Lean, an interactive code-execution framework that couples feedback-driven primitive composition with selective observation: the agent composes classical robot primitives and learned vision-language-action (VLA) policies into Python cells that perform conditional checks and local retries, returning only explicitly requested images and state feedback for replanning. Across 700 simulated task instances from LIBERO-PRO, RoboTwin 2.0, and RoboCasa365, we compare PyRUA-Lean with a tool-calling baseline using the same GPT-6 Astra planner and underlying robot primitives. Under equal LLM-call budgets, PyRUA-Lean increases overall success from 63.1% to 71.7%. On instances solved by both agents, it uses 49% fewer LLM calls and 65% fewer input tokens.

</details>


### [142] [Latent-Foresight: End-to-End Learning Predictable Representations for Latent World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01942)
*Efstathios Karypidis,Spyros Gidaris,Nikos Komodakis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Latent-Foresight，端到端联合学习潜变量分词器与基于流的生成动力学模型，显式塑造表示以支持时序预测，避免两阶段流程的解耦问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖两阶段流程：先用固定降维（如PCA）或独立训练的自编码器压缩VFM特征，再在冻结潜空间上训练独立预测器。表示学习与时序预测解耦，或将预测器直接作用于原始VFM特征，都无法保证潜空间结构适合可预测的动力学。

Method: 提出Latent-Foresight端到端框架，联合学习潜变量分词器与基于流的生成动力学模型，显式塑造可预测的表示。引入若干关键设计选择以防止潜变量坍缩，并使重建目标与生成目标对齐，从而实现稳定的联合优化。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法学习到更具时序一致性的潜表示，在多种未来场景理解任务和不同预测时域上持续优于两阶段基线，同时消除了分离的训练阶段（包括高分辨率适配阶段）。

Conclusion: 端到端联合优化潜表示与动力学模型能提升未来场景预测的表征质量与效果，代码与模型权重已在GitHub公开。

Abstract: Predicting the future evolution of a scene is a fundamental capability for world modeling. Recent work has shown that operating in the feature space of Vision Foundation Models (VFMs) yields semantically rich representations that support diverse future scene understanding tasks. However, existing approaches rely on two-stage pipelines, where VFM features are first compressed using fixed dimensionality reduction (e.g., PCA) or independently trained autoencoders, and a separate predictor is trained on top of the resulting frozen latent space. This decoupling between representation learning and temporal prediction, as well as approaches that apply predictors directly on raw VFM features, provides no guarantee that the latent space is structured for predictable dynamics. In this work, we propose Latent-Foresight, an end-to-end framework that jointly learns a latent tokenizer and a flow-based generative dynamics model, explicitly shaping the representation to support temporal predictability. To enable stable joint optimization, we introduce several key design choices that prevent latent collapse and align reconstruction with generative objectives. Extensive experiments show that our approach learns more temporally coherent latent representations and consistently outperforms two-stage baselines across multiple future scene understanding tasks and prediction horizons, while eliminating separate training stages, including during high-resolution adaptation. We provide the implementation code and model weights at https://github.com/Sta8is/Latent-Foresight

</details>


### [143] [Anti-Persona: Disrupting Unauthorized Identity Binding and Recognition in Personalized Vision--Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01944)
*Abhishek Basu,Fahad Shamshad,Karthik Nandakumar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Anti-Persona，一种针对个性化 LVLM 的图像级防御方法，通过破坏身份原型对齐来防止未授权身份绑定与识别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 少样本个性化使 LVLM 能学习用户特定视觉概念，但也带来隐私风险：攻击者可用少量参考图像绑定目标身份，并通过自然语言查询在新图像中识别该身份。现有防御难以应对这种身份绑定与识别威胁。

Method: 核心洞察是身份个性化依赖多张参考图像共享的视觉特征。方法聚合这些特征为身份原型，在视觉编码器空间中优化视觉上细微的扰动以破坏原型对齐；并通过空间平滑和低频保留提升视觉保真度与对图像压缩的鲁棒性。防护不依赖特定提示词，支持主动反个性化与被动图像保护。

Result: 在两个代表性个性化 LVLM 上，保护率最高达 95.0%，同时保持视觉保真度；方法在提示词变化和评估的身份查询任务中保持稳定，并在编码器不匹配时提升黑盒迁移性。

Conclusion: Anti-Persona 能有效防御个性化 LVLM 中的未授权身份绑定与识别，兼具高保护率、视觉保真度与迁移鲁棒性。

Abstract: Few-shot personalization enables large vision--language models (LVLMs) to learn user-specific visual concepts for applications such as personalized retrieval and subject-aware querying. However, it also creates a privacy risk: an adversary can bind a target identity from a few reference images and subsequently detect that identity in new images through natural-language queries. We introduce Anti-Persona, an image-level defense against unauthorized identity binding and recognition in personalized LVLMs. Our key insight is that identity personalization relies on visual features shared across multiple reference images. We aggregate these features into an identity prototype and optimize visually subtle perturbations that disrupt prototype alignment in the vision-encoder space. Spatial smoothing and low-frequency preservation further promote visual fidelity and practical resilience to image compression. The resulting protection does not depend on a specific prompt and supports both proactive anti-personalization and reactive image protection. Experiments on two representative personalized LVLMs demonstrate protection rates of up to $95.0\%$ while preserving visual fidelity. The method remains stable across prompt variations and evaluated identity-query tasks, and improves black-box transfer under encoder mismatch.

</details>


### [144] [EndoLive: Real-Time Style Transfer for Endoscopic Endonasal Skull Base Surgical Video](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01956)
*Griffin Hurt,Calvin Brinkman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 EndoLive 框架，实现尸体内镜视频与活体内镜视频之间的实时风格迁移，帮助外科医生更真实地进行颅底手术训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内镜下颅底手术等复杂术式需要大量训练，通常使用尸体标本练习，但尸体组织颜色与活体差异大且无法自然出血，导致解剖结构辨识与真实手术不同，因此需要缩小尸体训练与活体手术之间的视觉差距。

Method: 结合 ConStructS GAN 实现手术场景的真实风格迁移，以及可学习复杂翻译并实时执行的 HyPER-GAN，在非配对的尸体内镜图像与活体内镜图像上训练 EndoLive，并用尸体内镜视频在多设备上测试。

Result: 实验表明 EndoLive 能以远高于实时最低要求的速度完成尸体到活体的翻译，同时保持关键解剖结构的语义一致性。

Conclusion: EndoLive 可有效用于尸体内镜视频的实时风格迁移，提升手术训练的真实感，源代码已公开。

Abstract: Complex surgical procedures around critical anatomy, such as the endoscopic endonasal skull base surgery, requires significant practice and training on the part of the surgeon before they are allowed to perform the operation on a live patient. This training in typically done in cadaveric specimens, due to them containing the same critical structures as a living human. However, cadavers are not a perfect 1-to-1 substitute for a living patient. The dead and preserved tissues of a cadaver are colored completely differently than a living human, and -- without complex and expensive pumping systems -- do not bleed in the same way. As a result, identifying the critical pieces of anatomy that make this procedure so complex can be quite different in a live case than in a surgeon's cadaveric practice. This paper presents EndoLive, a framework for real-time style transfer between cadaveric endoscopic video and living human endoscopic video. Our method combines the ConStructS GAN model for realistic style transfer for surgical applications, with the HyPER-GAN model that can learn complex translations and perform them in real-time. We train EndoLive on unpaired cadaveric and live images taken from an endoscope, and test the trained model with cadaveric video, on a variety of devices. Experimental results demonstrate that EndoLive can perform cadaveric-to-live translation at speeds well above the minimum necessary for real-time, while maintaining semantic consistency of critical anatomical structures. Our source code is available at https://github.com/griffhurt/endolive.

</details>


### [145] [RASteer: Retain-Aware Activation Steering for Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01969)
*Yongliang Wu,Haori Lu,Yulun Wu,Jinqi Luo,Xingyu Zhu,Yaoyao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出RASteer，一种免训练的概念擦除方法，通过构建保留子空间并去除擦除方向中的共享成分，平衡目标概念擦除与非目标内容保留。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有激活引导方法从目标概念构建擦除方向，但目标与保留概念在表示空间中常重叠，直接沿该方向引导会抑制保留概念，损害非目标内容的生成。需要更精细的方法在擦除目标的同时保护保留内容。

Method: 提出RASteer免训练方法：1）从待保留概念构建保留子空间；2）Retain-Orthogonal Steering (ROS) 从擦除方向中移除与保留子空间对齐的成分，使引导更具目标特异性；3）Overlap-Adaptive Calibration (OAC) 在每层和每去噪步利用擦除方向与保留子空间的重叠度，控制共享成分的移除比例，从而平衡擦除与保留。

Result: 在不安全内容、实例和艺术风格擦除任务上，跨多个骨干网络和基准测试，RASteer达到或超过所评估的激活引导和权重编辑基线，在擦除与保留之间取得更好的平衡。

Conclusion: RASteer通过保留子空间正交化和重叠自适应校准，有效缓解了激活引导中共享成分带来的副作用，实现了更优的概念擦除与保留平衡。

Abstract: Concept erasure aims to remove a target concept, such as a copyrighted style, a recognizable character, or unsafe content, from a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model while preserving its ability to generate other content. Existing activation steering methods build an erasure direction mainly from the target concept and adjust model activations along it at inference time. However, target and retained concepts often overlap in the model's representation space, so this direction also contains shared components that retained concepts rely on. Steering directly along this direction can therefore suppress retained concepts and harm the generation of non-target content. To address this issue, we propose Retain-aware Activation Steering (RASteer), a training-free method. RASteer first builds a retain subspace from the concepts to preserve. Retain-Orthogonal Steering (ROS) then removes components aligned with this subspace from the erasure direction, making steering more specific to the target. Since fully removing the shared components can weaken erasure, we further introduce Overlap-Adaptive Calibration (OAC). At each layer and denoising step, OAC uses the overlap between the erasure direction and the retain subspace to control how much of each shared component is removed, balancing target erasure and concept preservation. Experiments on unsafe-content, instance, and artistic-style erasure across multiple backbones and benchmarks show that RASteer matches or outperforms the activation steering and weight editing baselines we evaluate, achieving a better balance between erasure and preservation.

</details>


### [146] [Token-Level Video Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01973)
*Yifan Wang,Gordon Guocheng Qian,Yanyu Li,Anil Kag,Yun Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TVRL，利用冻结视觉语言模型的问题似然与梯度为视频生成提供令牌级信用，在VBench-2.0上以57.69的Overall分数超越基线3.60分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频生成强化学习通常对整个采样视频分配单一标量奖励，但视频中各视觉令牌质量并不均一：部分令牌已满足提示，另一些才需修正。标量奖励无法定位错误，导致优化扰动合格令牌、却对真正需改变的令牌作用不足。

Method: 提出TVRL，从被优化奖励中导出令牌级信用。核心洞察是冻结视觉语言模型的答案似然同时提供两类信号：其输出贡献视频级奖励，其视频输入梯度幅值揭示哪些生成令牌对该分数影响最大。在GRPO中实例化：将提示导出的问题奖励平均为一个组相对优势，并用分离的、以问题为条件的令牌信用图，在裁剪策略比率内对稠密去噪转移对数概率再加权。

Result: 在VBench-2.0上Overall达57.69，超基线3.60分；相比匹配的GRPO基线，在SAGE、Flow、Dance三种SDE采样器上提升2.68–3.15分，在VideoAlign、VideoScore2、UnifiedReward2、Qwen3.5-9B四种奖励模型上提升1.33–3.15分。

Conclusion: 以令牌级信用替代单一标量奖励可更精准定位需修正的视觉令牌，TVRL在多种采样器与奖励模型下均稳定优于GRPO基线，验证了方法的通用性与有效性。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for video generation usually assigns one scalar reward to an entire sampled video. Yet a video is not uniformly flawed: some visual tokens may already satisfy the prompt, whereas others require correction. A scalar reward cannot localize errors, causing optimization to perturb satisfactory tokens while under-targeting the tokens that actually need to change. We introduce Token-Level Video Reinforcement Learning, TVRL, a framework that derives token-level credit from the reward being optimized. Our key insight is that the answer likelihood of a frozen vision-language model provides both signals: its outputs contribute to the video-level reward, while magnitudes of its video-input gradients reveal which generated video tokens most affect that score. We instantiate TVRL in Group Relative Policy Optimization by averaging prompt-derived question rewards into one group-relative advantage and using detached, question-conditioned token-credit maps to reweight dense denoising-transition log-probabilities inside the clipped policy ratio. On VBench-2.0, TVRL achieves an Overall score of 57.69, outperforming the base model by 3.60 points. TVRL also improves matched GRPO baselines across three SDE samplers (SAGE, Flow, and Dance) by 2.68--3.15 points and across four reward models (VideoAlign, VideoScore2, UnifiedReward2, and Qwen3.5-9B) by 1.33--3.15 points.

</details>


### [147] [Continual Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models by Suppressing Cross-Edit Interference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01989)
*Yongliang Wu,Haori Lu,Jinqi Luo,Wei Cao,Xingyu Zhu,Yaoyao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出CEASE，一种无需训练的持续概念擦除方法，通过自适应子空间编辑约束干扰累积，在擦除名人与艺术风格等任务上实现最一致的擦除-保留权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着擦除请求随时间不断到来，扩散模型需在移除新目标的同时不破坏此前的擦除结果。现有方法无法约束编辑间的相互干扰：保留集之外的残余扰动会相互作用并累积，导致无关生成质量下降，甚至使已擦除目标坍缩为噪声。

Method: CEASE对闭式求解器施加两个子空间约束：一是将共享替换词的token表示加入求解器的不变性矩阵；二是当检测到干扰时，将当前更新投影到由累积历史更新中提取的主导输出方向的正交补空间上。此外通过闭式分解将累积干扰归因于共享替换词的反复激活与连续更新方向的重叠。

Result: 在名人、艺术风格和特定实例的持续擦除任务中，CEASE取得了最一致的擦除-保留权衡；而现有方法要么损害通用生成能力，要么擦除不充分。

Conclusion: CEASE通过两个子空间约束分别抑制了干扰的两个来源，验证了闭式分解的理论分析，为持续概念擦除提供了无需训练且兼顾擦除与保留的有效方案。

Abstract: Concept erasure removes copyright-protected, privacy-sensitive, or otherwise undesirable concepts from pretrained text-to-image diffusion models to support content governance and compliance. As erasure requests arrive over time, models must remove new targets without undoing prior erasures. Existing methods do not constrain interference across edits: residual perturbations outside the retain set interact and accumulate, degrading unrelated generations and sometimes collapsing previously erased targets into noise. We propose CEASE (Continual Erasure via Adaptive Subspace Editing), a training-free method that imposes two subspace constraints on a closed-form solver. CEASE adds the token representation of the shared replacement to the solver's invariance matrix and, when interference is detected, projects the current update onto the orthogonal complement of dominant output directions extracted from cumulative past updates. A closed-form decomposition attributes the accumulated interference to repeated activation of the shared replacement and overlap between successive update directions, showing that the two constraints suppress these respective sources. Across continual erasure of celebrities, artistic styles, and instances, CEASE achieves the most consistent erase-preserve trade-off, while existing methods either degrade general generation or insufficiently erase targets.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [148] [Bounded-Fidelity Sim-as-Demo-Stage: Mocap Handoff for Governance Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00008)
*Xue Qin,Simin Luan,Cong Yang,Zhijun Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出"有界保真仿真演示阶段"（bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage）设计模式，通过在明确限定的交接包络内抑制接触物理，解决LLM驱动机器人治理基准测试中的审计链分歧问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真到现实研究通常以物理保真度为首要目标，但在LLM驱动机器人的治理基准测试中，接触力积分噪声会注入与治理属性无关的审计链分歧，成为干扰因素。

Method: 提出"有界保真仿真演示阶段"模式，在明确限定的交接包络（抓取、搬运、放置）内抑制接触物理，其余部分保留完整动力学。使用MuJoCo的mocap-body原语，由220行Python适配器驱动，治理桥通过结构化意图调用。将审计链稳定性形式化为重放间哈希事件日志的字节相等。

Result: N=1000次重放/姿态下，mocap变体产生1个唯一审计链哈希（1000/1000字节一致，Wilson 95% CI [0.997, 1.000]）；接触力基线产生584个不同哈希（993/1000分歧，CI [0.987, 0.998]）。时间步扫描（1、2、5、10 ms）显示分歧是结构性的，各时间步均保持0.985。包络边缘时序抖动（±10仿真步，1400次重放）零分歧，K∈{1,2,3}顺序交接物体时审计链保持字节相等（1500次重放），每次抓放开销亚线性。

Conclusion: 该模式以近乎零工程成本为基准设计者提供审计链可复现性；同时明确了其不适用场景（仿真到现实验证、策略训练、接触丰富任务），避免误用。

Abstract: Sim-to-real research pursues physics fidelity as a primary objective: simulators are judged by how closely they reproduce real-world contact dynamics. For governance benchmarking of LLM-driven robots, where the simulator demonstrates that an admission/policy/contract/audit pipeline behaves correctly, contact fidelity at object handoffs (grasp, carry, place) becomes a liability: contact-force integration noise injects audit-chain divergence that is structurally unrelated to the governance property under test. We propose bounded-fidelity sim-as-demo-stage, a design pattern that suppresses contact physics within explicitly bracketed handoff envelopes while preserving full dynamics elsewhere. The construction uses MuJoCo's mocap-body primitive driven by a 220-line Python adapter that the governance bridge invokes via structured intents. We formalise audit-chain stability as byte-equality of the hashed event log across replays and identify two structural envelope properties that imply it. Across N=1000 replays per posture, the mocap variant produces one distinct audit-chain hash (1000/1000 byte-identical; Wilson 95% CI [0.997, 1.000]); the contact-force baseline produces 584 distinct hashes (993/1000 diverged; CI [0.987, 0.998]). A timestep sweep (1, 2, 5, 10 ms) shows the divergence is structural, not a tuning artefact: it stays at 0.985 at every timestep. Envelope-edge timing jitter (+/-10 simulation steps, 1,400 replays) produces 0 divergence, and audit chains remain byte-equal across K in {1, 2, 3} sequentially handed-off objects (1,500 replays) with sub-linear per-pick-and-place overhead. The pattern gives benchmark designers audit-chain reproducibility at near-zero engineering cost; we also map where it is harmful (sim-to-real validation, policy training, contact-rich tasks) so it is not mis-deployed.

</details>


### [149] [Multi-Reference Path Tracking Control for an Agricultural Tractor with Nonlinear Model Predictive Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00057)
*Marcel Moll,Timo Oksanen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文开发了一种基于非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）的拖拉机路径跟踪控制器，将分段线性参考路径的多段直接纳入目标函数，并在田间试验中验证，平均绝对横向误差为6.1 cm。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 引导拖拉机沿预定参考路径行驶是精准农业的关键组成部分，需要一种能够精确跟踪路径的控制方法。

Method: 基于非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）开发路径跟踪控制器，将分段线性参考路径的多段直接纳入目标函数，并提出从完整路径中选择可行参考段的方法；通过拖拉机经Tractor Implement Management转向接口进行田间试验评估。

Result: NMPC求解器平均在3.45 ms后收敛，跟踪曲线参考路径的平均绝对横向误差为6.1 cm。

Conclusion: 所提出的NMPC路径跟踪控制器具有良好的实时性与跟踪精度，适用于精准农业中的拖拉机路径跟踪任务。

Abstract: Guiding a tractor along a predefined reference path is a key component of precision agriculture. This study develops a path tracking controller based on Nonlinear Model Predictive Control, which incorporates multiple segments of a piecewise-linear reference path directly into the objective function. In addition, methods for selecting viable reference segments from the full path are presented. The control system is evaluated during a field test with a tractor controlled via the Tractor Implement Management steering interface. The NMPC solver converged on average after 3.45 ms and tracked the curved reference path with a mean absolute cross-track error of 6.1 cm.

</details>


### [150] [Probabilistic Plan Legibility with Off-the-shelf Planners](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00065)
*Michele Persiani,Thomas Hellström*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向任意PDDL领域的可读性规划方法，通过二阶心智理论估计观察者视角，将可读性规划扩展到经典规划中，无需构建专用规划器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可读性规划旨在让规划者生成能向观察者最清晰区分其目标的规划。已有关于可读性的研究需要构建专门的规划器，难以推广到经典规划中的任意PDDL领域。作者希望在不依赖专用规划器的前提下，将可读性扩展到经典规划，并可用于人-机器人协作场景中机器人通过可读规划隐式传达目标。

Method: 将先前关于可读性的研究扩展到经典规划，面向任意PDDL领域提出可读性规划方法，无需构建ad-hoc规划器。通过二阶心智理论连接规划者与观察者的任务空间，以估计观察者视角。并在多个PDDL规划领域上进行基准测试。

Result: 在多个PDDL规划领域的基准测试表明，规划的可读性与规划效率之间存在权衡关系；不同规划领域提升可读性的方式并不相同，因此需要一个正则化因子来平衡可读性与效率。

Conclusion: 可读性规划可推广到任意PDDL经典规划领域，并可通过二阶心智理论建模观察者视角；可读性与效率存在权衡，且需引入正则化因子进行平衡。该方法可应用于人-机器人团队协作等场景。

Abstract: Legible planning is the creation of plans that best disambiguate their goals from a set of other candidates from an observer's perspective. In this paper we propose a method for legible planning for arbitrary PDDL domains, by extending previous research on legibility to classical planning without requiring to construct ad-hoc planners. We also discuss how the observer perspective may be estimated through a second order theory of mind that connects the planner's and the observer's task spaces. Our solution can for example be deployed in human-robot teaming scenarios, where an autonomous robot in a team can implicitly communicate its goal by producing legible plans. We present benchmark results on several PDDL planning domains. Our results generally show that plan legibility is a trade-off with plan efficiency, however, not all planning domains allows to increase legibility in the same way and a regularizing factor to balance legibility and efficiency was proved necessary.

</details>


### [151] [HumanoidTTT: Test-Time Capability Reuse for Efficient Humanoid Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00198)
*Jingtai Yang,Yining Wu,Yanjun Li,Zeyu Zhang,Hao Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出HumanoidTTT框架，通过选择性完整动作复用与测试时能力巩固，实现人形机器人在持续部署中对已验证动作能力的安全高效复用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人持续部署中动作能力会被反复请求，但中间动作会改变机器人进入状态，导致直接重放旧动作不再安全；同时能力不断积累而存储有限，需要决定保留哪些能力。

Method: 提出HumanoidTTT框架，包含两个组件：1）选择性完整动作复用（Selective Full-Motion Reuse）：仅从经过认证的适用进入状态授权直接复用已验证的完整动作，被接受时绕过重新生成；2）测试时能力巩固（Test-Time Capability Consolidation）：利用后续部署复用作为反馈，在有限的全动作存储中自适应决定保留哪些合格能力。

Result: 实验显示零不安全接受，端到端相比重新生成提速16.4倍；在线巩固相比冻结版本在每200次请求中多避免13.2次生成器调用。

Conclusion: HumanoidTTT在持续部署中实现了已验证动作能力可靠且高效的复用，并自适应地保留有用能力。

Abstract: Recent advances in motion generation and whole-body tracking have enabled humanoid robots to execute increasingly diverse motions, yet the same motion capabilities may be requested repeatedly during continual deployment. Reliable reuse is challenging because intervening motions can change the robot's entry state, making previously successful motions unsafe to replay blindly. Meanwhile, validated capabilities accumulate during deployment, while bounded storage requires deciding which ones are worth retaining. To address these challenges, we present HumanoidTTT, a framework for test-time capability reuse in continual humanoid control. Specifically, we introduce Selective Full-Motion Reuse, which authorizes direct reuse of validated complete motions only from certified applicable entry states, allowing accepted reuse to bypass fresh generation. We further introduce Test-Time Capability Consolidation, which adapts which qualified capabilities persist in a bounded Full-Motion Store using subsequent deployment reuse as feedback. Experiments demonstrate zero unsafe accepts and a 16.4$\times$ end-to-end speedup over fresh generation, while online consolidation improves avoided generator calls by 13.2 per 200 requests over its frozen counterpart. Overall, HumanoidTTT enables reliable and efficient reuse of validated motion capabilities while adaptively retaining useful capabilities throughout continual deployment. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/HumanoidTTT. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/HumanoidTTT.

</details>


### [152] [Real-Time Whole-Body Safe Motion Generation for Multi-Segment Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00220)
*Fangju Yang,Siyi Ma,Tonghao Guan,Tingcong Liu,Hang Yang,Zhengqiang Zhang,Jian S. Dai,Ke Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出面向平面多段腱驱连续体机器人的统一驱动空间框架，融合变曲率能量模型与多点CBF-QP，实现实时全身无碰撞运动生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 腱驱连续体机器人的实时运动生成需要准确建模非均匀弯曲，并实现全身碰撞避免，二者难以兼顾。

Method: 构建基于能量的变曲率模型，刻画空间变化的腱间距与弯曲刚度，并给出解析雅可比用于微分逆运动学与安全监测；采用多点CBF-QP在障碍运动与驱动速度约束下保证骨架间隙，其决策维度仅取决于独立驱动段数。

Result: 模型与GVS参考吻合良好，最大曲率误差为$5.223 \times 10^{-2}\,\mathrm{m}^{-1}$；100次MuJoCo试验中静态与动态场景无碰撞成功率分别为96%和100%，无CBF约束时约60%和80%；穿洞测试验证受限环境安全性；600个骨架监测点下平均控制步耗时6.66 ms。

Conclusion: 该框架可在保证全身安全的同时实现实时运动生成，适用于受限环境下的连续体机器人控制。

Abstract: Real-time motion generation for tendon-driven continuum robots requires accurate modeling of nonuniform bending and whole-body collision avoidance. This paper presents a unified actuation-space framework for planar multi-segment tendon-driven continuum robots. An energy-based variable-curvature model captures spatially varying tendon spacing and bending stiffness and provides analytical Jacobians for differential inverse kinematics and safety monitoring. A multipoint CBF-QP enforces backbone clearance under obstacle motion and actuation-velocity bounds, while its decision dimension depends only on the number of independently actuated segments. The model closely agrees with GVS references, with a maximum curvature error of $5.223 \times 10^{-2}\,\mathrm{m}^{-1}$. Over 100 MuJoCo trials, the proposed method achieves collision-free success rates of 96% and 100% in static and dynamic scenarios, respectively, compared with approximately 60% and 80% without CBF constraints. Hole-traversal tests further demonstrate safe motion in constrained environments. With 600 backbone monitoring points, the mean control-step time is 6.66 ms, demonstrating real-time whole-body safe motion generation.

</details>


### [153] [DriftOPD: Sequence-Level Reverse-KL Distillation for One-Step VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00317)
*Youngjun Jun,Kyumin Choi,Youngmin Kim,Seonghyun Jin,Sunwoo Park,Jangho Park,Jong Chul Ye*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DriftOPD 提出一种无需教师、无需在线 rollout 的序列级同策略蒸馏框架，将序列级反向 KL 分解为动作块级项与未来势能项，通过一步漂移目标与离线 Q 函数优化，把长时程行为蒸馏进单步 VLA 动作专家。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 动作专家在滚动时域控制下只生成短动作块，块级训练虽便于跨机器人本体迁移，却只优化局部动作似然，未显式考虑长时程任务成功率；而序列级强化学习通常依赖策略 rollout 与闭环交互，在真实机器人操作中代价高昂。因此需要一种既能在序列级优化、又不依赖在线交互和独立教师的方案。

Method: 论文提出 DriftOPD，一个无需教师、无需 rollout 的连续 VLA 动作专家序列级同策略蒸馏框架。理论上证明序列级反向 KL 散度可分解为块级反向 KL 项与刻画当前动作长时程影响的未来势能项，并分别用一步漂移（drifting）目标和从离线示范中学习到的 Q 函数评论家来优化这两项，从而仅用离线数据和一步动作生成实现序列级优化。

Result: 在多种 VLA 架构的仿真与真实世界操作任务中，DriftOPD 总体优于现有单步蒸馏基线，并取得与多步教师策略相当的任务成功率。

Conclusion: 结果表明，长时程行为可以在无需在线交互、也无需单独教师的情况下，有效蒸馏进单步 VLA 动作专家。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models increasingly rely on action experts that generate short action chunks under receding-horizon control. While chunk-level training is convenient across robot embodiments, it optimizes local action likelihood without explicitly accounting for long-horizon task success. Sequence-level reinforcement learning can address this limitation, but typically requires policy rollouts and closed-loop interaction, which are costly for real-robot manipulation. We introduce DriftOPD, a teacher-free, rollout-free framework for sequence-level on-policy distillation of continuous VLA action experts. We show that the sequence-level reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence decomposes into a chunk-level reverse-KL term and a future-potential term that captures the long-horizon effect of the current action. DriftOPD optimizes these two terms using a one-step drifting objective and a Q-function critic learned from offline demonstrations, respectively, enabling sequence-level optimization with only offline data and one-step action generation. Across multiple VLA architectures in simulation and real-world manipulation, DriftOPD generally outperforms existing one-step distillation baselines while achieving task success performance comparable to multi-step teacher policies. These results demonstrate that long-horizon behavior can be effectively distilled into one-step VLA action experts without online interaction or a separate teacher.

</details>


### [154] [Retrospective Open-Vocabulary Memory for Long-Term Object Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00330)
*Jiaming Wang,Zhiwei Xue,Chen Jizhuo,Peng Shiqi,Harold Soh*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出将长期目标搜索中的回溯性开放词汇记忆建模为基于删失观测的概率推断，强调"每次观测机会"的权重，并提出ECROM方法估计长期概念普遍性并转化为主动搜索先验，在HM3D长期基准上取得提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期目标搜索需要从对变化环境的重复但不均匀观测中学习物体的常见出现位置。现有方法未妥善处理观测机会不均导致的证据偏差问题。

Method: 将回溯性开放词汇记忆形式化为删失观测下的概率推断，核心思想是按观测机会加权证据：检测或未检测只应按机器人观察该位置的机会比例影响信念。提出ECROM，据此估计仅在查询时指定概念的长期普遍性，并将信念直接转化为主动搜索先验。

Result: 在十个HM3D家庭中构建了可独立变化物体摆放与观测机会的受控长期基准。ECROM在留出查询上的support-level AP提升4.5点，搜索SPL提升4.2点。

Conclusion: 按观测机会加权证据的概率推断能有效建模长期开放词汇记忆并改进主动搜索，基准、数据集与代码将开源。

Abstract: Long-term object search requires learning where objects usually appear from repeated but uneven observations of a changing environment. We formulate retrospective open-vocabulary memory as probabilistic inference from censored observations, where the key idea is to reason with evidence per opportunity: a detection or non-detection should influence belief only in proportion to the robot's opportunity to observe the corresponding location. We introduce ECROM, which uses this principle to estimate long-term prevalence for concepts specified only at query time and converts the resulting belief directly into an active-search prior. To evaluate this problem, we introduce a controlled long-term benchmark in ten HM3D homes that independently varies object placement and observation opportunity across repeated traversals. ECROM improves support-level AP on held-out queries by 4.5 points and search SPL by 4.2 points over the strongest competing memory in each metric. The benchmark, dataset, and code will be open-sourced.

</details>


### [155] [IndoorBEV: A Lightweight Real-Time LiDAR BEV Perception System for Indoor Mobile Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00355)
*Haichuan Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: IndoorBEV：一种轻量级LiDAR感知框架，通过高度感知BEV表示与几何条件特征融合，在室内3D感知中实现精度、延迟与内存的良好折衷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动机器人在严格的延迟与内存约束下理解杂乱三维环境具有挑战。现有基于点或体素的方法计算开销大，而传统BEV表示虽高效却丢弃了垂直几何信息，二者存在效率与信息完整性的权衡。

Method: 采用高度感知BEV表示：用统计高度特征与多频高度编码汇总每个BEV单元的垂直点分布，使3D线索可由2D卷积高效处理；轻量编码器融合互补几何特征、多尺度局部表示与紧凑全局场景上下文；解耦密集预测头联合输出语义BEV图与有向目标框。

Result: 模型仅0.6M参数、2.3MB存储。在NVIDIA AGX Orin上单次推理占21.52MB显存，200ms感知截止期内平均延迟169.6ms，超时率1.8%。在仿真场景、真实机器人扫描及开源室内点云数据集上均表现出较好的精度-延迟-内存权衡。

Conclusion: 在紧凑BEV表示中显式编码垂直几何，是资源高效室内LiDAR感知的有效途径。

Abstract: Efficient indoor LiDAR perception is challenging because mobile robots must understand cluttered three-dimensional environments under strict latency and memory constraints. Existing point-based and voxel-based methods often incur substantial computational overhead, whereas conventional bird's-eye-view (BEV) representations improve efficiency at the cost of discarding vertical geometric information. We present IndoorBEV, a lightweight LiDAR perception framework that mitigates this tradeoff through a height-aware BEV representation and geometry-conditioned feature fusion. IndoorBEV summarizes the vertical point distribution in each BEV cell using statistical height features and multi-frequency height encoding, allowing informative three-dimensional cues to be processed efficiently by two-dimensional convolutions. A lightweight encoder then integrates complementary geometric features with multi-scale local representations and compact global scene context. Decoupled dense prediction heads jointly produce semantic BEV maps and oriented object bounding boxes. IndoorBEV contains only 0.6M parameters and requires 2.3 MB of model storage. On an NVIDIA AGX Orin, it uses 21.52 MB of GPU memory per inference and achieves a mean latency of 169.6 ms under a 200 ms perception deadline, with a deadline miss ratio of 1.8\%. Evaluations on simulated scenes, real-world robot scans, and an open-source indoor point-cloud dataset demonstrate a favorable tradeoff among perception accuracy, latency, and memory consumption. These results indicate that explicitly encoding vertical geometry within a compact BEV representation provides an effective approach to resource-efficient indoor LiDAR perception.

</details>


### [156] [DexPolicy: Scheduled Exploration for Trajectory-Guided Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00360)
*Haoyu Wang,Siyuan Qian,Yanjun Li,Zeyu Zhang,Yandong Guo,Boxin Shi,Hao Tang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DexPolicy将RL探索噪声尺度显式设为训练步数的退火函数，在多种策略优化设置下大幅提升灵巧操作任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作RL需先发现手指-物体接触再精确控制物体，服务前一目标的动作噪声会干扰后者；在ViViDex等轨迹引导场景中，基线PPO训练5M步后仍停留在初始噪声水平，亟需显式控制探索尺度。

Method: 将探索噪声尺度设为训练步数的显式函数，从宽到窄退火，同时固定损失、架构、奖励与优化器设置；研究PPO、无critic的GRPO续训、流参数化PPO变体（FPO）三种策略优化设置。

Result: 五个YCB物体、三个种子下确定性Target成功率：FPO 49.4%→68.1%，GRPO 14.1%→45.4%，PPO 32.0%→35.7%；RealMan RM75配Inspire/RH56手、三物体360次试验：FPO 25.0%→85.0%，GRPO 10.0%→63.3%，PPO 8.3%→43.3%。PPO组件筛选显示噪声控制优于测试的优化器收缩；所选调度在三个测试物体上优于相同端点的线性衰减。

Conclusion: 训练回报、确定性Target成功率与执行噪声容忍度相互解耦；调度应按预期执行条件下的终端任务成功来评判，且需针对具体任务与策略优化设置分别评估。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for dexterous manipulation must discover finger-object contacts and then control the object precisely; the action noise that serves the first goal can interfere with the second. In trajectory-guided settings such as ViViDex, where RL refine hand-object trajectories from human video, our baseline PPO runs end near their initial action noise after 5M steps, motivating explicit control of exploration scale. DexPolicy makes that scale an explicit function of training steps, annealing from broad to narrow exploration while holding loss, architecture, reward, and optimizer settings fixed. We study three policy-optimization settings: PPO, critic-free GRPO continuation, and a flow-parameterized PPO variant (FPO). Across five YCB objects and three training seeds, mean deterministic Target success rises from 49.4% to 68.1% (FPO), 14.1% to 45.4% (GRPO), and 32.0% to 35.7% (PPO). On a RealMan RM75 arm with an Inspire/RH56 hand, 360 trials over three objects raise mean Target success from 25.0% to 85.0% (FPO), 10.0% to 63.3% (GRPO), and 8.3% to 43.3% (PPO), with one trained model per object-method condition. PPO component screening favors noise control over the tested optimizer contraction; the selected PPO schedule yields higher mean Target success than linear decay with the same endpoints on three tested objects. Training return, deterministic Target success, and tolerance to execution noise dissociate; schedules should therefore be judged by terminal task success under the intended execution conditions, per task and policy-optimization setting. Code: https://github.com/AIGeeksGroup/DexPolicy. Website: https://aigeeksgroup.github.io/DexPolicy.

</details>


### [157] [DeepJEPA: Scaling World Models from Within](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00368)
*Zijian Jin,Yunbei Zhang,Yuanzhe Liu,Ming Liu,Baian Chen,Weirui Ye,Shilong Liu,Marco Pavone*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 DeepJEPA，将世界模型中的转移深度视为内部测试时扩展轴，学习在决策关键的转移上分配更多循环更新，而非对每个转移均匀加深。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型规划器通过滚动更远、采样更多轨迹或优化更久来扩展，且对每个想象转移分配相同计算量。作者认为均匀加深每个转移会浪费计算并可能损害规划，因为有用的精化集中在少数决策关键事件上。

Method: DeepJEPA 是一种权重共享的联合嵌入预测世界模型，将转移深度作为内部测试时扩展轴，学习为每个候选和滚动步判断是否值得再执行一次循环更新，从而按需分配计算。

Result: 在五个视觉控制设定中，DeepJEPA 优于或匹配最强固定深度规划器，同时平均每个转移仅需 1.00–1.26 次更新；额外计算集中在接触起始和持续物体交互处，这些潜在修正可影响精英候选集与最终动作选择。表征探测显示规划改善并不需要统一更好的物体状态可解码性。

Conclusion: DeepJEPA 将世界模型扩展重新定义为计算分配问题：在能改变规划器决策的决策关键转移上思考更深，而非让每次滚动都均匀加深或加长。

Abstract: World-model planners typically scale outward by rolling farther, sampling more trajectories, or optimizing longer, while assigning the same computation to every imagined transition. We show that making every transition uniformly deeper wastes computation and can degrade planning because useful refinement is concentrated at a small set of decision-critical events. We introduce DeepJEPA, a weight-tied joint-embedding predictive world model that treats transition depth as an inner test-time scaling axis and learns when another recurrent update is worth computing for each candidate and rollout step. Across five visual-control settings, DeepJEPA improves or matches the strongest fixed-depth planner while averaging only 1.00-1.26 updates per transition. Its additional computation concentrates at contact onset and sustained object interaction, where latent corrections can change which candidates enter the planner's elite set and which action is selected. Representation probes further show that improved planning does not require uniformly better object-state decodability. DeepJEPA therefore reframes world-model scaling as a problem of allocating internal computation where it can change the planner's decision: think deeper at decision-critical transitions instead of making every rollout uniformly deeper or longer.

</details>


### [158] [Whole-Body Aerial Grasping and Lifting via Partial Visual Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00404)
*Jiaye Jin,Rui Jin,Xinhang Xu,Haotian Jin,Ruiyang Liu,Yi Wang,Jiayan Zhao,Kun Cao,Lihua Xie*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出循环教师-学生框架，在仿真中学习单一策略，联合控制飞行、机械臂运动与夹爪闭合，完成空中抓取-提升任务，无需显式任务阶段输入。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空中抓取-提升任务需要在部分观测条件下进行全身协调。早期接近阶段失败会减少后续任务阶段的训练暴露，而可见性变化又增加了对准与闭合时机的难度。

Method: 采用特权教师通过强化学习训练，并引入关键状态课程，先暴露抓取与提升状态再连接到正常接近轨迹；随后将其行为蒸馏为循环视觉学生策略，用双视角点云与本体感知替代特权目标状态，并整合观测历史实现闭环控制；另设专门闭合目标，基于持续模型定义的准备序列监督闭合时机。

Result: 在仿真抓取与负载模型中完成8,996个回合，冻结学生策略在标称、物理/控制随机化及额外相机随机化条件下的全任务成功率分别为99.97%、97.14%和95.84%；标称条件下按锁存次数加权的每种子90百分位对准误差均值为8.12 mm。

Conclusion: 该框架能够在无需任务阶段输入的情况下，通过教师-学生蒸馏与关键状态课程实现高成功率的空中抓取-提升闭环控制，并具备一定的随机化鲁棒性。

Abstract: Aerial grasp-and-lift tasks require whole-body coordination across approach, acquisition, and lifting under partial target observations. Early approach failures can limit exposure to later task stages during training, while changing visibility complicates alignment and closure timing during execution. We present a recurrent teacher-student framework that learns a single policy in simulation to jointly command flight, arm motion, and gripper closure without an explicit task-phase input. A privileged teacher learns through reinforcement learning with a critical-state curriculum that exposes acquisition and lifting states before connecting them to normal approach trajectories. Its behavior is distilled into a recurrent visual student that replaces privileged target states with dual-view point clouds and proprioception, integrating observation history for closed-loop control. A dedicated closure objective supervises closure timing from sustained model-defined readiness sequences. Training and primary evaluation use a simulated acquisition-and-payload model with condition-triggered latching, virtual attachment, and wrench-based payload loading for short-distance lifting. Across 8,996 completed simulation episodes under this model, the frozen student achieves full-task success rates of 99.97%, 97.14%, and 95.84% under nominal, physics/control-randomized, and additional camera-randomized conditions, respectively. The nominal latch-count-weighted mean of per-seed 90th-percentile alignment errors at acquisition is 8.12 mm.

</details>


### [159] [Towards a General Humanoid Loco-Manipulation Model via Egocentric Whole-Body Human Data Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00438)
*Chongyang Xu,Zhao Wu,Jin Chen,Yiming Jiang,Jinhui Ye,Yuming Jiang,Shifeng Zhang,Ziliang Feng,Mu Xu,Yilun Chen,Li Lu,Steven C. H. Hoi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出500小时人类全身移动操作数据集HumanVerse-500，并基于其训练人形全身视觉-语言-动作策略λ0，实现可扩展的人类经验迁移与SOTA表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形全身操作发展迅速，但人类视频监督对全身运动与手物交互协调的覆盖有限，而人形遥操作采集此类监督成本高、难扩展。作者希望探索如何利用人类经验支持人形locomanipulation的可扩展学习。

Method: 构建HumanVerse-500：用轻量可穿戴系统同步采集自我中心视频与身体、手部运动，覆盖开放环境多样行为，共500小时。基于此开发λ0全身人形VLA策略，采用三阶段训练：先从多样自我中心数据集学习交互，再用HumanVerse-500协调身体与手部运动，最后适配下游任务与机器人本体。过程中学习共享表示空间以迁移人类经验，并用领域专用接口处理人机状态与动作差异。

Result: 在SIMPLE和4个真实世界locomanipulation任务上评估λ0，取得SOTA性能；并分析其扩展行为、泛化能力及训练阶段贡献，以理解人类数据如何支持下游全身人形控制。

Conclusion: 人类经验可有效支撑人形全身locomanipulation的可扩展学习，HumanVerse-500与λ0为后续研究提供数据、模型与代码支持。

Abstract: Humanoid whole-body manipulation has advanced rapidly, enabling policies to coordinate locomotion, posture, bimanual interaction, and dexterous hand movements. Meanwhile, egocentric human videos provide diverse examples of everyday interactions across objects and scenes, offering scalable supervision without robot operation. However, existing supervision from these videos provides limited coverage of whole-body movement and coordination with hand-object interaction, while obtaining such supervision through humanoid teleoperation is also costly and difficult to scale. We therefore explore how human experience can support scalable learning of humanoid loco-manipulation. To support this study, we introduce HumanVerse-500, a 500-hour dataset of diverse human loco-manipulation behaviors in open-world environments, collected with a lightweight wearable system that synchronizes egocentric video with body and hand motion. Building on this dataset, we develop $λ_0$, a whole-body humanoid vision-language-action policy, through three-stage training that first learns interaction from diverse egocentric datasets, then coordinates body and hand motion using HumanVerse-500, and finally adapts the policy to downstream tasks and robot embodiments. Across these stages, $λ_0$ learns a shared representation space for human experience transfer, while domain-specific interfaces handle differences between human and robot states and actions. We evaluate $λ_0$ on SIMPLE and 4 real-world loco-manipulation tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance, and further analyze its scaling behavior, generalization, and training-stage contributions to understand how human data support downstream whole-body humanoid control. We will release our code, models, and data to support further research.

</details>


### [160] [ScaffoldM3C: A Multimodal Sequential Monte Carlo Framework for Generative Stable Construction Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00487)
*Gadiel Sznaier Camps,Chengyang He,Guillaume Sartoretti,Eduardo Montijano,Mac Schwager*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出ScaffoldM3C，一个多模态、轻量的自回归模型，用于稳定的积木式3D结构构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主构建物理可实现的3D结构面临组合动作空间大、组件可互换、装配序列多解以及构建过程稳定性要求严格等挑战。现有方法微调大语言模型进行文本生成式构建，但存在不足：不支持多模态（文本、图像、草图）条件输入，忽视了脚手架对稳定中间结构的实用作用，且推理速度慢。

Method: 将构建建模为带多种潜在装配动作和多种任务条件模态的概率式下一块生成任务；引入辅助的脚手架块token以显式考虑脚手架的效用；提出ScaffoldM3C模型，一种多模态轻量自回归模型，提出一组下一步候选块，并利用序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）维护可能装配序列的种群，从而同时考虑多个装配方向；通过扩展StableText2Brick数据集加入图像条件提示和脚手架稳定化构建序列来训练。

Result: ScaffoldM3C比竞争基线小4倍，推理时获得5倍至20倍加速，同时达到与最先进方法相当的构建质量和更高的整体稳定性。

Conclusion: 通过仿真和真实机器人装配演示验证了该方法的有效性。

Abstract: Autonomously constructing physically realizable 3D structures remains a significant challenge due to combinatorial action spaces, interchangeable components, equifinal assembly sequences, and strict stability requirements during construction. State-of-the-art methods fine-tune large language models for text-based generative construction. However, these approaches do not allow for Multimodal (text, image, sketch) conditioning, overlook the practical role of scaffolding for stabilizing intermediate structures, and suffer from slow inference speeds. Therefore, we formulate construction as a probabilistic next-block generation task with multiple potential assembly actions and multiple potential task conditioning modalities. Concurrently, we explicitly consider the utility of scaffolding by introducing an auxiliary scaffold block token. We present Scaffold Multimodal Monte Carlo (ScaffoldM3C), a multimodal, lightweight, auto-regressive model for stable block-based construction, that proposes a set of next-step candidate blocks. Leveraging these candidates, we utilize Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) to maintain a population of possible assembly sequences, allowing us to consider multiple, potentially different, assembly directions simultaneously. We train our multimodal architecture by extending the StableText2Brick dataset to contain image conditioning prompts and scaffold-stabilized build sequences. ScaffoldM3C is 4x smaller than competing baselines, yielding a 5x to 20x speedup during inference, while achieving comparable construction quality to state-of-the-art methods and higher overall stability. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through simulations and real-world robot assembly demonstrations.

</details>


### [161] [Same Scene, Different Task: Skill Alignment for Compositional Generalization in VLAs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00524)
*Taegeun Yang,Youngju Na,Yoonki Cho,Sung-Eui Yoon*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 CRAFT 方法，通过反事实配对与技能表征迁移监督，缓解 VLA 模型的视觉捷径问题，提升未见技能组合的泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型在微调时往往难以泛化到演示中未出现的技能组合，即使每个组成技能都已被演示。作者将视觉捷径视为一种失败模式：微调时视觉观测可能成为指令的代理，模型会执行与相似观测相关联的已演示组合，而非按指令执行。
