We argue that the router should score the update. To first order, adding an expert's update to a layer output lowers the loss by the inner product between that update and the negative loss gradient at the output. This usefulness is quadratic in the token, so a router that is linear in the token sees only the part of it that runs through the token mean, and routers that rank experts by the norm of their own activations never see the output factor. If each expert is split into a reader (down-projection) and a writer (up-projection), the usefulness of every reader--writer pair becomes an inner product in the shared rank-$r$ space, and all $N_AN_B$ pairs can be scored from $N_A+N_B$ vectors. We build VANE on this identity. A low-rank compass predicts the descent direction of each token. VANE scores every pair by the alignment between its update and the compass without forming any update, activates the top-$k$ pairs with additive gates, and gives every pair its exact first-order router gradient. On single-domain commonsense reasoning and a four-domain multi-task mixture with Llama-3.2-3B and Llama-3.1-8B, VANE attains the best average among twelve PEFT and MoE-LoRA baselines, by 0.9--1.1 and 1.3--1.5 points respectively, with less than half the trainable parameters of an 8-expert MoE-LoRA. Its router scores also track the measured usefulness of experts far more closely than token routers do.

</details>


### [299] [Gumbel Straight Flow: Distilling Autoregressive Models into One-step Flow Maps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00497)
*Yeongmin Kim,Arnaud Doucet,Andrew Campbell,Valentin De Bortoli,Thomas Mensink,David Ruhe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GSF 是一种连续流映射语言模型，利用预训练自回归模型诱导的 Gumbel 噪声与 one-hot token 序列耦合，构造不相交的线性路径，从而实现高质量少步语言生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有少步语言生成方法在采样质量和步数效率上仍有不足，作者希望借助预训练自回归模型的噪声-数据耦合结构，提升少步路径采样的质量。

Method: 提出 Gumbel Straight Flow（GSF）：理论上证明 AR 模型诱导的 Gumbel 噪声与 one-hot token 序列耦合形成不相交的线性路径；采用流映射半群目标，由 AR 教师直接引导切向量（速度）条件。

Result: 在预训练与下游任务等多个基准上，GSF 优于当前少步语言生成基线。

Conclusion: GSF 通过利用 AR 模型的噪声-数据耦合与流映射半群目标，实现了优于现有基线的少步语言生成效果。

Abstract: We present Gumbel Straight Flow (GSF), a continuous flow map language model that leverages the noise-data coupling of a pretrained autoregressive language (AR) model. We theoretically demonstrate that the coupling between Gumbel noise and one-hot token sequences induced by an autoregressive model yields non-intersecting linear paths connecting the noise to the sequence representations. To further enhance high-quality few-step path sampling, we use a flow map semigroup objective where the tangent (velocity) condition is guided directly by the AR teacher. Across various benchmarks, including pretraining and downstream tasks, GSF can outperform current few-step language generation baselines.

</details>


### [300] [Denoising Surface: Modeling and Predicting Inference Cost for Diffusion LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00499)
*Haoyu Zheng,Fangcheng Fu,Binhang Yuan,Yongqiang Zhang,Liang Deng,Hao Wang,Yuanyuan Zhu,Xiao Yan,Jiawei Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出去噪工作负载曲面（DWS），保留扩散大语言模型的块-步二维执行结构以预测推理成本，实现跨硬件迁移并显著降低延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）进入实际部署后，请求管理（如调度与资源分配）依赖准确的单请求推理成本估计。然而常用成本代理方法并不适用：输出长度忽略了单次前向可解掩多个token，去噪步数则忽略了每步成本的异质性。

Method: 作者观察到块自回归生成机制在输出块与块内去噪步上形成二维执行结构，而现有代理将其压缩为标量，丢失关键信息。据此提出DWS，将该二维块-步结构保留为概率曲面，对不同每步成本加权；并设计由粗到细的训练方案，使轻量级的仅提示词预测器能准确预测复杂DWS，且可在单CPU核心上高效运行，避免与serving模型争抢GPU。

Result: 在真实serving实验中，DWS相较基于标量的预测器将成本预测误差最多降低2.50倍；DWS引导的最短作业优先调度器在在线聊天机器人场景下将端到端延迟最多降低1.92倍。

Conclusion: DWS将请求相关的执行行为与部署相关的成本因素解耦，使预测器无需重新训练即可跨硬件配置迁移，为dLLM实际服务提供高效准确的成本预测与调度方案。

Abstract: As diffusion large language models (dLLMs) become more capable, they are moving from research settings to real-world \textit{serving}, where request management (such as scheduling and resource allocation) relies on accurate estimation of per-request inference cost. However, common cost proxies fall short for dLLMs: output length ignores that one forward pass can unmask multiple tokens, and denoising-step count ignores the \textit{heterogeneous} per-step costs. We observe that the block-autoregressive generation mechanism induces a two-dimensional execution structure over output blocks and within-block denoising steps, whereas these proxies collapse it into a scalar, discarding information essential for characterizing the cost. Motivated by this insight, we propose the Denoising Workload Surface (DWS), which preserves this two-dimensional block-step structure as a probability surface to weight the heterogeneous per-step costs. We then design a coarse-to-fine training scheme that enables a lightweight prompt-only predictor to accurately predict the complex DWS. This predictor runs efficiently even on a single CPU core, avoiding GPU contention with the serving model. Since DWS decouples request-dependent execution behavior from deployment-specific cost factors, the predictor transfers across hardware configurations without retraining. In \textit{real-world} serving experiments, DWS reduces cost-prediction error by up to $2.50\times$ over scalar-based predictors, while the DWS-guided shortest-job-first scheduler reduces end-to-end latency by up to $1.92\times$ for online chatbots.

</details>


### [301] [One-Step Generative Modeling via Training Dynamics Action](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00518)
*Zhangyong Liang,Ying Huang,Haibin Ling*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TDAction，按局部共享参数实现代价选择传输目标，用软终端控制求解闭式 Batch Tangent Action-to-Go 值，在 ImageNet 256×256 上无蒸馏取得 FID 低于 1.1。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一步生成模型通过迭代训练时传输构建静态生成器，但现有传输目标主要衡量分布运动，忽略了神经生成器需通过共享参数更新共同实现样本位移。由此提出问题：当训练本身是构建最终一步映射的迭代过程时，应优化下一次分布移动，还是有限生成器学习最终映射的路径？

Method: 引入 TDAction，在保留指定分布进展的同时，按局部共享参数实现代价选择传输目标。将代价建模为软终端控制问题，推导出闭式 Batch Tangent Action-to-Go 值，纳入参数努力与终端失配；该准则捕获独立成对代价遗漏的跨样本交互。各向同性移动下，对确定性平衡耦合与二次欧氏分配一致；随机切向探针提供低秩实现，构造共享的分离目标且不增加推理轨迹。

Result: 受控实验考察了生成器几何、传输选择与实现的局部动作之间的关系；在 ImageNet 256×256 上，TDAction 无蒸馏达到 FID 低于 1.1。

Conclusion: TDAction 将训练时传输目标的选择从单纯分布运动转向考虑共享参数实现代价，为一步生成模型的训练动力学提供了新的优化视角，并取得强实证表现。

Abstract: One-step generative models construct a static generator through iterative training-time transport. Existing transport objectives primarily assess distributional motion, although a neural generator needs to realize the requested sample displacements jointly through shared parameter updates. The training-time construction raises the question: \emph{once training becomes the iterative process that constructs the final one-step map, what to optimize: the next distributional move, or the route by which the finite generator learns the final map?} To address the question, we introduce \textbf{T}raining \textbf{D}ynamics \textbf{A}ction (\textbf{TDAction}), which selects transport targets according to local shared-parameter realization cost while retaining a prescribed level of distributional progress. We formulate the cost as a soft-terminal control problem and derive a closed-form Batch Tangent Action-to-Go value that accounts for parameter effort and terminal mismatch. The criterion captures cross-sample interactions omitted by independent pairwise costs; under isotropic mobility, the criterion agrees with quadratic Euclidean assignment for deterministic balanced couplings. Randomized tangent probes provide a low-rank implementation that constructs shared detached targets without adding an inference-time trajectory. Controlled studies examine the relationship between generator geometry, transport selection, and realized local action. On ImageNet $256\times256$, TDAction attains an FID below $1.1$ without distillation.

</details>


### [302] [SimplexUQ: An Evaluation Framework and Benchmark for Conformal Uncertainty on Simplex-Valued Predictions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00523)
*Liang You,Hengyu Shi,Dongwen Ou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SimplexUQ是首个针对单纯形值预测的基准与可复现协议，用于测量保形预测在难易区域间覆盖率分配不均的问题，比较现有wrapper而非提出新方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 保形预测虽保证边际覆盖，但单一校准阈值会使覆盖在易区域过度、在难区域不足，此前缺乏针对单纯形值预测上这种分配问题的基准与可复现协议。

Method: 构建SimplexTasks-12任务套件，含6个受控合成场景与6个冻结预测器的真实任务（类概率、主题混合、光谱丰度、细胞类型比例、年龄分布、情绪混合）。每次比较固定预测器、评分和分层映射，仅更换wrapper，报告边际覆盖、最差分层覆盖、最大差异及任务内半径与计算量。

Result: 全局校准可能看似有效却严重失败：CIFAR-10上边际覆盖0.900但最差熵分层仅0.542，Mondrian将其提升至0.886并把最大差异从0.358降至0.022。无wrapper占绝对优势；平滑异质性下多种修复方法具竞争力；12任务比较中Mondrian在自身目标划分上全部12项差异更低，BatchMVP在重叠组上5项更低。预测器偏差扫描显示消除偏差仅部分降低全局阈值差异。

Conclusion: 这是经验性比较而非新的覆盖保证，wrapper选择应视为诊断性比较而非通用排名；发布任务卡、结果溯源、允许的派生数组及重建说明。

Abstract: Conformal prediction guarantees marginal coverage, but a single calibration threshold can still spread that coverage unevenly, over-covering easy regions and under-covering hard ones. SimplexUQ is, to our knowledge, the first benchmark and reproducible protocol for measuring this allocation problem on simplex-valued predictions; it compares existing conformal wrappers rather than proposing a new one. Its task suite, SimplexTasks-12, combines six controlled synthetic regimes with six frozen-predictor real tasks spanning class probabilities, topic mixtures, spectral abundances, cell-type fractions, age distributions, and emotion mixtures. Each comparison fixes the predictor, score, and response-free stratification map, varies only the wrapper, and reports marginal coverage, worst-stratum coverage, max disparity, and within-task radius and compute. Global calibration can look valid while failing badly: on CIFAR-10 it attains 0.900 marginal coverage but only 0.542 in the worst entropy stratum, and Mondrian calibration raises that stratum to 0.886 while reducing max disparity from 0.358 to 0.022. No wrapper dominates, however. Under smooth synthetic heterogeneity, several repairs are competitive; fixed-map analyses show that rankings depend on the evaluation groups and protocol; and in a 12-task comparison, Mondrian has lower disparity on its single target partition for all 12 tasks, whereas BatchMVP has lower disparity over overlapping groups on five. These are empirical comparisons, not new coverage guarantees. A controlled predictor-bias sweep shows that removing predictor bias only partly reduces global-threshold disparity. We release task cards, result provenance, permitted derived arrays, and rebuild instructions, and treat wrapper selection as a diagnostic comparison rather than a universal ranking.

</details>


### [303] [Random Recursive Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00541)
*Jama Hussein Mohamud,Mirco Ravanelli*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出随机递归模型（RRM），通过从L个学习层中随机采样层进行T步递归，实现参数高效且深度灵活的网络架构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 递归模型通过参数复用创建计算深度，是增大模型规模的参数高效替代方案，但现有递归模型大多重复应用单一变换或固定顺序，将计算限制在固定层序。

Method: 维护一个含L个学习层的池，在每个样本和每一步独立有放回地采样一层，执行T步递归，从而实现灵活的层复用并保持参数效率。

Result: 在挑战性推理任务上达到或超过基线，常减少50-75%参数；可在推理时改变深度（包括超出训练时深度）而无需重训练或加参数；支持蒙特卡洛推理和概率性测试时扩展，均提升性能。

Conclusion: RRM在参数效率和推理灵活性上具有优势，这些发现可能为神经网络架构设计开辟新方向。

Abstract: Recursive models create computational depth through parameter reuse, offering a parameter-efficient alternative to increasing model size. However, most recursive models repeatedly apply one learned transformation or a prescribed sequence of transformations, restricting computation to a fixed layer order. We introduce the Random Recursive Model (RRM), which maintains a pool of $L$ learned layers and performs $T$ recursive steps by sampling one layer independently with replacement for each example and step. This enables flexible layer reuse while retaining the parameter efficiency of recurrence. We evaluate RRM on challenging reasoning tasks, where it matches or exceeds the baselines, often with 50-75 % fewer parameters. RRM can vary its depth at inference, including beyond that seen during training, without retraining or adding parameters, improving tasks that benefit from deeper iterative computation. RRM also supports Monte Carlo inference and probabilistic test-time scaling, both of which improve performance without retraining. These insights may open new directions in neural network architecture design.

</details>


### [304] [Geometry-Dependent Bounds for Online Non-Monotone DR-Submodular Maximization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00545)
*Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究在紧凸下闭集上对非负、非单调DR-次模函数的对抗性在线最大化问题，证明了系数为4/9的比较器一致一阶不等式，改进在线0.401基准，并给出上下界匹配及多项式时间离线近似结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线最大化非单调DR-次模函数已有基准系数为0.401，本文旨在改进该系数并刻画最优近似系数的理论极限。

Method: 采用有序坐标论证与目标无关的有理动作，结合三组对称间隙构造；对系数已知的多项式族分别处理，并给出自适应对抗与值反馈扩展。

Result: 证明系数4/9（ζ≥1/2时提升至1/2）、O(√T)期望近似遗憾；给出离线预言机上界β*=0.470438681380894…；任意ζ下广义最小二乘上下界匹配，最优亏缺为Θ((1/2-ζ)^2)；常数目标序列获得(4/9-ε)离线近似。

Conclusion: 该工作改进了非单调DR-次模在线最大化的近似系数并刻画了理论极限，建立了在线与离线下界之间的紧密联系。

Abstract: We study adversarial online maximization of nonnegative, non-monotone DR-submodular functions over compact convex down-closed sets. A learner commits each action before observing its objective and competes with the best fixed action in hindsight. We prove a comparator-uniform first-order inequality that gives coefficient $4/9$, improving the online $0.401$ benchmark, with one gradient query and one projection per round and $O(\sqrt T)$ expected approximate regret. If $ζ{\bf 1} \in K\subseteq[0,1]^d$, the coefficient improves to $\underlineα(ζ)=\tfrac12-(1-2ζ)_+^2/[2(3-2ζ)^2]$. The proof is a direct ordered-coordinate argument with an objective-independent rational action. Conversely, a three-group symmetry-gap construction yields an offline oracle upper bound $β_*=0.470438681380894\ldots$ at $ζ=0$, even with exact value and full-gradient responses. A parameterized extension and exact finite-instance bounds define an upper function for every $ζ$. The lower and upper bounds match at $1/2$ for $ζ\ge1/2$, and show that the optimal deficit from $1/2$ is $Θ((1/2-ζ)^2)$ as $ζ\uparrow1/2$. For coefficient-revealed polynomials we obtain $1/2$ for quadratics and a geometry-dependent cubic coefficient starting at $8/17$, including $0.49$ at $ζ=1/5$. A constant objective sequence yields an offline $(4/9-\varepsilon)$ approximation with polynomially many first-order queries on the cube and projections, without requiring a supplied positive lower bound on the optimum. We also give nonanticipating adaptive-adversary and value-feedback guarantees, including $O(T^{3/4})$ regret with one noisy value per round.

</details>


### [305] [Evaluating Hybrid Quantum-Classical Models for Reduced-Order Brain Deformation Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00554)
*Tao Liu,Ge He,Dongyu Liang,Wujie Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估混合量子-经典机器学习用于时空脑变形场的降阶预测，采用POD降维并在静态回归与自回归预测两个任务上对比经典与量子模型，发现经典网络在此场景下仍具决定性优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维位移场的计算不可行性促使研究降阶建模；同时需要为近期量子机器学习（QML）寻找严谨的测试平台，以检验混合量子-经典架构能否在真实物理场学习任务中发挥作用。

Method: 使用本征正交分解（POD）将高维时空脑变形场投影到紧凑潜空间；定义两类学习目标——静态的时间到潜变量回归与自回归潜状态预测；将紧凑经典基线（POD-MLP、POD-LSTM）与最小及增强型混合量子架构（VQC、增强VQC、QLSTM）进行系统基准对比，并在不同历史窗口和随机初始化下评估。

Result: 静态回归中，经典POD-MLP优于所有量子变体，但增强型VQC较最小VQC基线有显著提升；时间预测中，经典POD-LSTM在不同历史窗口与随机初始化下，预测精度和统计稳健性均优于增强型QLSTM。

Conclusion: 降阶物理场学习可作为近期QML的严谨测试平台；混合增强能成功恢复弱量子电路的表达能力，但经典架构在保真度与稳定性上仍保持决定性优势。

Abstract: We evaluate hybrid quantum-classical machine learning for the reduced-order prediction of spatiotemporal brain deformation fields. To mitigate the computational intractability of high-dimensional displacement fields, we employ Proper Orthogonal Decomposition (POD) to project the data into a compact latent space. Within this framework, we formulate two distinct learning objectives: static temporal-to-latent regression and autoregressive latent state forecasting. We systematically benchmark compact classical baselines against both minimal and enhanced hybrid quantum architectures. Our results demonstrate that classical networks provide the strongest baselines in the present setting. For static regression, a classical POD-MLP outperforms all evaluated quantum variants, although an enhanced Variational Quantum Circuit (VQC) substantially improves upon a minimal VQC baseline. For temporal forecasting, a classical POD-LSTM delivers superior predictive accuracy and statistical robustness compared to an enhanced Quantum LSTM (QLSTM) across varying history windows and random initializations. Overall, this study establishes reduced-order physical field learning as a rigorous testbed for near-term QML, highlighting that while hybrid enhancements successfully recover expressivity in weak quantum circuits, classical architectures retain a definitive advantage in both fidelity and stability.

</details>


### [306] [Redundancy Meets Synergy: Dependency-aware Expert Selection for MoE via Submodular Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00558)
*Zheng Lin,Shaoke Fang,Yuxin Zhang,Jinfeng Xu,Zihan Fang,Zhe Chen,Wei Ni,Jun Luo,Symeon Chatzinotas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DS-MoE框架，通过difference-of-submodular优化重新定义专家选择，兼顾专家间冗余与协同，实现了优于现有基线的压缩效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型通过稀疏激活扩展容量，但部署时受内存瓶颈限制。提取紧凑专家子集是解决方案，但现有启发式方法依赖Top-k排序，孤立评估单个专家，忽略了门控网络引入的专家间依赖关系。

Method: 分析损失退化的二阶泰勒展开，揭示专家组合中的功能二重性：冗余（重叠表示）与协同（互补误差抵消）。将选择目标建模为DS函数，数学上解耦冗余削减与协同最大化，并设计带单调性保证的majorization-minimization（MM）算法高效求解最优专家子集。

Result: 大量实验表明，DS-MoE有效保留了不可或缺的专家组合，性能优于当前最先进的基线方法。

Conclusion: DS-MoE提供了一个有理论依据的专家选择框架，通过DS优化与MM算法在保持关键专家组合的同时实现更优的压缩性能。

Abstract: While Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models effectively scale model capacity through sparse activation, their deployment is often bottlenecked by prohibitive memory requirements. Extracting a compact subset of experts presents a promising solution. However, existing expert selection heuristics predominantly rely on Top-k ranking, which isolates the evaluation of individual experts and ignores the intricate inter-expert dependencies introduced by the MoE gating network. In this paper, we propose DS-MoE, a theoretically grounded framework that redefines expert selection via difference-of-submodular (DS) optimization. By analyzing the second-order Taylor expansion of the loss degradation, we reveal functional duality within expert combinations: redundancy (where experts encode overlapping representations) and synergy (where experts provide complementary error cancellation). To navigate this duality, we mathematically decouple redundancy reduction from synergy maximization by formulating the selection objective as a DS function. Furthermore, we devise a tailored majorization-minimization (MM) algorithm with provable monotonicity guarantees to efficiently identify the optimal expert subset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DS-MoE effectively preserves indispensable expert combinations, achieving superior performance compared to the state-of-the-art baselines.

</details>


### [307] [Beyond Affine Transformations: A Soft Dominance Layer for Coordinate-Wise Neural Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00563)
*Mariano Rivera*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文初步探索了一种替代传统仿射变换的"软支配层"，通过可学习参考向量与输入坐标的平滑不等式比较实现输出，验证其可训练性与阈值可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经网络层依赖仿射变换，本文希望探索一种替代性原语，使其输出单元能够直接进行阈值式比较，从而获得可解释的硬阈值判断，并检验这种结构的可训练性。

Method: 提出Soft Dominance Layer：每个输出单元将输入坐标与可学习参考向量比较，聚合成平滑的不等式响应；用sigmoid松弛使比较可微，锐度参数α控制其向硬阈值决策过渡；在单次运行的MNIST上进行实验。

Result: 最高Soft Dominance准确率为0.9061（无退火）和0.9173（有退火），MLP基线为0.9827；这些描述性结果不足以确立可靠的配置排序或统计上支持的退火收益；学习到的参考向量呈现空间结构，显示结构化学习的定性证据。

Conclusion: 该工作仅为概念验证，尚未证明该原语优于仿射层；需通过多次随机种子实验及更广泛数据集来评估其稳健性与实际相关性。

Abstract: This paper presents a preliminary study of an alternative to the affine transformation underlying conventional neural-network layers. In the proposed Soft Dominance Layer, each output unit compares input coordinates with a learnable reference vector and aggregates smooth inequality responses. A sigmoid relaxation makes the comparisons differentiable, while a sharpness parameter $α$ controls their transition toward hard threshold decisions. The aim is to examine the trainability and direct threshold interpretation of this primitive, not to claim a replacement for affine layers. In single-run MNIST experiments, the highest observed Soft Dominance accuracy is $0.9061$ without annealing and $0.9173$ with annealing, compared with $0.9827$ for the MLP baseline. These descriptive results do not establish reliable configuration rankings or a statistically supported annealing benefit. Learned reference vectors exhibit spatial structure, providing qualitative evidence of structured learning. Repeated-seed experiments and broader datasets are required to assess robustness and practical relevance beyond this proof of concept.

</details>


### [308] [MIKASA-Robo-VLA: Benchmarking Memory in VLA Models for Long-Horizon Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00604)
*Egor Cherepanov,Nikita Kachaev,Aleksandr I. Panov,Alexey K. Kovalev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 MIKASA-Robo-VLA 基准，包含 90 个语言条件操作任务，专门用于评估 VLA 策略对任务中消失信息的记忆能力，并发布 22,500 条轨迹数据及 π0.5 基线结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常只观测最近一帧或少数帧，难以评估其如何利用任务过程中已消失的信息，缺乏针对记忆依赖型任务的系统评测基准。

Method: 构建 MIKASA-Robo-VLA 基准，含 90 个语言条件操作任务：80 个隐藏动作所依赖的线索，10 个为反应式对照（保留线索）；每个任务均提供指令。为 70 个任务设定环境阶段时间以指定信息缺口，其中 28 个缺口超过最宽固定上下文 VLA 的 16 帧窗口。缺口仅统计线索可证明缺席的区间，因此所有记忆依赖任务按构造仍需记忆。发布涵盖 10 种记忆类型的 22,500 条 oracle 轨迹（RLDS 与 LeRobotDataset v3 格式），并微调无观察历史与显式记忆模块的 π0.5 基线。

Result: π0.5 基线在 14 个任务上微调后平均任务成功率为 0.211 ± 0.044；其在 Long-split 任务上成功率较低，受开环分块与子集记忆类型混杂影响。

Conclusion: MIKASA-Robo-VLA 为评估 VLA 策略的记忆依赖能力提供了系统性基准与配套数据，但基线结果表明当前无记忆机制策略在该类任务上表现有限，记忆能力评估仍需进一步研究。

Abstract: Vision-language-action policies often see only one or a few recent frames, which makes it difficult to evaluate how they use information that disappears during a task. We introduce MIKASA-Robo-VLA, a benchmark of 90 language-conditioned manipulation tasks. All but 10 hide the cue an action depends on. Those 10 are reactive controls. MIKASA-Robo, the suite it rebuilds, has 32 tasks and uses language only in a representative VLA subset. Here every task provides an instruction, while memory-dependent tasks hide a task-relevant cue and reactive controls keep it available. For 70 tasks, environment phase timings specify an information gap, and for 28 of them the gap exceeds the 16-frame window of the widest fixed-context VLA we survey. The gap counts only the interval the cue is provably absent, not the full duration a policy must retain it, so every memory-dependent task still requires memory by construction, including the ones whose measured gap is short. We release 22,500 oracle trajectories across 10 memory types in RLDS and LeRobotDataset v3. A reference $π_{0.5}$ baseline with current images and proprioception, but no observation history or explicit memory module, is fine-tuned on 14 tasks and achieves 0.211 $\pm$ 0.044 mean task success. Its lower success on the evaluated Long-split tasks is confounded by open-loop chunking and the memory types represented in that subset. Project page: https://mikasarobo.github.io/

</details>


### [309] [Attention Kernels for Learning Maps Between Heavy-Tailed Measures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00564)
*Kailen Hargenrader,Edoardo Calvello,Bohan Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对概率测度上的算子学习，论文指出softmax的指数加权在重尾测度下会导致积分发散，因此提出并评估生长更慢的注意力核。作者构建了两个闭式解的基准，研究后归一化Transformer中注意力核生长与数据变换的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在概率测度上做算子学习时，若测度具有多项式尾，softmax中的指数加权会使测度级注意力积分发散，这促使研究者用生长更慢的函数替代指数函数。

Method: 构建两个具有闭式目标的测度算子学习基准，用于研究后归一化Transformer中的注意力核生长与数据变换；对比softmax与三种生长更慢的核，并测试symlog预处理及高斯控制组。

Result: 无数据变换时，softmax模型在两个重尾基准上出现ensemble collapse，而三种慢生长核均避免崩塌；symlog预处理使softmax在矩阵求逆任务上避免崩塌，但在sheared swap任务上无效；在高斯控制组上四种核表现相近。此外还考察了样本量对经验能量与Wasserstein距离对尾部差异敏感性的影响。

Conclusion: 生长更慢的注意力核是从重尾集合学习的后归一化Transformer的有效设计选择。

Abstract: Operator learning on probability measures can be accomplished with transformers. For measures with polynomial tails, the exponential weighting in softmax can make the corresponding measure-level attention integrals diverge. This motivates replacing the exponential with slower-growing functions. We construct two benchmarks for operator learning on measures with closed-form targets. We use these benchmarks to study attention kernel growth and data transformation in post-norm transformers. Without data transformation, the softmax models exhibit ensemble collapse on both heavy-tailed benchmarks, while the three slower-growing kernels avoid collapse. Symlog preprocessing allows softmax to avoid collapse on the matrix inverse task but not on the sheared swap task. On the Gaussian control, all four kernels perform similarly. We also examine how sample size affects the sensitivity of empirical energy and Wasserstein distances to tail differences. These results support slower-growing attention kernels as an effective design choice for post-norm transformers learning from heavy-tailed ensembles.

</details>


### [310] [Make Sparse Rewards Count: Density-Aware Reward Aggregation for Multi-Reward RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00574)
*Tong Zheng,Skylar Zhai,Zhan Cheng,TianMing Sha,Youling Huang,Shuo Zhou,Shaotong Qi,Jingcheng Liang,Xuwei Ding,Pengcheng Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究多奖励强化学习中奖励学习进度不均衡问题，提出基于优势能量与活跃组密度关系的方法DARA，通过对低活跃奖励施加反平方根密度校正来平衡奖励贡献，在工具调用和数学推理任务上显著加快目标行为学习速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多奖励RL用于让大模型同时满足多种行为目标。GDPO等奖励级归一化虽保留了各奖励在rollout组内的相对信息，但不同目标的学习进度仍不均衡，存在批次级信号失衡问题，需要一种校准各奖励贡献的机制。

Method: 作者提出"优势能量"（一个奖励在批次上平方优势之和）作为分析工具，在理想化GDPO归一化下证明其与"活跃组密度"（奖励提供非零相对优势的rollout组占比）成正比。据此提出Density-Aware Reward Aggregation（DARA），推导反平方根密度校正，对不常活跃的奖励信号赋予更大权重。权重由每个rollout批次计算，随训练中奖励活跃度变化自适应调整，且不改变底层策略优化目标。

Result: 在工具调用和数学推理实验中，DARA比GDPO更快学到目标行为：工具调用的格式合规在最多少26%的训练步数内达到，数学推理的长度合规在最多少65%的步数内接近饱和，同时最终性能保持竞争力。

Conclusion: DARA通过优势能量与活跃组密度的理论关系，实现了对多奖励贡献的有效校准，加速了稀缺活跃奖励的学习，同时保持最终性能竞争力，代码已开源。

Abstract: Multi-reward reinforcement learning trains large language models to satisfy multiple behavioral objectives simultaneously. Reward-wise normalization, as used in GDPO, preserves reward-specific relative information within rollout groups, but different objectives can still exhibit uneven learning progress. We study this behavior through advantage energy, the sum of a reward's squared advantages over a batch. Under idealized GDPO normalization, we show that this energy is proportional to active-group density: the fraction of rollout groups in which the reward provides nonzero relative advantages. This reveals a residual batch-level signal imbalance and provides a basis for calibrating reward contributions. Based on this relation, we propose Density-Aware Reward Aggregation (DARA). We derive an inverse-square-root density correction that gives greater weight to signals from less frequently active rewards. DARA computes its weights from each rollout batch, adapting to changes in reward activity throughout training without modifying the underlying policy optimization objective. Experiments on tool calling and mathematical reasoning show that DARA learns the targeted behaviors faster than GDPO, reaching high format compliance in up to 26% fewer training steps on tool calling and near-saturated length compliance in up to 65% fewer steps on mathematical reasoning, while remaining competitive in final performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/zhaihaotian/DARA.

</details>


### [311] [Learning Transferable Skills using Goal-Conditioned Bisimulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00676)
*Mohammad Amin Abbasfar,Farbod Azimmohseni,Mohammad Hossein Rohban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种动作感知时序表征学习方法，结合双模拟度量实现无监督技能发现，使技能可跨不同布局迁移，具备较强的分布外泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无监督技能发现方法要么依赖专家数据，要么泛化能力有限，难以迁移到未见过的环境布局。核心挑战在于学习既能捕捉环境时序结构、又对布局变化稳健的表征。

Method: 提出一个学习动作感知时序表征的目标函数，满足功能等变性并保留环境局部时序结构；在该嵌入基础上，进一步提出基于双模拟（bisimulation）的无监督技能发现方法，将技能行为仅以其执行直接相关的状态特征子集为条件，从而强制跨布局行为不变。

Result: 通过全面的实证评估表明，在给定环境中习得的技能可有效应用于多种环境布局下的下游任务，展现出较强的分布外泛化能力。

Conclusion: 动作感知时序表征结合双模拟技能发现能够学习可迁移技能，实现跨布局的有效泛化。

Abstract: Unsupervised skill discovery has emerged as a promising approach for leveraging reward-free datasets to pretrain general-purpose policies. However, current skill discovery methods either require access to expert data or exhibit limited generalization, failing to transfer effectively to previously unseen layouts. A key challenge is to learn representations that capture the temporal structure of the environment while remaining robust to variations across layouts. To address this issue, we present an objective for learning action-aware temporal representations that satisfy the functional equivariance property while preserving the local temporal structure of the environment. Building upon this embedding, we further propose unsupervised skill discovery using bisimulation, which learns transferable skills by conditioning the behavior of skills exclusively on the subset of state features that directly affect their execution. This enforces invariant behavior across different layouts, enabling skills to transfer effectively to other configurations. Finally, through comprehensive empirical evaluations, we show that skills learned in a given environment can be effectively applied to solve downstream tasks in various environment layouts, demonstrating strong out-of-distribution generalization.

</details>


### [312] [From Task Mixtures to Specialized Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00580)
*Hojat Allah Salehi,Mehrdad Mahdavi,Andrew Arash Mahyari,M. Hadi Amini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究"复合异质性"下的联邦基础模型微调，提出FedSEE，将输入路由到任务专家，避免负迁移并提升整体及最差服务群体性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中客户端数据常是多种任务分布的未知混合，传统方法只处理客户端间异质性，忽略客户端内部的任务混合（复合异质性），导致单一本地模型无法兼顾不同任务输入，产生负迁移。

Method: 在共享冻结表示上做自适应：证明任务共享特征几何且损失为平方损失时，客户端任务混合的最优模型是各底层任务最优模型的凸组合；利用少量任务标注的公开样本，通过凸规划恢复任务专家并匹配到对应任务；据此提出FedSEE，采用与客户端任务混合对齐的输入依赖专家路由。

Result: 当任务最优模型构成单纯形时，任务对齐路由的风险低于任何单一自适应模型；实验中FedSEE避免了基线中的负迁移，整体性能提升2.9个点，最差服务四分位提升3.7个点。

Conclusion: 复合异质性下有效的专业化需要与客户端任务混合对齐的输入依赖专家选择，FedSEE验证了该路由分析的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: In collaborative foundation model fine-tuning, client data is rarely homogeneous. Instead, clients typically possess unknown mixtures of distinct data distributions, or tasks. Conventional federated learning primarily addresses heterogeneity across clients without explicitly resolving latent task mixtures within each client. We study this setting as compound heterogeneity, where data is heterogeneous both across and within clients. We study adaptation over a common frozen representation and show that, when tasks share the same feature geometry, the optimal model for a client's task mixture under squared loss is a convex combination of the optimal models for its underlying tasks. Thus, a single locally trained model represents the client's overall task mixture, while individual inputs may be drawn from different underlying task distributions. This motivates routing inputs to specialized experts, and we show that, when the task optima form a simplex, task-aligned routing achieves lower risk than any single adapted model for genuinely mixed clients. With access to a small set of task-labeled public samples, we derive a convex program to recover task experts and match them to their corresponding tasks. Our routing analysis shows that effective specialization requires input-dependent expert selection aligned with each client's task mixture. Motivated by this analysis, we propose FedSEE. Across our experiments, FedSEE avoids the negative transfer observed in the evaluated baselines and improves performance by 2.9 points overall and 3.7 points for the worst-served quartile.

</details>


### [313] [Reward as Observation: Learning Reward-Based Policies for Rapid Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00729)
*Morgan Byrd,Maks Sorokin,Robert Wright,Sehoon Ha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种仅以奖励和动作为条件的策略，实现观察空间完全不同的源与目标环境之间的零样本迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络策略难以适应新环境，通常需要大量样本才能完成迁移，而人类却能展现出强大的适应能力。本文希望在源与目标环境观察空间完全不同的情况下，实现零样本迁移。

Method: 提出一种新颖的基于奖励的策略，其输入仅包含奖励与动作，不依赖观察信息。文中讨论了基于奖励策略的挑战与可行性，并给出了一个可实际训练的算法。

Result: 在 Pointmass、Cartpole 和 2D Car Racing 三种环境中训练该奖励策略，并零样本迁移到完全不同的观察形式，如不同配色、3D 渲染，或 Habitat-Sim 中的 Stretch 机器人导航任务。此外，该奖励策略还能进一步指导目标环境中基于观察的策略训练。

Conclusion: 基于奖励的策略能够在观察空间完全不同的环境间实现零样本迁移，并可作为辅助信号帮助目标环境中基于观察的策略学习。

Abstract: This paper explores a reward-based policy to achieve zero-shot transfer between source and target environments with completely different observation spaces. While humans can demonstrate impressive adaptation capabilities, deep neural network policies often struggle to adapt to a new environment and require a considerable amount of samples for successful transfer. Instead, we propose a novel reward-based policy only conditioned on rewards and actions, enabling zero-shot adaptation to new environments with completely different observations. We discuss the challenges and feasibility of a reward-based policy and then propose a practical algorithm for training. We demonstrate that a reward policy can be trained within three different environments, Pointmass, Cartpole, and 2D Car Racing, and transferred to completely different observations, such as different color palettes or 3D rendering, or Stretch robot navigation in Habitat-Sim, in a zero-shot manner. We also demonstrate that a reward-based policy can further guide the training of an observation-based policy in the target environment.

</details>


### [314] [Right In-Place (RiP) Convolution: A Simple, General, and Near-Optimal Strategy for Memory-Efficient CNN Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00586)
*Opegbemi Matthias Busoye,Tolulope Matthew Busoye,Eghonghon-aye Eigbe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文修正了现有内存最优直接原地卷积闭合公式的两类错误，并提出Right In-Place (RiP)卷积，将适用范围推广到任意步长、膨胀、填充和矩形核，在保持位一致性的同时平均节省24.8%内存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活内存（而非计算）是CNN在微控制器等受限硬件上推理的主要瓶颈。直接原地卷积可消除双缓冲开销，但已有的内存最优公式假设有效填充、单位步长、单位膨胀和奇数方核，且非顺序遍历会带来约2倍推理时间开销，因此需要更通用且更实用的方案。

Method: 首先指出并修正原闭合公式的两类错误：一是欠分配恰好(k-1)C_in mod (C_out-C_in)个标量，导致对仍在使用的输入静默破坏；二是当关键段超出输出网格时产生最多2432倍的高估。随后将公式推广到任意步长、膨胀、填充和矩形核。进而提出RiP卷积：每层在共享工作区中右对齐读入输入、从索引0左对齐写出输出，债务是输出像素索引的分段仿射函数，通过O(1)求断点得到最小安全间距，同时保持行主序访问。

Result: 在10000个随机层上RiP未产生破坏；在来自25种架构的84个卷积层中，58个与herringbone工作区完全一致，81个误差在5%以内，平均比双缓冲少用24.8%内存。写入TinyEngine内核并部署到Raspberry Pi Pico 1和Pico 2后，在十一个MCUNet模型上将峰值激活内存降低12.5%至33.3%，周期数不变且输出位一致，使可装入Pico 1 256 KB SRAM的模型数从6个增加到9个。

Conclusion: RiP卷积在保持行主序遍历、周期数和输出位一致性的前提下显著降低峰值激活内存，适用于任意卷积参数，扩大了微控制器上可部署的模型范围。

Abstract: Activation memory, not compute, limits CNN inference on constrained hardware such as microcontrollers. Direct in-place convolution removes the dual-buffer cost, but the memory-optimal formulation of Gural and Murmann assumes valid padding, unit stride, unit dilation, and odd square kernels, and needs a non-sequential traversal costing $2\times$ inference time in transposes. We identify two regimes in which their published closed form does not hold: (1) an under-allocation of exactly $(k-1)C_{in} \bmod (C_{out}-C_{in})$ scalars, active on every convolutional layer of their own deployed network and manifesting as a silent corruption of still-live input; (2) an unbounded overestimate, up to $2{,}432\times$, once the critical leg leaves the output grid. We correct both and generalize to arbitrary stride, dilation, padding, and rectangular kernels. We then propose Right In-Place (RiP) convolution, a bit-identical operation in which every layer reads its input right-aligned in a shared workspace and writes its output left-aligned from index zero. The debt is piecewise affine in the output pixel index, so evaluating its breakpoints in $O(1)$ yields the minimum safe gap without enumerating the output grid, with row-major access preserved. Across $10{,}000$ random layers RiP produced no corruption, and across 84 convolutional layers from 25 architectures it matches the herringbone workspace exactly on 58 and within 5% on 81, using 24.8% less memory than dual buffering on average. Written into TinyEngine's kernels and deployed to a Raspberry Pi Pico 1 and Pico 2, it cuts peak activation memory across eleven MCUNet models by 12.5 to 33.3% at unchanged cycle counts and bit-identical outputs, raising the number of models that fit the Pico 1's 256 KB SRAM from six to nine.

</details>


### [315] [ALER: Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting for Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00592)
*Oleg Shchendrigin,Egor Cherepanov,Aleksandr I. Panov,Alexey K. Kovalev*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出记忆的两个新要求——重写与经验融合，构建相应任务与Rune-Mazes环境，并提出带槽记忆的ALER智能体，在多项任务上取得最高成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RL的记忆架构与基准主要测试"保持"能力，即信息在需要前保持不变。但部分可观测RL中，后续观测可能使已存信息过时或改变其含义，因此需要形式化重写与经验融合两种新要求。

Method: 提出ALER（自适应可学习经验重写），结合LSTM与槽记忆；使用独立寻址的Gumbel-Softmax写入将权重集中于单一槽以实现覆盖，并用学习门控在策略与价值头之前融合检索内容与循环状态。同时构建Rune-Mazes三个环境。

Result: 在十六个Endless T-Maze配置中ALER成功率至少0.82；在五个Rune T-Maze组合中至少0.99；在四分支Rune Multi-Corridor（含Invert符文）上平均成功率最高；在像素Rune MiniGrid Memory中十个配置有八个优于PPO-LSTM。

Conclusion: ALER通过槽记忆重写与门控融合机制有效应对需要重写和经验融合的记忆任务，优于七个基线方法。

Abstract: In partially observable reinforcement learning (RL), a later observation can make stored information obsolete or change what it implies for the next decision. Memory architectures and benchmarks for RL mostly test retention, the ability to keep information unchanged until it is needed. We formalize two further requirements. Rewriting sets the decision-relevant content to a value independent of the old one, and experience fusion transforms the old content by a rule that a later observation specifies. For tasks built from such updates, we count the memory states that a solution needs, and several baselines reach their lowest success rates on compositions that need more states. We introduce ALER (Adaptive Learnable Experience Rewriting), an agent that pairs an LSTM with a slot memory. An independently addressed Gumbel-Softmax write that concentrates its weight on one slot overwrites that slot, and a learned gate fuses the retrieved content with the recurrent state before the policy and value heads. We also introduce Rune-Mazes, three environments in which rune observations invert, cancel, reset, or repeat updates of a hidden cue under vector and pixel observations. Against seven baselines, ALER reaches a success rate of at least $0.82$ in all sixteen Endless T-Maze configurations and at least $0.99$ on all five Rune T-Maze compositions, and it has the highest mean success rate on four-branch Rune Multi-Corridor with an Invert rune. On pixel-based Rune MiniGrid Memory, it has a higher mean success rate than PPO-LSTM in eight of ten configurations. Project page: https://quartz-admirer.github.io/ALER-Adaptive-Learnable-Experience-Rewriting/.

</details>


### [316] [In CEM, a World Model Is Also a Proposal Mechanism](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00921)
*Oliver Obst,Frieder Stolzenburg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究将世界模型在CEM中的作用拆分为"当前决策打分"与"影响后续候选分布"两个角色，并用四种预测模型在Walker和Cheetah任务上分别评估，发现提案分布持续收缩、打分排序一致性接近随机，且用环境排序替换首次模型排序更新可降低最终代价。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CEM依赖世界模型分数来选择动作序列并拟合下一轮迭代的采样分布，因此打分误差会同时影响当前决策和后续候选集合。作者希望厘清打分在这两个环节中的不同作用，检验模型打分是否真正带来有效引导。

Method: 用四类预测模型生成CEM轨迹，并让每个模型为每个已保存的候选池重新打分；同时在环境中执行相同候选以获得参考精英集与提案更新。在Walker和Cheetah上运行十二个独立训练的任务-种子单元，比较提案分布距离、提案宽度、拟合均值分离度、成对排序一致性与精英集一致性。随后基于前六个单元选择Random nonlinear进行单次更新干预，将首次模型排序更新替换为环境排序更新，并在留出的六个单元上验证。

Result: 在全部十二个单元中，预定的提案距离均从第一次到最终CEM迭代下降；提案宽度收缩，拟合均值相对于剩余搜索宽度出现分离。成对排序一致性在Walker上接近随机水平，在Cheetah上下降，精英集一致性没有改善。Cheetah上打分器之间的差异大于候选池来源之间的差异，Walker上两者及其配对均有差异。将首次模型排序更新替换为环境排序更新后，前六个单元与留出的六个单元的最终已选序列代价均降低。

Conclusion: CEM中世界模型打分的引导作用有限：提案分布收缩与均值分离更多源于迭代机制本身，而非模型排序的有效区分能力。用环境排序替代模型排序的首次更新可稳定降低最终代价，提示模型打分的早期偏置是性能损失的重要来源。

Abstract: The cross-entropy method (CEM) uses world-model scores to select action sequences and fit the distribution sampled in its next iteration. A scoring error can therefore change both the present decision and the candidates considered later. We evaluate these two roles separately. Four types of predictive model generate CEM traces, and every model rescores every saved candidate pool. Executing the same candidates in the environment provides a reference elite set and proposal update.
  Across twelve independently trained task-seed units on Walker and Cheetah, the pre-specified proposal distance falls from the first to the final CEM iteration in every unit. Proposal widths contract and fitted means separate relative to the remaining search width. Pairwise ranking agreement stays near chance on Walker and declines on Cheetah; elite-set agreement does not improve. This comparison shows greater variation between scorers than between pool sources on Cheetah; Walker has variation in both and in their pairings. We use the original six units to select Random nonlinear for a one-update intervention, without inspecting intervention outcomes. Replacing its first model-ranked update with an environment-ranked update lowers final realised selected-sequence cost in those six units and in six further units held out from the selection.

</details>


### [317] [Learning the identity: a case study of how SGD selects among functional decompositions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00615)
*Andy Arditi,Weian Xie,David Bau,Liu Ziyin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文以深度线性残差网络学习恒等函数为案例，揭示SGD在总体损失无法区分的解流形上偏好特定解（甚至不收敛到零权重解）的现象，并用熵损失（entropic loss）框架给出解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习恒等函数看似平凡——残差连接本身即实现恒等，权重置零即可。然而存在整个极小化解流形，总体损失无法区分这些解，但SGD会可复现地偏好某些解（如各向异性标签噪声下学习层呈现依赖噪声的谱，且权重衰减也不能恢复零权重解）。作者希望澄清SGD为何偏好同一输入输出函数的特定分解。

Method: 采用熵损失的视角，即在总体损失上加入与minibatch梯度期望平方范数成正比的项。在恒等流形上总体损失为常数，熵项则用于区分不同分解。作者对熵项的极小化解进行解析刻画，并据此推导SGD偏好解结构的预测；同时对比仅改变参数化（将每个权重矩阵分解为两矩阵乘积）的情形。

Result: 在恒等流形上解析刻画了熵损失极小化解并给出对SGD解结构的预测，实验表明SGD训练结果与预测高度吻合。仅改变参数化（权重矩阵因子化）而保持可实现函数不变，会使权重坍缩为零，即使不使用显式权重衰减。

Conclusion: 恒等学习任务是一个干净、简单的案例，说明熵损失视角如何澄清SGD为何偏好同一输入输出函数的不同分解；参数化方式即便不改变可实现函数集合，也会显著改变SGD的偏好行为。

Abstract: One might think that learning the identity function with a deep linear residual network is trivial - the path along residual connections already implements the identity, and so the network need only drive its weights to zero. However, this zero-weight solution is just one point on an entire manifold of population-loss minimizers, each corresponding to a different decomposition of the identity across the network's layers. Although the population loss does not distinguish among these solutions, stochastic gradient descent (SGD) reproducibly favors particular ones. For instance, under anisotropic label noise, the learned layers exhibit a noise-dependent spectrum; even with weight decay, SGD does not generally recover the zero-weight solution. Changing only the parametrization, while leaving the set of realizable functions unchanged, yields different behavior: factoring each weight matrix as a product of two matrices causes the weights to collapse to zero, even without explicit weight decay.
  While perhaps mysterious and unintuitive at first, these phenomena can be understood through the lens of entropic loss, which augments the population loss with a term proportional to the expected squared norm of the minibatch gradient (Ziyin et al., 2025). On the identity manifold, the population loss is constant, while the entropic term distinguishes among these decompositions. We characterize its minimizers analytically and use them to derive predictions for the structure of solutions favored by SGD. Networks trained with SGD closely match these predictions.
  Overall, the identity learning task studied here serves as a clean and simple case study of how the lens of entropic loss can clarify why SGD favors particular decompositions of the same input-output function.

</details>


### [318] [Misalignment of Low-Loss Regions Causes Grokking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00620)
*Yongding Tian,Zaid Al-Ars,Maksim Kitsak,Peter Hofstee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于模式连通性和低损失区域几何的分析框架，揭示grokking产生的条件，并发现一个稳定的反grokking反例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: grokking（训练集已过拟合后验证集泛化延迟出现）的底层机制尚未明确，已有相关性解释存在不足，需要从低损失区域几何角度给出更本质的刻画。

Method: 构建基于模式连通性和低损失区域几何的分析框架，并在标准模算术设定下采用保对称性的训练/验证划分进行实验。

Result: 在保对称性划分下观察到稳定的反grokking情形，验证性能不再恢复；该反例挑战了若干既有grokking相关性解释。

Conclusion: grokking产生于训练与验证划分诱导的低损失区域错位时；一旦这些区域良好对齐，仅靠训练超参数无法产生grokking，动力学坍缩为可训练或不可训练行为。

Abstract: Grokking refers to the delayed emergence of validation-set generalization after a model has already overfit the training set. Although first observed in small algorithmic tasks trained with transformers, its underlying mechanism remains unsettled. In this work, we develop an analysis framework based on mode connectivity and the geometry of low-loss regions. The framework predicts that the standard modular-arithmetic setting does not always produce grokking: under a symmetry-preserving train/validation split, we observe a stable anti-grokking case in which validation performance does not recover. This counterexample challenges several existing correlational explanations of grokking. More broadly, our analysis framework and results further suggest that grokking arises when the low-loss regions induced by the training and validation partitions are misaligned. Once these regions become well aligned, training hyperparameters alone cannot produce grokking and the observed dynamics collapse to either trainable or non-trainable behavior.

</details>


### [319] [Supervise What Decides Success: Criterion-Aligned Auxiliary Losses for Latent World-Model Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01224)
*Takumi Hara,Kanata Suzuki*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种辅助损失，将成功判据量作为训练目标，让潜世界模型的潜状态更好地编码成功判据量，从而提升规划成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜世界模型通过潜空间距离对候选动作序列打分来规划，但任务成功与否由物理量（成功判据量）决定。作者检查的四个潜世界模型中，末端执行器位置的潜编码误差都大于成功判据所允许的范围，导致潜状态无法区分成功与失败的候选动作。

Method: 在编码器和预测器输出上接一个线性头回归成功判据量，将回归误差加入训练损失（即把成功判据量从仅作输入变为训练目标），训练后丢弃该头，因此测试时模型、代价与输入均不变。

Result: 仅加入该损失即在PushT和cube任务上分别带来3.5%和3.4%（绝对值）的成功率提升，且两项提升均具有统计显著性。

Conclusion: 成功判据规定了世界模型必须在潜状态中保留什么信息，并且可以直接作为训练目标使用。

Abstract: Latent world models plan by scoring candidate action sequences with distances in latent space. However, task success is judged by physical quantities, which we call the success-criterion quantities. In all four latent world models we examine, the end-effector position is encoded in the latent state with an error larger than the success criterion allows. Such a latent state cannot separate successful candidates from failing ones. We propose an auxiliary loss that uses success-criterion quantities as training targets, whereas existing latent world models take them only as inputs. During training, a linear head on the encoder and predictor outputs regresses the success-criterion quantities, and the regression error is added to the training loss. The head is discarded after training, so the model, its cost, and its inputs at test time are unchanged. This loss alone improves the success rate on PushT and cube by 3.5% and 3.4% (absolute), respectively, and both improvements are statistically significant. A success criterion thus specifies what a world model must retain in its latent state, and we show that it can serve directly as a training target.

</details>


### [320] [Learning Linear Systems under Heavy-Tailed Noise: A Non-Asymptotic Analysis from A Single Trajectory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00637)
*Xiaomian Yang,Sungho Shin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文针对指数稳定向量自回归模型，在重尾噪声下给出了基于单条轨迹的最小二乘估计的非渐近样本复杂度界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统样本复杂度分析多依赖轻尾噪声假设，而实际系统常受重尾噪声影响。作者希望在仅观测单条轨迹、噪声仅具有限p阶矩的条件下建立估计误差界，并统一处理多种噪声分布。

Method: 假设噪声独立同分布、噪声协方差有界且满足持续激励条件，基于最小二乘估计推导非渐近误差界；提出统一的分析框架，并推广至次指数与次高斯噪声分布，进一步特化到带外生输入的ARX模型。

Result: 在噪声具有有界p阶矩（p>2）时，估计误差为Õ(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})，其中T为样本数、r为噪声维度；该框架可导出次指数和次高斯噪声的误差界；在ARX模型中误差界的维度因子与模型阶数无关。

Conclusion: 论文为指数稳定VAR模型在重尾噪声下的最小二乘估计提供了非渐近样本复杂度保证，并提出可统一处理多种噪声分布的分析方法，同时表明ARX模型的误差维度因子不受模型阶数影响。

Abstract: We establish non-asymptotic sample complexity bounds for the least-squares estimation of vector autoregressive models for exponentially stable systems with heavy-tailed noise based on a single observed trajectory. By assuming i.i.d. noise, bounded noise covariance, and persistent excitation, we show that the estimation error is $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(r^{1/2}T^{-1/2+1/p})$ under bounded $p$th moment for $p > 2$, where $T$ is the number of samples, $r$ is the noise dimension, and $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\cdot)$ hides logarithmic terms. We also introduce a unifying approach to sample complexity analysis applicable to broad classes of noise distributions and showcase this by deriving error bounds for sub-exponential and sub-Gaussian noise distributions. Finally, we specialize our analysis to autoregressive models with exogenous inputs and show that the dimension factor of the error bound is independent of the model order.

</details>


### [321] [Group-Invariant Statistics Determine Embedding Geometry: Harmonic Analysis of Representations from Bach to the Night Sky](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00647)
*Liam Storan,Andreas Tolias,Nina Miolane*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明：当词族共现统计在任意有限群、紧群或齐性空间下不变时，学习到的词嵌入由该群不可约表示的矩阵元构成；循环群给出傅里叶模（圆/薯片形），并用月份、音乐和弦、天体三个实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前工作将月份、星期等概念的圆形与"薯片形"（Pringle）几何结构追溯到阿贝尔格点上距离依赖的平移对称性。作者希望说明这种结构并非平移对称性独有，而是更一般的群对称性（有限群、紧群、齐性空间）的自然结果。

Method: 理论推导：对任意群G，若某词族的共现统计在G作用下不变，则学习到的词嵌入由G的不可约表示的矩阵元张成；当G为循环群时，不可约表示即傅里叶模，对应圆与Pringle几何。实验验证三个场景：(i) 循环群Z12下月份；（ii）作用于大/小三和弦的二面体群，将乐理中移调与和弦转位构成的T/I群与机器学习中"五度圈"嵌入相统一；(iii) 将大语言模型中天体的球面表示解释并复现为源自该理论的球谐嵌入。

Result: (i) 在Z12下复现月份已知的圆形几何；(ii) 由T/I群的作用推出并验证和弦嵌入中"五度圈"的出现；(iii) 解释并复现了LLM中天体的球谐表示。

Conclusion: 学习到的表示几何常常是底层数据统计对称性的必然结果，而非偶然现象；平移对称性只是更一般群对称性框架的特例。

Abstract: The representations that language models learn for concepts such as months, weekdays, and places display consistent geometric structure: circles and saddle-shaped "Pringle" manifolds. Recent work traced these structures to $\textit{translation symmetry}$ in word co-occurrence statistics, deriving the observed Fourier geometry when co-occurrence depends only on distance on an abelian lattice of concepts. We demonstrate that more general notions of symmetry lead to equally structured predictions. Considering symmetries defined by arbitrary finite groups, compact groups, and homogeneous spaces, we prove that whenever the co-occurrence statistics of a word family are invariant under a group $G$, the learned word embeddings consist of matrix elements of the irreducible representations (irreps) of $G$. Circles and Pringles arise when $G$ is cyclic, in which case the irreps are Fourier modes. We verify the irrep structure in three experimental settings. (i) The cyclic group $\mathbb{Z}_{12}$: for the months of the year we recover the known circular geometry. (ii) A dihedral group acting on the major and minor triads: we unify two classical observations -- that transposition and chord inversion form a group ($T/I$) acting on chords (music theory), which $\textit{implies}$ that the well-known "circle of fifths" emerges in learned chord embeddings (machine learning). (iii) We explain and reproduce a recently discovered spherical representation of celestial objects in large language models (LLMs) as a spherical-harmonic embedding derived from our theory. Our results demonstrate that the geometry of learned representations is often a consequence of the statistical symmetry of underlying data.

</details>


### [322] [Exploring More, Reasoning Better: Stepwise Risk-Sensitive GRPO for Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00661)
*Yue YU,Bowen Zuo,David Crandall,Yinglun Zhu,Dongruo Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 StepRS-GRPO，一种在扩散大语言模型去噪过程中随状态变化调整风险系数的强化学习方法，在数学推理任务上同时提升准确率、覆盖度和答案多样性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）通过去噪序列或连续块来并行生成多个 token，其每一步决策的 conditioning context 都在变化。RLVR 在这些决策间复用终端反馈，因此固定的组优势变换可能并不适配不同去噪状态。论文希望针对这一特性设计更合适的强化学习训练方式。

Method: 提出 Stepwise Risk-sensitive GRPO（StepRS-GRPO），在保留原有训练器的基础上，让 group-advantage transformation 的风险系数随去噪状态变化。作者在二值奖励下证明该变换等价于对中心化 outcome advantages 的 prompt- 与 state- 相关重缩放；并用 capability-based calibration 给出系数尺度，通过端点与插值消融选择 schedule。

Result: 在多个 dLLM 骨干网络和数学推理基准上，StepRS-GRPO 相比 centered GRPO 提升了 pass@1 准确率与 pass@k 覆盖度，同时增加了答案多样性。消融实验中的 mass-matched 控制支持状态分配与 schedule 方向的作用；在将优势 RMS 匹配到 centered GRPO 后增益依然存在。推理轨迹诊断显示多样性增益不止于最终答案字符串。

Conclusion: StepRS-GRPO 通过状态相关的风险敏感优势变换，为扩散大语言模型的 verifiable-reward 强化学习提供了一种有效改进，在准确性、覆盖度和多样性上均优于 centered GRPO，且消融与诊断验证了其关键设计要素。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by denoising a sequence or successive blocks, allowing several tokens to be revealed in parallel. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) reuses terminal feedback across these decisions, even as their conditioning context changes. We propose stepwise risk-sensitive GRPO (StepRS-GRPO), which varies the risk coefficient of the group-advantage transformation across denoising states while retaining the underlying trainer. For binary rewards, we show that this transformation is exactly a prompt- and state-dependent rescaling of centered outcome advantages. A capability-based calibration suggests a coefficient scale, while endpoint and interpolation ablations guide schedule selection. Across multiple dLLM backbones and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, StepRS-GRPO improves both pass@1 accuracy and pass@k coverage over centered GRPO, while increasing answer diversity. In our ablation studies, mass-matched controls support the contributions of state allocation and schedule direction, and the gains persist after matching the root mean square (RMS) of the advantages to that of centered GRPO. Reasoning-trace diagnostics further show that the diversity gains from StepRS-GRPO extend beyond final-answer strings.

</details>


### [323] [Analysis of Quantized and Efficiently Adapted Protein Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00665)
*Ilan Yaniv Zeisler,Sebastian Clancy,Pouriya Bayat,Saaim Raad,Ivan Kraskov,Matthew Xie,Vivian White,Spencer Perkins,Serena Singh,Sepehr Bayat,Keith Pardee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究报告了4比特量化与QLoRA微调在多种蛋白质语言模型上的系统评估，发现多数任务能保留超过90%全量微调性能，显存节省可达90%，并提出将QLoRA作为内存受限场景下的首选适配策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质语言模型规模庞大，微调与部署成本高昂；量化与参数高效微调对性能、表征和生成的影响尚未被充分刻画。

Method: 在ESM-2、ESMC、ProtBERT、ProtT5、Ankh、Ankh3、Profluent-E1等模型上评估4比特量化与低秩适配器微调（QLoRA）；对ProLLaMA、ProtGPT2、ProGen2、ProteinGLM、ESM3等模型进行无条件生成测试，结合结构与序列指标及token级分布分析。

Result: 多个模型-任务组合保留超过90%全量微调性能，最大模型显存节省接近90%；QLoRA常保留浅层表征并在中后层产生任务特异性适配；生成任务中4比特量化基本保持结构与序列性质，但token级分析显示自回归输出分布存在模型相关偏移。训练速度与能耗效应差异较大。

Conclusion: QLoRA与4比特量化可显著降低蛋白质语言模型的计算需求，尤其显存占用；建议将QLoRA作为内存受限适配的首选方案，将全量微调留给困难任务、不稳定架构或验证恢复较低的情形；生成模型评估需在序列与结构指标之外补充分布分析。该方法可扩大大规模蛋白质建模的可及性，但需针对模型与任务进行验证。

Abstract: Background: Protein language models (PLMs) are increasingly used for sequence generation and property prediction, but their size makes fine-tuning and deployment expensive. The effects of quantization and parameter efficient fine-tuning on performance, representations and generation remain insufficiently characterized. Results: We evaluated 4-bit quantization and low-rank adapter fine-tuning (QLoRA) across ESM-2, ESMC, ProtBERT, ProtT5, Ankh, Ankh3 and Profluent-E1. Across protein prediction tasks, many model-task pairs retained more than 90% of full fine-tuning performance. Peak GPU memory savings approached 90% for the largest models, although performance and efficiency varied by model, dataset and training configuration. QLoRA often preserved early-layer representations while inducing task-specific adaptations in middle and late layers, resembling full fine-tuning with smaller representational changes. Training speed and power effects were more varied. For unconditional generation with ProLLaMA, ProtGPT2, ProGen2, ProteinGLM and ESM3, 4-bit quantization largely preserved predicted structural and sequence-level properties, but token-level analysis revealed model-dependent shifts in autoregressive output distributions. Conclusion: QLoRA and 4-bit quantization reduce PLM computational requirements, particularly GPU memory usage. Our results support QLoRA as a first-pass strategy for memory limited adaptation, reserving full fine-tuning for challenging tasks, unstable architectures or low validation recovery. For generative PLMs, sequence-level and structural metrics should be complemented with distributional analysis, since downstream predictions alone may miss quantization-induced shifts. These approaches can broaden access to large-scale protein modelling while requiring model- and task-specific validation.

</details>


### [324] [ORBIT-FMIB: Tracking Order-Resolved Epistatic Information Through ESM-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00672)
*Maryam Rahimimovassagh,Ivan Garibay,Niloofar Yousefi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出ORBIT-FMIB诊断框架，检验ESM-2表征中不同阶上位性信息的保留程度，但重复实验后未能获得稳健证据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蛋白质基础模型虽能支持突变效应与结构预测，但仅凭预测性能无法揭示模型不同深度层次中保留何种生物相互作用信息。作者希望探究ESM-2是否在其表征层级中同等地保留高阶上位性信息，还是高阶信息随阶数升高而选择性衰减。

Method: 提出ORBIT-FMIB诊断框架，将基于Walsh的相互作用分解与子集条件化的神经常依赖性估计相结合。先在已知相互作用结构的合成适应度景观上验证方法，再应用于四站点密集GB1适应度景观，使用冻结的ESM-2表征进行测量，并做完整测量网格的独立重复（匹配GPU硬件与相同critic随机种子）。

Result: 初次生产运行显示ESM-2对高阶上位性信息的保留弱于低阶信息（Δ_HO-LO = -0.107）。在匹配硬件与相同critic种子下对完整测量网格进行独立重复后，该差异大幅缩小（Δ_HO-LO = -0.017），且在同一批已训练critics上采用其他合理评估配对方案时符号不稳定（-0.011至+0.015）。因此目前没有稳健证据表明ESM-2选择性地丢失高阶上位性信息，也无法断言各阶保留程度相等。

Conclusion: 方向性问题仍然开放。测量协议本身（包括对池化critic中位置子集捷径的记录性移除）依然有效，不受此发现影响。ORBIT-FMIB可作为探测蛋白质基础模型交互结构的诊断框架；本研究自身的重复结果说明，此类探测在把输出当作生物学发现之前，需要具有充分统计效力的可重复性检验。

Abstract: Protein foundation models support mutation-effect and structural prediction, but predictive performance alone does not reveal which forms of biological interaction information remain accessible through model depth. We ask whether ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information as strongly as first- and second-order information across its representation hierarchy, introducing ORBIT-FMIB, a diagnostic framework combining Walsh-based interaction decomposition with subset-conditioned neural dependence estimation. The method is validated on synthetic landscapes with known interaction structure before being applied to the dense four-site GB1 fitness landscape using frozen ESM-2 representations.
  An initial production run suggested ESM-2 retains higher-order epistatic information less well than lower-order information ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.107$). An independent replication of the complete measurement grid, under matched GPU hardware and identical critic seeds, substantially reduced this contrast ($Δ_{\mathrm{HO-LO}}=-0.017$), and its sign was unstable across otherwise-defensible evaluation-pairing choices applied to the same trained critics ($-0.011$ to $+0.015$). We therefore do not currently have robust evidence that ESM-2 selectively loses higher-order epistatic information, nor that retention is equal across orders; the directional question remains open. The measurement protocol itself, including its documented removal of a positional-subset shortcut in pooled critics, remains validated and is unaffected by this finding. ORBIT-FMIB is offered as a diagnostic framework for probing interaction structure in protein foundation models; this study's own replication result illustrates why such probing requires adequately-powered reproducibility checks before its output is treated as a biological finding.

</details>


### [325] [LabBook: Harnessing Experimental History for Efficient LLM-Driven Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00675)
*Bo Yuan,Wenqian Ye,Zelin Zhao,Lama Moukheiber,Henry Kautz,Aidong Zhang,Yongxin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LabBook——一种由智能体维护的记忆机制，用于LLM驱动的科学发现，兼顾完整实验历史保留与选择性上下文构建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 进化式LLM发现方法通常从少量被选祖先生成新程序，上下文可控但会遗漏其他实验的有用证据；而纳入完整历史又会导致上下文冗长冗余。需要在保留完整历史与构建简洁上下文之间取得平衡。

Method: 构建一个简单的单智能体发现框架，核心是LabBook——智能体维护的记忆，起两种互补作用：从完整实验日志中引导相关证据检索，并指导新方案生成。每次迭代，同一智能体结合记忆与检索到的证据，联合产出下一个程序和更新后的LabBook，无需显式种群或分支搜索结构。

Result: 在49个Frontier-CS问题上，LabBook在两种骨干模型下相较所评估的进化基线改善了质量-成本权衡；在另外九项数学、系统与启发式设计任务上也保持竞争力。

Conclusion: LabBook通过将完整历史保留与选择性上下文构建分离，无需种群或分支搜索即可提升LLM驱动发现的质量-成本权衡，具有较好的通用性。代码将开源。

Abstract: Evolutionary approaches to LLM-driven discovery often generate new programs from a small set of selected ancestors. This keeps contexts manageable but can omit useful evidence from other experiments, whereas including the full experimental history produces long, redundant contexts. We introduce a simple, single-agent discovery harness built around LabBook, an agent-maintained memory that serves two complementary roles: guiding retrieval of relevant evidence from a complete experimental log and informing the generation of new solutions. At each iteration, the same agent combines its memory with retrieved evidence and jointly produces the next program and an updated LabBook. This separates complete history retention from selective context construction, without requiring an explicit population or branching search structure. On 49 Frontier-CS problems, LabBook improves the observed quality-cost trade-off over the evaluated evolutionary baselines with two backbones, while remaining competitive across nine additional mathematical, systems, and heuristic-design tasks. Code will be released at https://github.com/BoYuanVisionary/LabBook.

</details>


### [326] [FERPO: Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02198)
*Sebastian Sanokowski,Alireza Sarmadi,Majid Khadiv*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FERPO：一种策略改进用critic值而非critic动作梯度的在线最大熵强化学习算法，在MuJoCo Playground与ManiSkill上取得有竞争力且样本效率更优的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有连续控制在线强化学习多依赖学习到的critic的动作梯度来改进策略，但critic通常以预测回报为目标训练，准确的价值预测并不保证准确的动作导数，可能导致策略更新不可靠。因此需要一种不依赖critic对动作求导的策略改进方法。

Method: FERPO是一种在线（on-policy）最大熵强化学习算法。它从带熵与KL散度正则化的策略改进目标中推导出最优目标动作分布；随后用在rollout策略上采样动作、经自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）估计的前向KL目标，将actor拟合到该目标分布。KL正则限制目标分布偏离rollout策略，使重要性权重保持良好性质。

Result: 在MuJoCo Playground和ManiSkill上的实验与消融显示，FERPO性能具有竞争力并带来样本效率提升；计算基准测试表明其actor更新速度快于REPPO。相比反向KL目标（可能只偏好目标分布的少数模态），前向KL鼓励覆盖多个高价值模态，从而促进探索。

Conclusion: 通过用critic值而非critic梯度进行策略改进，并结合熵与KL正则化的前向KL拟合，FERPO在保证重要性权重稳定的同时提升了探索能力、样本效率与更新效率，为连续控制中的最大熵在线强化学习提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Several state-of-the-art methods for online reinforcement learning in continuous control improve policies using action gradients of a learned critic. However, critics are typically trained to predict returns, and accurate value predictions do not necessarily yield accurate action derivatives, potentially leading to unreliable policy updates. We propose Forward Entropy-Regularized Policy Optimization (FERPO), an on-policy maximum entropy reinforcement learning algorithm that performs policy improvement using critic values without differentiating the critic with respect to actions. FERPO derives an optimal target action distribution from a policy-improvement objective regularized by entropy and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence. We then fit the actor to this target by minimizing a forward-KL objective, estimated using self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS) with actions drawn from the rollout policy. By limiting the target distribution's deviation from the rollout policy, the KL regularization helps keep these importance weights well behaved. In contrast to reverse-KL objectives, which can favor a subset of the target distribution's modes, the forward-KL objective encourages coverage of multiple high-value modes and thereby promotes exploration. Experiments and ablations on MuJoCo Playground and ManiSkill show competitive performance and sample-efficiency gains. Computational benchmarks also demonstrate faster actor updates than Relative Entropy Pathwise Policy Optimization (REPPO).

</details>


### [327] [Curvature Under Attack in hZACH-ViT: Gauge Symmetry, Boundary Saturation, and Adversarial Failure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00680)
*Athanasios Angelakis,Marta Gomez-Barrero*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过hZACH-ViT在多个MedMNIST数据集上比较欧氏、庞加莱与球面原型头的表现，发现曲率对干净识别与对抗鲁棒性的影响高度依赖坐标尺度与边界数值处理，并非内在属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 曲率常被视为表示的内在属性，但其经验效应还取决于坐标尺度、学习到的logit温度与数值保护措施。作者希望厘清曲率、尺度与庞加莱边界邻近性如何共同影响干净识别与对抗表示运动，避免将实现敏感的效应误读为"双曲鲁棒性"。

Method: 构建紧凑ViT模型hZACH-ViT，配备欧氏、庞加莱与球面三种原型头；在三个MedMNIST数据集、五个随机种子上匹配backbone架构、初始化、每类50样本训练子集与优化流程。在固定曲率c=1下评估类宏平均PGD攻击成功率及更强的CE+DLR多重重启攻击，并进行端到端曲率干预（庞加莱曲率降至c=0.1），结合硬裁剪比例、径向雅可比与无量纲攻击轨迹分析；球面头作为对照，其曲率变化在浮点精度上等价于精确尺度规范。

Result: 在c=1时，庞加莱头在全部12个数据集-预算单元中类宏PGD攻击成功率最低，并在三个数据集的CE+DLR多重重启攻击下同样最低，但其干净MacroF1也最低。将庞加莱曲率降至c=0.1后，15个配对种子-数据集比较中干净MacroF1全部提升并消除了硬边界裁剪，但在OrganAMNIST上强攻击成功率由89.7%升至99.3%（配对差+9.57点，95%分层bootstrap CI [+5.52,+14.03]）。c=1时40%-47%的干净庞加莱特征被硬裁剪，继承映射的径向雅可比接近零，攻击轨迹异常长且低效。球面头对照的曲率变化在浮点精度上为精确尺度规范，攻击差异小得多。

Conclusion: 结果并不支持"内在双曲鲁棒性"这一说法，而是揭示了一个实现敏感的区域：曲率、尺度与庞加莱边界邻近性共同组织干净识别与对抗表示运动。曲率效应无法脱离数值实现与坐标尺度单独解释。

Abstract: Curvature is often treated as an intrinsic property of a representation, although its empirical effect also depends on coordinate scale, learned logit temperature, and numerical safeguards. We study this interaction in hZACH-ViT, a compact Vision Transformer with Euclidean, Poincare, and spherical prototype heads. The backbone architecture, seed-specific initialization, 50-per-class training subset, and optimization protocol are matched across three MedMNIST datasets and five seeds. At the fixed comparison curvature $c=1$, Poincare has the lowest class-macro PGD attack-success rate in all 12 dataset-budget cells and under a stronger CE+DLR multi-restart attack on all three datasets, but it also has the lowest clean MacroF1. An end-to-end curvature intervention changes the interpretation. Reducing Poincare curvature to $c=0.1$ improves clean MacroF1 in every one of the 15 paired seed-dataset comparisons and removes hard boundary clipping, yet on OrganAMNIST it increases strong attack success from $89.7\%$ to $99.3\%$ (paired difference $+9.57$ points; 95\% hierarchical bootstrap CI $[+5.52,+14.03]$). At $c=1$, $40$-$47\%$ of clean Poincare features are hard-clipped, the radial Jacobian of the inherited map is nearly zero, and dimensionless attack trajectories are unusually long and inefficient. The spherical head provides a control: its curvature change is an exact scale gauge to floating-point precision and produces much smaller attack differences. These results do not establish intrinsic hyperbolic robustness. They identify an implementation-sensitive regime in which curvature, scale, and proximity to the Poincare boundary jointly organize clean recognition and adversarial representation motion.

</details>


### [328] [Grand Canonical Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00683)
*Andreas Burger,Malte Franke,Luka Mucko,Kjell Jorner,Alan Aspuru-Guzik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Grand Canonical Generators（GCG），将Boltzmann生成器扩展到巨正则系综，通过两种设计实现对粒子数和构型在化学势条件下的联合或分解采样，并在Lennard-Jones流体和甲烷吸附任务上验证了其准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Boltzmann生成器主要针对正则系综，难以处理粒子数可变、化学势驱动的巨正则系统（如吸附、相平衡等）。作者希望将生成式建模扩展到巨正则系综，以准确复现巨正则观测量并支持跨化学势泛化。

Method: 提出两种GCG设计：一是将可变尺寸生成模型以化学势为条件，联合采样粒子数与构型；二是将巨正则分布分解为粒子数分布与对应正则Boltzmann密度的乘积，可复用任意现有Boltzmann生成器，解析编码已知的化学势线性依赖，并提供可处理的似然以支持自归一化重要性采样（SNIS）。

Result: 在Lennard-Jones流体和沸石中甲烷吸附两个体系上，GCG能准确复现巨正则观测量，并展示出跨化学势的泛化能力，同时可通过SNIS和巨正则蒙特卡洛进行校正。

Conclusion: GCG为巨正则系综提供了有效且可扩展的生成式采样框架，兼具灵活性与可处理似然，为可变粒子数体系的生成建模与重要性采样校正提供了新途径。

Abstract: We introduce Grand Canonical Generators (GCG), a generative framework that extends Boltzmann generators to the grand canonical ensemble. We present two designs. The first conditions a variable-size generative model on the chemical potential, sampling particle number and configuration jointly. The second factorizes the grand canonical distribution into a particle-number distribution and the corresponding canonical Boltzmann density. This factorized formulation can use any existing Boltzmann generator for the canonical component, encodes the known linear chemical-potential dependence analytically, and yields a tractable likelihood that supports self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS). Empirically, GCG accurately reproduces grand canonical observables on a Lennard--Jones fluid and methane adsorption in a zeolite, demonstrating generalization across chemical potentials and correction via SNIS and grand canonical Monte Carlo.

</details>


### [329] [SkillSpec: Consensus-Gated Agent Skill Evolution via Representation Specialization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00704)
*Huancheng Chen,Xiaodi Sun,Zhaoqiong Huang,Shenyang Huang Shreya Singhal,Jingwen Lu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 SkillSpec 两阶段框架，通过共识门控演化与表示特化改进 LLM 智能体的自然语言技能优化，在六个基准和三个模型上平均成功率较 SkillOpt 提升 6.89%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法将自然语言技能视为静态产物或整体式文档，仅以聚合验证分数作为反馈优化文本内容，未显式建模程序性知识的检索与执行结构。作者区分了"保留什么知识"与"如何组织知识"两个问题，认为文本更新应先经执行证据验证，再依据程序依赖与检索需求进行结构化。

Method: SkillSpec 包含两个阶段：（1）共识门控演化，由互补的编辑意图生成完整的候选技能，仅当配对评估达成共识——即总体提升充分且每次重复评估的配对增益非负——才提交更新；（2）表示特化，从完整优化轨迹（含接受与拒绝的候选）中提取过程敏感性与冗余敏感性信号，指导选择扁平、图或混合表示。

Result: 在六个基准和三个目标语言模型上，SkillSpec 相较 SkillOpt 平均成功率提升 6.89%（三模型平均）。

Conclusion: 可靠的技能演化与表示特化解决了互补目标：决定保留哪些知识，以及如何为推理组织这些知识。

Abstract: Natural-language skills are textual procedural memories through which large language model (LLM) agents retain reusable task knowledge without updating model weights. Existing methods typically treat skills as either static artifacts or monolithic documents optimized using aggregate validation scores as feedback. However, representing a skill as a monolithic document restricts optimization to its textual content, without explicitly modeling the structure through which procedural knowledge is retrieved and executed. We identify a key distinction between learning what knowledge to retain and determining how to organize it: textual updates should first be validated through execution evidence, after which the retained knowledge should be structured according to its procedural dependencies and retrieval requirements. To this end, we introduce SkillSpec, a two-phase framework comprising consensus-gated evolution and representation specialization. In the consensus-gated phase, complementary editing intents generate complete candidate skills. An update is committed only when paired evaluations reach consensus, requiring sufficient overall improvement and non-negative aggregate paired gain in every repeated evaluation. In the specialization phase, signals of process and redundancy sensitivity derived from the full optimization trajectory, including accepted and rejected candidates, guide the selection of a flat, graph, or hybrid representation.Across six benchmarks and three target language models, SkillSpec improves average success rate over SkillOpt by 6.89%, averaged across the three models. These results demonstrate that reliable skill evolution and representation specialization address complementary objectives: deciding what knowledge to retain and how to structure it for inference.

</details>


### [330] [Initialization Improves LLM-Driven Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00707)
*Mansi Sakarvadia,Marco Ciccone,Colin Raffel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究利用LLM进行算法、定理、药物等发现任务中，迭代种群与最终发现成功率的关系。作者提出12种"Modular"框架，在5类发现任务上评测，发现发现成功对框架设计极其敏感，并普遍出现"模式崩塌"（迭代多样性骤降）。他们提出一种先并行探索、再迭代优化的初始化干预方法，在多种框架和应用上获得稳定提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作利用带"框架（harness）"的LLM迭代优化目标以发现新算法、定理、药物等，但人们尚不清楚上一次迭代种群（population of previous iterates）与最终发现成功之间的关系。作者希望厘清框架设计、种群多样性对发现成功率的影响机制，并找到普适、稳健的改进方法。

Method: 1）将以往关于框架设计的工作推广，构建包含12种框架的"Modular"套件；2）在5类多样化发现任务上系统评测其性能；3）分析迭代多样性与失败模式，识别出"模式崩塌"现象；4）检验当前先进框架及多样性诱导干预的效果；5）基于"早期发现性能可预测最终成功"这一发现，提出通用干预：先进行并行探索阶段，再初始化后续的迭代优化。

Result: 发现成功具有脆弱性，对框架设计高度敏感；模式崩塌（迭代多样性显著下降）是常见失败模式；当前流行的先进框架以及旨在延缓崩塌的多样性诱导干预收益不稳定；而早期发现的性能可预测最终成功。

Conclusion: 提出先并行探索、后迭代初始化的通用干预，在多种框架与目标应用中取得一致增益，证实初始化在LLM驱动发现中的关键作用。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been used for novel discovery of algorithms, theorems, drugs, and other tasks through the use of harnesses that prompt an LLM to iteratively optimize an objective. In this work, we study the relationship between the population of previous iterates and eventual discovery success. We generalize past work on harness design to develop a suite of 12 harnesses called 'Modular' and characterize their performance across 5 diverse discovery tasks, finding that discovery success is brittle and sensitive to harness design. We uncover mode collapse, characterized by a dramatic drop in the diversity of iterates, as a common failure mode. We find that popular state-of-the-art harnesses and diversity-inducing harness interventions, which aim to prolong this collapse, yield inconsistent gains. Our results instead uncover that the performance of early discoveries is predictive of eventual success. We therefore propose a universally applicable intervention that performs an initial stage of parallel exploration in order to initialize subsequent iterative optimization. Our method provides consistent gains across many harnesses and target applications, confirming the importance of initialization in LLM-driven discovery.

</details>


### [331] [Beyond Unimodal Bases: Pullback Geometry for Multimodal Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00708)
*Honglei Brinkmann,Lucas Ng,Georgios Batzolis,Mark Girolami,Carola-Bibiane Schönlieb,Willem Diepeveen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种支持多流形混合数据的拉回几何，用潜变量高斯混合定义黎曼度量，在归一化流中实例化，实现更优的高维数据插值与几何表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有可扩展拉回几何通常假设数据位于单一流形附近，使用单峰高斯潜分布。对多模态数据，将分离的模态映射到单一高斯区域需要较大的传输形变，从而损害几何质量。作者希望将拉回几何推广到由流形混合支撑的数据。

Method: 使用潜变量高斯混合构造拉回几何，将黎曼度量定义为责任加权期望分量精度的矩阵平方。证明该度量光滑、正定，并在单分量极限下退化为已有高斯构造。针对结构化重叠混合，给出对数密度沿测地线为凹的条件，建立几何与高似然路径的联系并推导局部曲率关系。随后在带自适应混合学习的归一化流中实例化该几何，使活跃分量数从数据中自适应涌现，并支持分量级重构与局部有效维估计。

Result: 在合成几何数据、具有已知参考轨迹的受控多视角图像设置以及MNIST上的实验显示：传输畸变减小、路径支撑具竞争力、参考轨迹恢复接近、插值真实感提升。

Conclusion: 该工作将可扩展拉回几何从仅适用于接近单一流形的数据集，扩展到多模态数据，同时保持局部结构的可处理性与可解释性。

Abstract: Data-driven Riemannian geometry provides nonlinear interpolation and geometric representations of high-dimensional data. For these operations to be statistically meaningful, paths between observations should preferentially traverse high-likelihood regions. Existing scalable pullback constructions typically use a unimodal Gaussian latent distribution, assuming that the data reside close to a single manifold. For multimodal data, mapping separated modes or local structures into one Gaussian region can require substantial transport deformation and compromise the resulting geometry.
  We introduce a pullback geometry for data supported on mixtures of manifolds. Using a latent Gaussian mixture, we define its Riemannian metric as the matrix square of the responsibility-weighted expected component precision. The metric is smooth and positive definite and recovers the existing Gaussian construction in the single-component limit. For structured overlapping mixtures, we establish conditions under which the log-density is concave along geodesics, providing a formal connection between the proposed geometry and paths through high-likelihood regions, and derive the corresponding local curvature relations.
  We instantiate this geometry in a normalizing flow with adaptive mixture learning, allowing the number of active components to emerge from the data and supporting component-wise reconstruction and local effective-dimension estimation. Experiments on synthetic geometric data, a controlled multi-view image setting with a known reference trajectory, and MNIST show reduced transport distortion, competitive path support, close reference-trajectory recovery, and improved interpolation realism. These results extend scalable pullback geometry beyond datasets that reside close to a single manifold while retaining tractable and interpretable local structure.

</details>


### [332] [WOMBAT: Whitebox Oracle for Molecular Benchmarking and Attribution Testing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00713)
*Dominik Matuszek,Bartosz Zieliński,Tomasz Danel,Dawid Rymarczyk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: WOMBAT是一个由14个白盒GNN模型组成的基准，每个模型的手工设置消息传递权重使其检测特定SMARTS基序，从而为可解释性方法提供归因真值，并在数百万PubChem分子上验证并评估了多种事后解释器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当GNN解释器在分子上产生意外归因时，仅凭归因本身无法判断是解释器失败还是模型学到了捷径（shortcut）。缺乏已知决策规则的模型使解释器错误的识别与研究变得困难。

Method: 构建WOMBAT基准，包含14个白盒GNN，每个模型的消息传递权重手工设定以检测特定SMARTS基序，因此决策规则已知，提供归因真值。在数百万PubChem分子上验证模型，并评估GNNExplainer、PGExplainer和Integrated Gradients等事后解释器。基于定性分析构造一个模型，使Integrated Gradients将归因散布到整个图，尽管该模型能可靠检测目标基序。

Result: 模型在数百万PubChem分子上得到验证；对多种事后解释器进行了评估；构造出使Integrated Gradients归因扩散的模型，尽管其仍能可靠检测目标基序。数据集、模型与评估代码已发布。

Conclusion: WOMBAT通过提供已知决策规则的白盒模型与归因真值，能够识别并研究解释器错误，并助力GNN新型XAI工具的开发。

Abstract: When a graph neural network (GNN) explainer produces an unexpected attribution on a molecule, the attribution alone cannot reveal whether the explainer has failed or the model has learned a shortcut. We introduce WOMBAT, a benchmark of 14 whitebox GNNs, each with message-passing weights set by hand to detect a specific SMARTS motif. Each model's decision rule is known by construction, providing attribution ground truth against which explainer errors can be identified and studied. We validate the models on millions of PubChem molecules and evaluate post-hoc explainers including GNNExplainer, PGExplainer, and Integrated Gradients. Guided by our qualitative analysis, we construct a model that causes Integrated Gradients to spread attribution across the graph, even though the model reliably detects the intended motif. We release the dataset, models, and evaluation code to help researchers in the development of newer XAI tools for GNNs.

</details>


### [333] [JEPA-TTT: Persistent Test-Time Training of Latent World Models for Planning under Dynamics Shifts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00722)
*Zheyuan Zhang,Suyu Ye,Nakul Agarwal,Hossein Nourkhiz Mahjoub,Ehsan Moradi Pari,Daniel Khashabi,Tianmin Shu,Vaishnav Tadiparthi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: JEPA-TTT通过在测试时对预训练世界模型的潜在动力学预测器进行自监督持续更新，使智能体在动力学变化下仍能有效规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型能通过预测未来状态来辅助规划，但当测试时的动力学与训练时不同，其预测会变得不可靠，因此需要一种能在测试阶段适应新动力学的方法。

Method: 提出JEPA-TTT，仅微调预训练的动作条件联合嵌入预测架构世界模型中的潜在动力学预测器，视觉编码器和奖励头保持固定；更新为自监督并跨回合累积；规划无需目标图像或在线环境奖励；采用密集回放，在每个时间偏移处构造预测窗口，存入不断增长的缓冲区并从中采样小批量进行更新。

Result: 在4个连续控制环境的8种动力学变化中，JEPA-TTT在每种变化上都提升了规划表现；500个测试回合后，自回归潜在预测误差平均降低83%，规划性能相较冻结的JEPA世界模型提升153%。

Conclusion: 持续的自监督测试时训练能够让预训练潜在世界模型适应变化的动力学，从而显著提升规划性能。

Abstract: World models enable agents to plan by predicting future states of the environment, but their predictions can become unreliable when test-time dynamics differ from those seen during training. We present JEPA-TTT, which adapts the latent dynamics predictor of a pretrained action-conditioned Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture world model throughout test time. Self-supervised updates accumulate across episodes, while the visual encoder and reward head remain fixed, preserving the pretrained representation and task objective. Planning requires neither a goal image nor online environment reward. JEPA-TTT uses dense replay, which forms prediction windows at every temporal offset, retains them in a growing buffer, and samples minibatches from that buffer for predictor updates. Across eight dynamics shifts in four continuous-control environments, JEPA-TTT improves planning on every shift. After 500 test-time episodes, it reduces autoregressive latent prediction error by 83% on average and improves planning performance by 153% over the frozen JEPA world model. These results show that persistent self-supervised test-time training can adapt a pretrained latent world model under changed dynamics.

</details>


### [334] [Benchmarking Generative Models for Weather Data Assimilation on Real Station Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00728)
*Ruizhe Huang,Qidong Yang,Jonathan Giezendanner,Sherrie Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次在真实气象站观测上对生成式天气数据同化进行受控基准测试，发现学习到的生成先验优于3D-Var高斯先验，全梯度引导最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 天气再分析依赖计算密集的数值天气预报和数据同化。深度生成模型提供更廉价的替代方案，但现有方法多在合成观测或不同数据集/评估方案下评测，无法确定哪些设计选择真正改善真实数据同化。
