Method: 构建首个生成式天气数据同化的受控基准。使用美国本土11,849个NOAA MADIS站点和四个气象变量，固定数据集、观测算子和深度学习架构，比较扩散vs流匹配、像素vs潜空间、多种推理时条件策略，并以经典3D-Var为基线。

Result: 1) 学习生成先验优于3D-Var高斯先验（RMSE较ERA5降低35.7% vs 33.3%），且推理时不使用ERA5背景场；2) 全梯度引导持续优于停止梯度和初始噪声优化；3) 扩散与流匹配性能几乎相同，潜空间变量混合无帮助；4) 稀疏站点下生成式AI和全梯度引导优势更明显。

Conclusion: 明确了生成式天气数据同化中哪些组件真正提升真实站点观测上的性能，并为未来研究建立标准化基准。

Abstract: Weather reanalysis products rely on computationally intensive numerical weather predictions followed by data assimilation that corrects the forecast toward observations. Deep generative models offer a cheaper alternative that shifts much of this cost from inference to offline training. However, existing generative approaches have been evaluated on synthetic observations or under different datasets and evaluation schemes, making it unclear which design choices actually improve real-world data assimilation. We present the first controlled benchmark of generative weather data assimilation on real weather station observations. Using 11,849 NOAA MADIS stations across the contiguous United States and four weather variables, we evaluate methods while holding the dataset, observation operator, and deep learning architecture fixed. The benchmark compares the major design choices, including diffusion versus flow matching, pixel versus latent-space formulations, and multiple inference-time conditioning strategies, against a classical 3D-Var baseline. The benchmark reveals three clear conclusions. First, learned generative priors outperform the Gaussian prior of 3D-Var (35.7% vs. 33.3% RMSE reduction over ERA5) despite using no ERA5 background field at inference. Second, full-gradient guidance consistently outperforms stop-gradient and initial-noise optimization. Third, other choices provide little measurable benefit: diffusion and flow matching perform nearly identically under matched conditions, and latent-space variable mixing does not help. We further evaluate both dense and sparse station settings and find advantages from generative AI and full-gradient guidance more pronounced under sparsity. Together, these results identify which components of generative weather data assimilation improve performance on real station observations and establish a standardized benchmark for future work.

</details>


### [335] [Reformulation-Contrastive Learning for Mixed Integer Programs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00730)
*Ousema Bouaneni,Mathis Le Bail,Clément Elliker,Maël Jenny,Sonia Vanier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ReMILP利用MILP的等价重构作为自监督信号，联合训练图神经网络与超网络学习变量与约束的等变表示，无需求解器标签即可提升下游预测任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MILP可建模大量现实决策问题，但其求解昂贵；同一问题存在多种等价表述（保持整数性的变量替换与冗余约束）。作者希望利用这些重构作为自监督来源，学习MILP变量与约束的通用表示，从而加速求解并避免依赖求解器标签。

Method: 作者刻画了对所有输入实例均有效的仿射重构，并将保持变量不变的重描述与可预测变换变量的替换区分开。基于等变自监督学习，提出ReMILP，联合训练图神经网络与超网络，预测变量嵌入在变量替换下如何变换。

Result: 在未见问题类别上，ReMILP学习到的表示展现出预期的不变性与等变性；在二元解、约束活跃度及整数间隙预测任务中，冻结表示即包含任务相关信息，并可作为微调的有效初始化。

Conclusion: 等价重构可作为有效的自监督信号，ReMILP无需求解器标签即可学得可迁移的MILP表示，为下游预测与求解加速提供良好基础。

Abstract: Mixed-integer linear programs (MILP) model many real-world decision problems, motivating machine-learning methods that exploit recurring structure to accelerate MILP solving. MILPs can admit many equivalent formulations: integrality-preserving changes of variables and the addition of redundant constraints can alter their formulations while preserving the optimization problem. We leverage these reformulations as a source of self-supervision for learning general-purpose representations of MILP variables and constraints. We characterize the affine reformulations that are valid for every input instance, and distinguish re-descriptions, which leave variables unchanged, from substitutions, which transform them predictably. Building on equivariant self-supervised learning, we introduce ReMILP (reformulation-contrastive MILP representation learning), which jointly trains a graph neural network and a hypernetwork to predict how variable embeddings transform under changes of variables. Without solver-derived labels, ReMILP learns representations that exhibit the intended invariance and equivariance on unseen problem classes. Across binary solution, constraint activity and integrality gap prediction, these representations carry task-relevant information when frozen and provide a useful initialization for fine-tuning.

</details>


### [336] [Signal-Noise Factorization Isolates Nuisance Variation into Removable Subspaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00751)
*Sakin Kirti,Joel Zylberberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过在训练中施加正则化强化表征几何中的信号-噪声分解(SNF)与信号-信号分解(SSF)，发现SNF正则化能显著提升模型性能（尤其在含损坏的BloodMNIST上），而SSF正则化无此效果；其机制是SNF使噪声表征在独立子空间中，从而可在推理时投影去除损坏方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有理论工作指出表征几何的两个基本性质——信号-噪声分解(SNF)与信号-信号分解(SSF)——会影响深度网络的推理能力，但尚不清楚在训练中主动强化这些性质会如何塑造表征并影响实际任务性能，尤其缺乏在生物医学等存在分布外图像失真的场景下的验证。

Method: 构建正则化项，在训练中分别强化SNF和SSF两种性质；在CIFAR-100分类任务上与L2正则化基线网络对比，观察表征几何变化与性能影响；随后在经MedMNIST-C五种严重程度损坏处理的BloodMNIST数据集上评估；为理解SNF机制，分析不同正则化方案下的噪声/冗余子空间；并利用SNF模型噪声表征显式的特性，在留出数据上估计由损坏诱导的主要方向并从表征中投影剔除。

Result: 在CIFAR-100上，强化SNF改善了模型性能，而强化SSF未带来提升；在遭受五种严重程度损坏的BloodMNIST上，SNF正则化带来更大的性能增益。子空间分析显示SNF正则化模型将噪声表征在独立于类相关信号的子空间中；由于该几何结构显式，可在留出数据上估计损坏主要方向并投影剔除，从而使准确率大幅提升。

Conclusion: 强化信号-噪声分解的正则化能在推理时存在分布外图像失真的计算机视觉任务上带来显著改进，说明将噪声变量与类别变量分离比保持类别变量之间的分解表征更重要，也揭示了表征塑造对模型性能的关键作用。

Abstract: Recent theoretical work identified fundamental properties of representation geometry that shape inference ability of deep neural networks. These include signal-noise factorization (SNF), the ability to segregate signal from noise, and signal-signal factorization (SSF), the ability to segregate task-specific and task-irrelevant signals. Here, we built regularizers that reinforce these two properties during training. We compared networks trained with these regularizers to $L_2$-regularized baseline networks on the CIFAR-100 classification task to understand how our regularizers shape representation geometry and impact performance on a well-known computer vision baseline. Enhancing SNF via regularization improved model performance but enhancing SSF did not. Motivated by biomedical applications, we investigated how our regularizers affected performance on the BloodMNIST dataset treated with MedMNIST-C corruptions at five severity levels, and found even larger performance gains using the SNF regularizer. To understand the mechanism by which SNF-regularization produces improved performance, we analyzed the nuisance subspaces across regularization regimes, finding that the SNF-regularized models represent noise in distinct subspaces, separate from class-relevant signal. Because this geometry is explicit, the dominant corruption-induced directions can be estimated on held-out data and projected out of the representations. This manipulation led to a substantial gain in accuracy. These results show that regularizers that enforce signal-noise factorization can produce substantial improvements on computer vision tasks that contain out-of-distribution image distortions at inference time. They also highlight how shaping representations affects model performance: isolating nuisance variables from categorical ones is more important than maintaining factorized representations of categorical variables.

</details>


### [337] [Increasing Width Allows Greedy Layer-wise Training to Rival End-to-End Backpropagation in Self-Supervised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00753)
*Syon Mansur,Joel Zylberberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究探讨卷积网络中宽度与深度对逐层贪心自监督训练与端到端反向传播效果的影响，发现网络越宽，端到端优势越小，甚至浅而宽的网络中逐层贪心训练表现更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端反向传播是深度学习主流训练方式，但已有研究表明局部优化（避免端到端误差反传）的替代方法有时也能达到相近性能。然而，在何种网络结构条件下局部优化网络能学到与端到端训练相当的表示仍不清楚，本文旨在自监督学习背景下回答这一问题。

Method: 在自监督学习框架下，研究卷积网络的宽度与深度如何影响逐层贪心训练与端到端自监督训练的效能，并对两种训练方式形成的表示进行比较分析。

Result: 在网络较宽时，端到端反向传播相对逐层贪心训练的优势缩小；在相对较浅且非常宽的网络中，逐层贪心训练甚至取得更高性能。表示分析显示，非常宽的贪心训练网络比端到端反向传播网络具有更有利的表示几何。

Conclusion: 网络宽度可以弥补受限的信用分配问题，表示几何的差异是其性能提升的潜在机制。

Abstract: End-to-end backpropagation has been the dominant mode of training in deep learning, allowing for the coordination of parameter updates across layers of a neural network. Prior studies have explored alternative -- and, in some cases, simpler -- training mechanisms, showing that they can sometimes achieve performance similar to backpropagation. However, the architectural conditions under which locally optimized networks, which avoid end-to-end backpropagation of error, can learn representations comparable to those learned through end-to-end training remain unclear. We aim to answer this question in the context of self-supervised learning, an important framework for large-scale pretraining in artificial intelligence. Here, we investigate how network width and depth affect the efficacy of greedy layer-wise and end-to-end self-supervised training in convolutional networks. We find that in wider networks, the benefits of end-to-end backpropagation over greedy layer-wise training shrink: in relatively shallow and very wide networks, we even observed higher performance in models trained with greedy layer-wise training. Subsequent analysis of the representations formed by these networks shows that very wide greedy-trained networks exhibit more favorable representational geometry than do networks trained end-to-end with backpropagation. This work shows that width can compensate for restricted credit assignment and identifies differences in representational geometry as a potential mechanism for their improved performance.

</details>


### [338] [Scalable Multi-Task Inverse Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00758)
*Allen Tran,Jia Wan,Nathan Kallus,Aurélien Bibaut*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种低秩多任务逆强化学习方法，通过在相同环境中汇聚多个不同奖励智能体的数据，缓解覆盖要求并实现可扩展的跨环境评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆强化学习通过迁移可迁移奖励，可在修改后的环境中对智能体进行反事实评估，但这类迁移对数据覆盖有严格要求，因为目标环境会影响智能体的状态占用。单任务方法难以满足覆盖需求，且多任务评估时规划计算量随任务数增长而变得昂贵。

Method: 在低秩假设下，将同一环境中多个具有不同奖励的智能体的数据汇聚起来进行多任务逆强化学习。该方法使每个任务无需访问所有状态，只需其他任务访问即可；同时利用奖励的低秩结构，使在新环境下的规划计算量随秩而非任务数量扩展。

Result: 理论上给出了奖励恢复与在新环境中策略学习的有限样本保证。实验表明，该方法对有限覆盖具有鲁棒性，能够在每个任务支持集内外恢复奖励，并在迁移到目标环境时相比基线具有更低的遗憾，且相较于逐任务方法，其计算优势随任务数量增加而扩大。

Conclusion: 该多任务逆强化学习方法通过低秩数据汇聚，有效缓解了覆盖要求，并提供了可扩展的多任务跨环境评估，兼具理论保证与实验上的鲁棒性和计算优势。

Abstract: By learning transferable rewards, inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) enables counterfactual evaluation of agents under modified environments. Such transfer places strict requirements on coverage since target environments affect agents' state occupancy. We propose a multi-task IRL method that pools data across multiple agents with different rewards in the same environment under a low-rank assumption. In addition to alleviating coverage requirements, so each task need not visit every state as long as others do, the method offers scalable evaluation of multiple tasks under new environments as computationally intensive planning scales with rank rather than the number of tasks. We provide finite sample guarantees on reward recovery and on policy learning in new environments. Experiments show our method is robust to limited coverage, recovers rewards on and off of each task's support, transfers to target environments at lower regret than baselines, with its computational advantage over per-task methods widening as tasks grow.

</details>


### [339] [Pre-training interventions, ex post facto: Grafting model beliefs across checkpoints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00767)
*Peter Nutter,Dani Roytburg,Clément Dumas,Jinghua Ou,Shi Feng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"嫁接"(grafting)方法：在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，再将学到的权重更新加到后训练模型上，从而以极低成本近似忠实的预/中期训练干预。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练干预（如合成文档微调SDF）对对齐研究至关重要，因为预训练阶段形成的信念会影响模型的后续泛化。理想情况下合成文档应混入预训练或中期训练，但语料改动后必须完整跑一遍后训练才能测量效果，迭代慢且昂贵。实践中通常直接在已后训练的模型上做SDF，但会残留伪影、损害能力，并导致"现实漂移"——模型会把与文档无关的虚构实体当作真实存在。

Method: 提出"嫁接"：先在预训练检查点上训练SDF适配器，然后将学到的权重更新叠加到已后训练模型上。这样无需重跑后训练即可近似忠实的中期训练流程。作者用三类任务验证：植入虚假事实、训练失准的模型生物、以及宪法式中期训练干预，覆盖最高284B参数的多个模型家族。

Result: 嫁接在植入目标信念的强度上与在后训练模型上直接做SDF相当；平均而言将现实漂移和偏好一致性损失降低超过一半，且更接近忠实的完整中期训练结果。

Conclusion: 由于嫁接无需后训练，同一适配器可应用到任意后续检查点，使研究者能以单次微调的成本快速迭代预训练干预方案。

Abstract: Pre-training interventions are critical to alignment research, since beliefs formed during pre-training shape how a model generalizes from later training. One recently popular technique for such interventions is synthetic document fine-tuning (SDF), which aims to alter what the model believes. Ideally, synthetic documents would be mixed into pre- or mid-training, but every change to a pre-training corpus must be followed by a full post-training run before its effect can be measured, making iteration slow and expensive. Common practice instead applies SDF to an already post-trained model. This is known to leave artifacts and degrade capabilities, and, as we show, it makes the model treat fabricated entities unrelated to the documents as real, a failure we call reality drift. We propose grafting: train the SDF adapter on the pre-trained checkpoint, then add the learned weight update to the post-trained model, which approximates the faithful approach while reusing the existing post-training. We demonstrate this by installing false facts, training misaligned model organisms and applying a constitutional mid-training intervention, across model families up to 284B parameters. Grafting installs the target belief as strongly as SDF on the post-trained model while reducing both reality drift and the loss of preference coherence by more than half on average, and it stays closer to a faithful mid-training run. Because grafting requires no post-training, the same adapter can be applied to any later checkpoint, enabling researchers to iterate quickly on pre-training interventions at the cost of a single fine-tuning run.

</details>


### [340] [Localizing Transfer Between Memorization Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00771)
*Yimiao Yu,Florentin Guth*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究随机输入-输出映射的记忆任务之间的迁移学习，发现两种反直觉的迁移模式（等价迁移与非等价迁移），并通过消融实验将迁移分解为末层幅值驱动的"平凡"迁移和其他层协方差贡献的"非平凡"结构迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迁移学习的核心谜题在于：为何在一个任务上预训练能加速或提升另一任务的训练，其背后的机制是什么。作者希望通过研究可控的随机映射记忆任务之间的迁移来揭示这一机制。

Method: 作者在随机输入-输出映射的记忆任务上进行迁移学习实验，观察预训练与下游微调之间的关系，并设计消融实验对迁移效应进行分解与定位。

Result: 发现两种反直觉的迁移模式：一是等价迁移，每个额外预训练epoch约节省一个下游微调epoch；二是非等价迁移，在不匹配任务上预训练甚至比直接训练下游任务更高效。消融实验将迁移分解为末层幅值驱动的"平凡"迁移，以及部分归因于其他层协方差的"非平凡"结构迁移。

Conclusion: 该研究加深了对迁移学习内在机制的理解，并有望指导基于原理的预训练策略设计。

Abstract: A central puzzle in transfer learning is why pre-training on one task can accelerate training or improve performance on another task, and what mechanisms underlie this transfer. In this work, we examine the transfer between memorization tasks of random input-output mappings. We find two surprising transfer patterns: equivalent transfer, where each additional pre-training epoch saves approximately one downstream fine-tuning epoch; and non-equivalent transfer, where pre-training on a mismatched task can be even more efficient than directly training on the downstream task itself. Through ablation experiments, we decompose and localize the transfer into two separate effects: a "trivial" magnitude-driven transfer in the last layer, and a "non-trivial" structure-driven transfer, partially attributable to the covariance of the other layers. These results advance our understanding of the underlying mechanisms of transfer learning and have the potential to lead to principled pre-training strategies.

</details>


### [341] [Learning Goal-Reaching Quasimetric Geometry From Finite-Time Reachability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00778)
*Daisuke Yamada,Travis Pence,Vikas Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出ReQRL，通过有限时域可达性约束评论家的价值梯度，将动力学可达性与边界几何解耦并分别从数据估计，在OGBench上优于或媲美现有拟度量方法及其他离线GCRL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在目标条件强化学习中，拟度量学习将目标达成代价建模为拟度量距离，连接局部约束与全局价值几何。但其局部约束应体现有限时域内控制复合的方向依赖效应以及环境的可行性，现有方法对此刻画不足。

Method: 借鉴状态约束最优控制，通过有限时域可达性对评论家的价值梯度施加约束；将动力学可达性与边界几何进行解耦，并分别从数据中估计二者。

Result: 在OGBench基准上，该方法优于或媲美现有拟度量方法以及其他离线GCRL方法。

Conclusion: 通过有限时域可达性约束价值梯度、解耦并数据驱动估计动力学可达性与边界几何，能有效提升离线目标条件强化学习的性能。

Abstract: In goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL), quasimetric learning models goal-reaching costs as quasimetric distances, connecting local constraints to global value geometry. Its local constraints, however, should reflect the direction- dependent effects of control composition over a finite horizon together with environmental feasibility. We propose ReQRL, which constrains the critic's value gradients through finite-horizon reachability. Drawing on state-constrained optimal control, we decouple dynamical reachability from boundary geometry, estimating both from data. On OGBench, our method outperforms or rivals existing quasimetric approaches and other offline GCRL methods.

</details>


### [342] [Training-Aware Target Coverage for Synthetic Data Selection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00814)
*Yang Ba,Michelle V. Mancenido,Rong Pan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个线性理论刻画合成数据在LLM训练中的价值权衡，并据此设计TATC合成数据选择方法，在数学推理等任务上验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成数据被广泛用于扩展LLM训练规模，但更多合成数据并不必然带来更好模型。有用的合成数据须为目标任务增加相关信息而不引入抵消其收益的错误，且样本价值随训练集增大而变化，因此需要一个能刻画"信息增益与误差抵消"权衡的理论框架来指导何时、多少以及如何添加合成数据。

Method: 作者建立线性理论来分析合成数据的上述权衡，确定其有用性条件、应添加的数量及向现有数据集添加单个样本的边际价值；分析进一步给出仅靠输入覆盖即足够、以及须同时考虑合成误差的条件。基于此提出Training-Aware Target Coverage（TATC）方法：筛选对目标任务训练效应有益的候选样本，并在其中选择能扩展数据尚未覆盖的目标相关方向者。

Result: 在文本和图像数据上的实验验证了线性理论。在数学推理任务中，TATC为Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct选择合成解进行微调，在GSM8K上于各选择预算下均优于其他合成数据选择方法。

Conclusion: 本文通过量化并最大化合成数据对目标任务的价值，提供了一个有原则的合成数据选择方法。

Abstract: Synthetic data are increasingly used to scale LLM training, yet more synthetic data do not necessarily produce better models. Useful synthetic data must add information relevant to the target task without introducing errors that offset their benefit, and the value of an example can change as the training set grows. We develop a linear theory that characterizes this tradeoff and determines where synthetic data are useful, how much should be added, and the marginal value of adding one example to an existing set. The analysis shows the conditions when input coverage alone is sufficient and when synthetic errors must also be considered. Guided by these results, we introduce \emph{Training-Aware Target Coverage} (TATC), a synthetic data selection method for LLM fine-tuning. TATC identifies candidates whose training effects are beneficial to the target task and selects among them to expand coverage of target-relevant directions not already represented by the available data. Experiments on text and image data verify the linear theory. With mathematical reasoning tasks, TATC selects synthetic solutions for fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct and outperforms alternative synthetic-data selection methods on GSM8K across selection budgets. In summary, we provide a principled approach to synthetic data selection by quantifying and maximizing its value to the target task.

</details>


### [343] [Quantifying the Impact of Ambulance Ramping: A Multi-Year Analysis of Victorian Emergency Medical Services Cases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00818)
*Ayesha Tanveer,Khandakar Ahmed,Assefa Teshome,Oyetunde Gbadeyan,Ziad Nehme*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对澳大利亚维多利亚州全州EMS系统2020年1月至2024年3月的285万余次救护车出勤进行探索性数据分析，量化救护车滞留（ramping）的规模、趋势与运营关联，为医院状态感知的救护车调度提供实证依据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 救护车滞留（到达医院至患者交接之间的延迟）是EMS的关键运营瓶颈，但其在系统层面的规模与动态特征在大范围上仍缺乏充分刻画，因此需要全州尺度的实证量化研究。

Method: 采用探索性数据分析（EDA）。经系统预处理后，构建覆盖59家有急诊科的医院、79个地方政府区域、2,026,569例急诊转运的分析队列，方法包括区间分解、帕累托集中度分析、小时级互相关、医院到达并发度分析以及按优先级分层的运营比较。

Result: 累计救护车损失工时（AHL）达1,491,127小时，相当于研究期内每天约损失96个十小时班次；59家医院中10家贡献57.8%的损失工时（占50.9%病例）。年度损失上升57%并于2022年达峰，而转运需求下降3.7%，说明恶化源于单例交接效率而非需求增长。交接时长与患者病情严重度几乎无关，但随前一小时到达同一医院的救护车数量单调上升，且该效应在一天中各时段均存在。小时需求与2至4小时后的滞留中度相关（r = 0.365）。

Conclusion: 研究揭示滞留问题的系统性规模与集中性，并表明交接延迟主要由医院侧并发压力而非患者病情驱动，从而为医院状态感知的救护车路径规划确立了实证前提。

Abstract: Ambulance ramping, the delay between hospital arrival and patient handover, is a critical operational bottleneck in Emergency Medical Services (EMS), yet its systemic magnitude and dynamics remain inadequately characterised at scale. This paper quantifies the scale, trajectory, and operational correlates of ramping across an entire statewide EMS system, analysing 2,850,575 ambulance attendances in Victoria, Australia from January 2020 to March 2024 using an Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA). After systematic preprocessing, an analytical cohort of 2,026,569 Emergency Department (ED) transports across 59 hospitals with ED and 79 Local Government Areas (LGA) was examined through interval decomposition, Pareto concentration, hourly cross-correlation, hospital arrival concurrency and priority-stratified operational comparisons. Cumulative Ambulance Hours Lost (AHL) totalled 1,491,127 hours, equivalent to approximately 96 ten-hour ambulance shift lost every day of the study window. Ten of 59 hospitals account for 57.8% of lost hours from 50.9% of cases. Annual losses rose 57% to a 2022 peak while transported demand fell 3.7%, indicating deterioration in per-case handover rather than growth in demand. Handover duration varies little with patient acuity, but rises monotonically with the number of ambulances arriving at the same hospital in the preceding hour, an effect persisting within every hour of the day. Hourly demand is moderately associated with ramping two to four hours later (r = 0.365). These findings establish the empirical preconditions for hospital-state aware ambulance routing.

</details>


### [344] [On-the-fly Weight Generation: A Hypernetwork Proof of Concept on ARC-1D](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00820)
*Fabio J. Fehr,Philip Torr*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文探索能否从少量示例直接生成专用模型参数，而非进行任务特定训练。以ARC-1D为测试平台，证明单个变换可由极小的专用模型表示，且超网络能从上下文生成其参数，形成结构化权重空间，并展现部分组合泛化与未见变换泛化；去除显式任务标识可进一步提升泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用模型能从上下文适应多种任务，而专用模型虽能以更小容量执行单一功能，却需要任务特定训练或适配。作者希望探究能否绕过训练，直接从少量示例中生成这些专用模型。

Method: 使用ARC-1D作为受控测试平台，用极小的专用模型表示单个变换，并训练一个超网络根据上下文生成这些专用模型的参数；同时比较是否保留显式任务标识对泛化的影响。

Result: 生成的参数构成结构化权重空间，所得专用模型表现出部分组合泛化和对训练中未见变换的泛化能力；在两种设定下，移除显式任务标识均可提升对训练变换之外的泛化。

Conclusion: 结果证明少数示例中的任务上下文可以被即时编译为紧凑的可执行模型参数，且生成的权重空间支持超出已知函数的复用与泛化，为少样本任务上下文到模型参数的即时生成提供了概念验证。

Abstract: General-purpose models can adapt to many tasks from context, while specialised models can execute individual functions with less capacity. Yet obtaining such specialists requires task-specific training or adaptation. We ask whether they can instead be generated directly from a few demonstrations. Using ARC-1D as a controlled testbed, we show that individual transformations can be represented by tiny specialist models, and that a hypernetwork can generate their parameters from context. The generated parameters form a structured weight space, while the resulting specialists show partial compositional generalisation and generalisation to transformations not seen during training. In both settings, removing explicit task identifiers improves generalisation beyond the training transformations. Together, these results provide a proof of concept that few-shot task context can be compiled on-the-fly into compact executable model parameters, and that the resulting weight space can support reuse and generalisation beyond known functions.

</details>


### [345] [AnyJev Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00831)
*Jiamu Zhang,Tianze Yang,Yucheng Shi,Evan Chen,Zixiang Nie,Kelly Wan,Liangjie Hong,Ninghao Liu,Liang Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: AnyJev 通过一次 prefill 从指令微调语言模型中读取"类型化决策"，用标签先验校正和选项列表循环旋转平均消除标签偏差与位置偏差，并以停止规则减少所需 prefill 次数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有系统若需类型化决策（在固定选项集中以概率形式给出选择），通常依赖专门训练的模型。本文希望无需额外训练，直接利用预训练指令微调语言模型在答案位置读取类型化决策。

Method: AnyJev 将答案位置的下一个 token 分布限制在选项 token 上。针对两个缺陷（无关于输入的标签偏好、选项列表中的位置偏好），在无梯度、无参数更新下进行校正：除以由无标注输入估计的标签先验，并对选项列表的 K 个循环旋转取对数概率平均。为降低 K 次 prefill 的开销，引入停止规则，在无标注状态上针对全旋转决策进行选择，并在另一划分上界定其不一致度。

Result: 在两个 20 选项任务上，旋转将顺序翻转率从 0.33 降至 0.14 和 0.18，并在 11/11 个模型上提升准确率。停止规则在四个单元格中的两个上以 0.008 的已验证界读取 18 个旋转中的 10.6 个；按服务运行方式（在同一划分上选择并界定）读取 7.3 个旋转，在 vLLM 上每秒服务决策数提升 2.2 倍。

Conclusion: AnyJev 无需训练即可从预训练指令微调模型读取类型化决策，有效纠正标签与位置偏差，并通过停止规则显著降低计算开销，代码已开源。

Abstract: A typed decision is a choice among a fixed set of options, returned as a probability rather than as text. Systems that need typed decisions today use models trained for that purpose. This report describes AnyJev, which reads a typed decision from one prefill of a pretrained instruction-tuned language model. The readout restricts the next-token distribution at the answer position to the option tokens. It has two defects: the model assigns higher probability to some labels whatever the input, and to some positions in the option list. AnyJev corrects both with no gradient steps and no parameter changes: it divides out a label prior estimated from unlabelled inputs, and it averages log-probabilities over the K cyclic rotations of the option list. On two 20-option tasks the rotations lower the order-flip rate from 0.33 to 0.14 and from 0.33 to 0.18, and raise accuracy on 11 of 11 models on both. Reading every rotation requires K prefills. A stopping rule selected against the full-rotation decision on unlabelled states cuts that. Selecting the threshold on one unlabelled split and bounding its disagreement on a second, it reads 10.6 rotations of 18 at a verified 0.008 bound on two of four cells; selected and bounded on one split, as our serving run did, it reads 7.3 and serves 2.2 times as many decisions per second on vLLM. The code is open source.

</details>


### [346] [TrueMuse: A Benchmark for Data Attribution in Text-to-Music Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00835)
*Jiawei Yu,Jian Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TrueMuse，一个用于文本到音乐生成数据归因的受控数据集与基准，通过对三个扩散模型在精选归因样本上微调来提供可靠的评估目标，系统评估现有黑盒归因方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文本到音乐生成模型基于海量音乐数据集训练，亟需量化单个训练样本贡献的数据归因方法。但现有归因方法因缺乏可靠的真实标注（ground truth）而难以严格评估，导致无法可靠判断其实际有效性。

Method: 构建TrueMuse：通过对三个基于扩散的文本到音乐模型在精心挑选的归因样本上微调，已知的微调样本纳入性提供了受控的归因评估目标。基准涵盖四种归因设定（旋律结构、音色特征、艺术家级风格特征、流派级共享模式），包含133个属性、648个微调模型、两种提示类型下共95,456个生成样本。使用该基准从四个维度系统评估现有黑盒归因方法：微调改进、提示类型难度、多任务训练、微调数据规模。

Result: 结果显示归因仍具挑战性，现有方法在不同评估设定下表现出显著差异，凸显了对更可靠、更可泛化的文本到音乐生成归因方法的需求。

Conclusion: TrueMuse为文本到音乐数据归因提供了受控评估基准，揭示了现有黑盒归因方法的不足。代码和数据集将在论文被接收后发布。

Abstract: Text-to-music generation models are trained on massive music collections, creating a growing need for data attribution methods that can quantify the contribution of individual training samples. However, existing attribution methods are difficult to rigorously evaluate due to the lack of reliable ground truth, making it challenging to reliably assess their actual effectiveness. To address this gap, we introduce TrueMuse, a controlled dataset and benchmark for text-to-music data attribution. TrueMuse is constructed by fine-tuning three diffusion-based text-to-music models on carefully curated attribution samples, whose known inclusion in fine-tuning provides controlled attribution targets for evaluation. The benchmark covers four attribution settings, spanning melodic structure, timbral characteristics, artist-level stylistic signatures, and genre-level shared patterns, and includes 133 attributes, 648 fine-tuned models, and 95,456 generated samples across two prompt types. Using TrueMuse, we systematically evaluate existing black-box attribution methods along four dimensions: fine-tuning improvement, prompt-type difficulty, multi-task training, and fine-tuning data size. Our results show that attribution remains challenging, with existing methods exhibiting substantial variation across evaluation settings, highlighting the need for more reliable and generalizable attribution methods for text-to-music generation. Code and Dataset will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [347] [SHARPO: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00838)
*Xinchen Du,Zhengze Zhou,Wenhui Zhu,Han Yu,Sen Na,Rohit Jain,Alborz Geramifard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SHARPO提出一种段级事后优势重加权机制,通过在环境交互段上计算教师-学生对数概率差,对GRPO优势施加有界乘子,从而改进多步交互中的信用分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体强化学习需LLM进行长程多步交互,但单点局部错误即可导致任务失败,而轨迹级奖励对单步决策的信用分配指导有限。

Method: SHARPO在面向环境的"段"层面细化GRPO:受在线策略自蒸馏(OPSD)启发,在每个段内计算教师-学生对数概率差,据此得到有界乘子作用于GRPO优势,该乘子由段内所有token共享。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上,SHARPO在ALFWorld与WebShop基准上优于GRPO、SDAR、RLSD、StepOPSD等基线。

Conclusion: 段级重加权可实现跨段的差异化信用分配,是提升智能体RL训练效果的有效途径。

Abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) trains a large language model (LLM) to act over long, multi-step interactions. However, a single localized error can cause task failure, while trajectory-level rewards provide limited guidance for assigning credit to individual decisions. To address this limitation, we introduce Segment-level Hindsight Advantage Reweighting for Policy Optimization (SHARPO), a credit-assignment mechanism that refines Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) at the level of environment-facing segments. Inspired by the existing on-policy self-distillation (OPSD) method, SHARPO computes teacher-student log-probability gaps within each segment and uses the resulting signal to compute a bounded multiplier on the GRPO advantage. This multiplier is shared by all tokens within the segment, allowing credit to vary across different segments. With Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, SHARPO outperforms existing baselines on the ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks, including GRPO, SDAR, RLSD, and StepOPSD.

</details>


### [348] [Fixing a Model That Learned Worse Cancer Means Lower Risk: Monotonic Constraints in Bladder Cancer Recurrence Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00858)
*Saram Abbas,David Thomas,Naeem Soomro,Rishad Shafik,Rakesh Heer,Kabita Adhikari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究揭示无约束XGBoost模型在膀胱癌复发预测中学习了与医学常识相反的"风险倒置"（分期和原位癌越高反而复发风险越低），且传统判别力、校准和SHAP均无法察觉；作者提出反事实方向检验和单调约束框架，可在不损失性能的前提下检测并修正这一失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床医生预期癌症越严重复发风险越高，但机器学习模型可能学到违反医学直觉的反向关系，而现有的判别力、校准和SHAP等常规评估手段对这一"风险倒置"完全无感知，因此需要一套能检测并纠正此类方向性错误的框架。

Method: 基于BOXIT多中心试验（472例患者，51个英国中心，2007-2012；435例随访≥2年，153例复发，35.2%），开发了反事实方向检验和单调约束修正方法，约束方向源自EORTC和EAU风险系统；在18个预测变量（7个有向）上，用50折交叉验证比较无约束XGBoost与逻辑回归。检验时逐个将患者在某有向特征上"恶化"，观察风险是否下降，同时评估SHAP方向和校准。

Result: 肿瘤分期和原位癌与更低复发风险相关，与医学直觉相反；无约束模型在90.2%的病例中反向处理原位癌反事实，74.3%反向处理分期。判别力（ΔAUC 0.005，p=0.47）、校准和SHAP幅度均对该倒置不敏感。单调约束消除了所有违规，判别力无损失（0.723 vs 0.718），并优于EORTC（p=8.9e-16）。

Conclusion: 一个学到了风险倒置的模型能通过所有常规检查；以预先设定的单调约束进行单次重拟合的反事实方向检验，能在不损失性能的情况下捕获该失效，应在临床部署前常规开展。局限：单一试验，仅内部-外部验证。

Abstract: Background and Objective: Clinicians expect recurrence risk to climb with cancer severity. In a UK multicentre trial, an unconstrained XGBoost model learnt that higher tumour stage and carcinoma in situ predicted lower recurrence risk, and discrimination, calibration, and SHAP were all blind to it. We developed a counterfactual testing framework to detect this inversion and a monotonic-constraint framework to remove it without hurting performance. Methods: BOXIT enrolled 472 patients with protocol-mandated cystoscopy across 51 UK sites (2007-2012); 435 had at least two years' follow-up (153 recurrences, 35.2%). We developed a counterfactual direction test and a monotonic-constraint correction, with constraint directions drawn from the EORTC and EAU risk systems, and evaluated both against unconstrained XGBoost and logistic regression on 18 predictors (seven directed) over 50 cross-validation folds. The test worsened each patient on one directed feature at a time to check whether risk fell; SHAP direction and calibration were also assessed. Key Findings and Limitations: Tumour stage and carcinoma in situ were associated with lower recurrence, opposite to medical intuition; the unconstrained model reversed carcinoma in situ counterfactuals in 90.2% of cases and stage in 74.3%. Discrimination ($Δ$AUC 0.005, p=0.47), calibration, and SHAP magnitude were all blind to the inversion. Monotonic constraints eliminated every violation at no cost to discrimination (0.723 vs 0.718) and outperformed EORTC (p=8.9e-16). Limitations: single trial, internal-external validation only. Conclusions and Clinical Implications: A model that had learned this inversion passed every conventional check. A counterfactual direction test, run as a single refit with pre-specified monotonic constraints, catches this failure at no cost to performance and should be routine before clinical deployment.

</details>


### [349] [Don't Waste the Noise: Importance-Guided Perturbation Allocation under Joint Global and Local Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00861)
*Melika Shirian,Kianoosh Vadaei*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种重要性引导的扰动分配机制，在共享 ℓ1 预算与局部幅度约束下重新分配（而非扩大）扰动预算，以提升对抗攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在共享 ℓ1 预算的对抗优化中，不仅要决定扰动总量，还要决定预算花在哪里；当各输入坐标受局部幅度约束时，扰动难以集中在少数位置，分配问题尤为关键。

Method: 利用固定的干净梯度先验构建重要性引导分配机制，将扰动引向模型敏感区域，同时保持可行扰动集不变；采用中心化分配目标，鼓励在高于平均重要性的位置施加扰动，抑制其他位置的多余开销。

Result: 在十种鲁棒模型—数据集配置、统一容量受限威胁设定下，相比匹配的 APGD 与 PMA 基线，攻击成功率提升 2.52 至 17.70 个百分点；高重要性区域扰动质量显著增加，而全局 ℓ1 消耗未增加。机制消融显示，中心化非均匀重分配贡献部分收益，模型导出的重要性带来额外提升。

Conclusion: 扰动分配是共享预算、局部约束威胁模型下对抗优化的一个独立且具有实际意义的维度。

Abstract: Adversarial optimization under a shared $\ell_1$ budget requires deciding not only how much perturbation to use, but also where that limited budget should be spent. This allocation problem becomes particularly important when individual input coordinates are subject to local magnitude constraints, which restrict the extent to which perturbation can be concentrated on a small number of locations. We introduce an importance-guided allocation mechanism that uses a fixed clean-gradient prior to steer perturbation toward model-sensitive regions while leaving the feasible perturbation set unchanged. A centered allocation objective encourages perturbation at above-average importance locations and discourages unnecessary expenditure elsewhere, thereby redistributing rather than enlarging the available budget. Across ten robust model--dataset configurations under a common capacity-limited threat setting, the proposed method improves attack success over matched APGD- and PMA-based baselines by $2.52$ to $17.70$ percentage points. Allocation analysis shows that these gains are accompanied by substantially greater perturbation mass in high-importance regions without increased global $\ell_1$ consumption. Mechanism ablations further show that centered non-uniform redistribution provides part of the benefit, while model-derived importance yields an additional improvement. These results identify perturbation allocation as a distinct and practically relevant dimension of adversarial optimization under shared-budget, locally constrained threat models.

</details>


### [350] [Rethinking Data Augmentation under Covariate Shift: Invariant-Guided Diffusion and Prototype Reweighting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00873)
*Hongyu Cao,Xinyuan Wang,Arun Vignesh Malarkkan,Kunpeng Liu,Haifeng Chen,Yanjie Fu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AWL-CS问题设定并提出IGDPR框架，通过不变性引导的扩散生成与原型重加权，实现协变量偏移下的稳定合成与适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业应用中表格数据稀缺且不平衡、训练与部署分布漂移（协变量偏移）、验证集与测试环境不一致、标准生成模型仅模仿过时源分布，导致标准增强与自适应流程不稳定。

Method: 提出IGDPR统一框架：i) 用不变性势引导扩散采样，使合成样本对齐稳定决策边界而非过时相关性；ii) 基于原型的重加权策略，通过结构聚类而非孤立点评估样本可靠性，过滤验证噪声。

Result: 在真实数据上的大量实验表明，该方法通过增强对鲁棒学习最有益的数据提升了数据质量。

Conclusion: IGDPR将稳定合成与结构自适应协同，有效应对AWL-CS设定下的误导性生成引导与分布密度结构不稳定两大挑战。

Abstract: In many industrial applications, 1) tabular data is scarce and imbalanced and thus requires synthetic expansion; 2) input distributions drift between training and deployment (covariate shift); 3) validation sets often diverge from unseen test environments; or 4) standard generative models simply mimic outdated source distributions. This learning setting limits the stability of standard augmentation and adaptation pipelines. We generalize the task under such setting as the Augmented and Weighted Learning under Covariate Shift problem (AWL-CS). AWL-CS imposes two critical challenges on existing methods: 1) misleading generative guidance where models optimize for source similarity rather than downstream task relevance, and 2) structural instability of distributional density where reweighting mechanisms overfit to noisy validation signals. To tackle these challenges, we propose IGDPR (Invariant-Guided Diffusion with Prototype Reweighting), a unified framework that synergizes stable synthesis and structural adaptation: i) To achieve task-relevant generation, we steer the diffusion sampling process using invariant potentials to ensure synthetic samples align with stable decision boundaries rather than outdated correlations. ii) To ensure stable adaptation, we develop a prototype-based reweighting strategy that assesses sample reliability through structural clusters instead of isolated points, effectively filtering validation noise. Extensive experiments on real data demonstrate our method improves data quality by augmenting the most beneficial data for robust learning.

</details>


### [351] [Match the Distribution, Not the Compute: Post-Training Multi-Token Prediction Heads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00888)
*Prachi Badarayani,Aidan Jay,Chenghui Zhou,Dayquan Julienne,Yuan Gao,Tianwei Chen,George Zerveas,Ishmam Zabir,Xiren Zhou,Chris Quirk,Xia Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在冻结的推理模型上，仅需轻量后训练即可获得多token预测的加速效果，并通过验证松弛与自适应控制器进一步提升吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多token预测（MTP）家族发布均需在数万亿token的预训练全程与骨干联合训练，导致草稿质量在预训练阶段被固化，成本高昂且不适用于已有冻结模型。作者探究是否可用轻量后训练在冻结推理模型上达到同等加速。

Method: 1）在冻结的Qwen3-8B上使用K=3链式MTP头，采用普通交叉熵在约2.5B目标模型生成的思维链token上进行后训练；2）提出链感知的草稿token验证松弛规则，允许相对骨干分布的有界漂移；3）提出自适应控制器，动态选择推理时启用的MTP头数量。

Result: 后训练方案在数学、编程与知识基准上达到或超过联合训练的MiMo-7B预期加速，且MTP训练token用量减少10^3–10^4倍；验证松弛使各基准预期加速提升12–16%且保持任务精度；自适应控制器在固定最大草稿长度下挽回11–14%的加速损失。

Conclusion: 轻量后训练足以在冻结推理模型上实现高效MTP加速，配合验证松弛与自适应头选择可进一步优化服务时性能，为低成本部署多token预测提供可行路径。

Abstract: Multi-token prediction (MTP) improves the throughput of autoregressive generation by enabling the language model to draft multiple next tokens per forward pass, while a verification step over draft tokens ensures that token distribution of the backbone is preserved. Every open MTP-family release (MiMo-7B, DeepSeek-V3, Qwen3) trains its heads jointly with the backbone over the full pretraining run of tens of trillions of tokens, thus setting the drafter quality at pretraining time. We ask whether a lightweight post-training pass on target-generated chain-of-thought is enough to reach the same expected throughput speedup on a frozen reasoning model, and study how a serving-time system built on such a checkpoint can be optimized. We present three findings. 1) On a frozen Qwen3-8B with $K{=}3$ chained MTP heads, we show that a post-training recipe with plain cross-entropy on $\approx\!2.5$B tokens reaches or exceeds the expected speedup of jointly trained MiMo-7B on math, coding and knowledge benchmarks. Our post-training recipe utilizes $10^3$-$10^4\times$ less MTP-training tokens as compared with joint pre-training of MiMO-7B MTP baseline. 2) We propose a chain-aware relaxation of draft token verification rule that allows a bounded drift from backbone language model token distribution. We show that this relaxation lifts expected speedups by $+12$ to $+16\%$ per benchmark while preserving task accuracy. 3) We propose an adaptive controller that dynamically chooses the number of MTP heads to be engaged at inference time and demonstrate recovery of upto $11$--$14\%$ loss in speedup using fixed maximum MTP draft length.

</details>


### [352] [Cross-Benchmark Transfer from RL on Agentic Coding Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00890)
*Sushant Mehta,Logan Ritchie,Edwin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对 Kimi K2.7 Code 仅用 RL、在 1700 个专家构建的智能体编程任务上做一 epoch 的 GSPO-LoRA 后训练，六个外部基准的 pass@1 全面提升，且在训练数据之后发布的基准与未见过的新 harness 上仍显著提升，轨迹步数缩短 24–35%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 编程智能体常败在"最后一公里"：功能做了大半却漏掉需求、只测自己实现已覆盖的情况、破坏本应保持不变的行为、或基于未经检验的假设做验证。作者想验证：在专家构建的智能体编程任务上做强化学习能否弥合这一差距，以及学到的东西能否迁移到训练分布之外。

Method: 对 1T 参数（32B 激活）的开源 MoE 模型 Kimi K2.7 Code 仅用 RL 后训练，任务共 1700 个：1000 个仓库任务由隐藏的 fail-to-pass 测试与检验既有行为的 pass-to-pass 测试评分，700 个终端任务由专家编写的隐藏验证器评分。奖励为目标检查通过的比例，任一 pass-to-pass 测试失败则奖励归零。训练为 GSPO，rank-32 LoRA 适配器，一个 epoch。

Result: 在三个智能体框架下，六个外部基准的 pass@1 均提升：SWE-Bench Pro 60.1→64.8，DeepSWE 31.0→43.4，Terminal-Bench 2.1 67.4→82.0，Terminal-Bench 3 1.4→12.1，Terminal-Bench 4 0.0→7.6，SWE-Marathon 5.0→25.0。五个独立任务集汇总提升显著（p < 0.001），在训练数据收集之后发布的三组上仍显著（p = 0.004）；在训练中从未使用的两个框架下也提升。DeepSWE 与 Terminal-Bench 3 的中位轨迹长度在智能体步数上缩短 24–35%。

Conclusion: 仅用 RL 的轻量后训练即可显著且可迁移地提升编程智能体的整体任务完成度。基座模型在 DeepSWE 上的失败多为"差之毫厘"，而在新解出的任务上，配对轨迹显示训练后的模型规避了上述四种失败模式。

Abstract: Coding agents often fail in the last mile: they build most of a feature but drop a requirement, test only the cases their implementation already handles, break behavior that was supposed to stay intact, or validate against an unchecked assumption. We ask whether reinforcement learning (RL) on expert-built agentic coding tasks closes this gap, and whether what the agent learns transfers beyond the training distribution. We post-train Kimi K2.7 Code, a 1T-parameter (32B active) open-weight mixture-of-experts model, with RL alone on 1,700 tasks: 1,000 repository tasks graded by hidden fail-to-pass tests and by pass-to-pass tests of existing behavior, and 700 terminal tasks graded by expert-written hidden verifiers. The reward is the fraction of target checks passed and drops to zero if any pass-to-pass test fails. One epoch of GSPO on a rank-32 LoRA adapter improves pass@1 on each of the six external benchmarks we evaluated, across three agent harnesses: SWE-Bench Pro (60.1 to 64.8), DeepSWE (31.0 to 43.4), Terminal-Bench 2.1 (67.4 to 82.0), Terminal-Bench 3 (1.4 to 12.1), Terminal-Bench 4 (0.0 to 7.6), and SWE-Marathon (5.0 to 25.0). Pooled over the five independent task sets (Terminal-Bench 4 revises Terminal-Bench 3), the improvement is significant (p < 0.001), and it remains significant on the three sets released after the training data was collected (p = 0.004); the model also improves under both harnesses never used in training. Median trajectories on DeepSWE and Terminal-Bench 3 are 24-35% shorter in agent steps. The base model's failed DeepSWE runs are mostly near-misses, and on the tasks the trained model newly solves, paired trajectories show it avoiding each of the four failure modes above.

</details>


### [353] [Clock Diffusion: Efficient Semi-Autoregressive Continuous Diffusion Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00894)
*Yair Schiff,Omer Belhasin,Roy Uziel,Matan Rusanovsky,Ran Zilberstein,Marianne Arriola,Gilad Turok,Guanghan Wang,Volodymyr Kuleshov,Michael Elad*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出Clock Diffusion框架，通过位置相关噪声调度定义半自回归连续扩散语言模型，解决了连续扩散模型缺乏变长生成和KV缓存支持的问题，并在多个基准上达到最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续扩散模型在离散数据上性能可与离散扩散模型相当，但缺乏作为语言模型的关键实用特性：变长生成能力和键值缓存（KV cache）支持，且整体质量仍落后于自回归和离散扩散的前沿水平。本文旨在弥补这些不足。

Method: 提出一种模型参数化方法，利用位置相关噪声调度定义半自回归（SAR）连续扩散语言模型（DLM），配合高效的训练与采样算法，构成Clock Diffusion框架。给出两种特例：块生成（block）和滑动窗口生成（sliding window），并据此定义ClockDLMs（基于滑动窗口的高斯DLM）。此外提出Cache Grab采样器，借鉴离散扩散加速推理技术，如对超过置信度阈值的token进行提交和自推测解码。

Result: ClockDLMs在OpenWebText上取得最先进的扩散似然界限，甚至超越表现优异的块SAR离散扩散模型；在TinyGSM上训练后，于GSM8K基准上显著优于连续基线，并匹敌或超越可比的SAR离散扩散模型。Cache Grab采样器进一步提升模型质量与效率。

Conclusion: 通过位置相关噪声调度的半自回归参数化，连续扩散语言模型可实现变长生成与KV缓存支持，并在似然界限和下游任务上达到或超越离散扩散与自回归模型的水平，同时借助高效采样器进一步提升实用性与效率。

Abstract: Recent works on continuous diffusion for discrete data have demonstrated performance on par with comparable discrete diffusion models. However, these continuous counterparts lack key features that are essential to practical use as language models, namely variable-length generation and support for a key-value cache, and they still lag behind the frontier of autoregressive and discrete diffusion quality. In this work, we address these limitations. We do so by introducing a model parameterization that uses position-dependent noise schedules to define semi-autoregressive (SAR) continuous diffusion language models (DLMs). Together with efficient training and sampling algorithms, we call this framework Clock Diffusion, and we present two special cases of our method: block and sliding window generation. We then define ClockDLMs, a family of Gaussian DLMs based on sliding window Clock Diffusion that attain state-of-the-art diffusion likelihood bounds on OpenWebText, even beating the performant block SAR discrete diffusion models. ClockDLMs trained on TinyGSM also substantially outperform continuous baselines on the GSM8K benchmark and match and exceed comparable SAR discrete diffusion models. Finally, building on our parameterization, we propose more efficient samplers that we dub Cache Grab, which adapt techniques from accelerated inference in discrete diffusion, such as committing tokens whose probabilities exceed a confidence threshold and self-speculative decoding, further improving our models' quality and efficiency.

</details>


### [354] [Towards Fast and Disentangled Counterfactuals for Visual Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00895)
*Sidney Bender,Benedikt Kunz,Ahmed Zeid,Shinichi Nakajima,Klaus-Robert Müller,Marco Morik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出DiDAE，将冻结的基础模型包裹在条件扩散解码器中，通过解耦字典方向的反事实编辑，无需梯度即可高效修复分类器偏差，速度比现有方法快至2000倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型仍易受伪相关和"Clever Hans"策略影响。可解释机器学习可在无元数据情况下为分类器发现并移除此类策略，但针对基础模型尚无可行的对应方案。

Method: DiDAE将冻结的基础模型包裹在条件扩散解码器中。反事实即沿解耦字典某一方向的闭式编辑后解码。字典可采用监督（Procrustes）或无监督（SVD、稀疏自编码器）方式构建，无需梯度计算。

Result: 在六个数据集（两个合成、四个真实）上评估；在其中三个的基准测试中，反事实表现与最先进方法持平或更优；通过反事实知识蒸馏（CFKD）修复下游分类器，优于基于元数据的校正；速度比现有方法快最多2000倍。

Conclusion: 该机制可对预训练字典与训练分类器进行排序，返回分类器实际依赖的少数方向，并经反事实因果验证及教师标注修复分类器。工作流已集成于开源Peal库，具备即插即用特性。

Abstract: Foundation models remain vulnerable to spurious correlations and ``Clever Hans'' strategies. Explainable machine learning can find and remove such strategies for classifiers without metadata. For foundation models, no such option exists yet. We propose Disentangled Diffusion Autoencoders (DiDAE). DiDAE wraps a frozen foundation model in a conditional diffusion decoder. A counterfactual is one closed-form edit along a direction of a disentangled dictionary, followed by decoding. The dictionary can be supervised (Procrustes) or unsupervised (Singular Value Decomposition, Sparse Autoencoders). No gradients are needed, so DiDAE is up to 2000 times faster than the state of the art. We evaluate on six datasets, two synthetic and four real-world. In a desiderata-driven benchmark on three of them, its counterfactuals are on par with or better than the state of the art, and they repair downstream classifiers through Counterfactual Knowledge Distillation (CFKD), where they beat metadata-based correction. The same machinery can rank a pretrained dictionary against a trained classifier. It returns the few directions the classifier actually reads, each causally verified by a counterfactual that flips the decision, and repairs the classifier along those a teacher marks spurious. The workflow is plug-and-play in our open-source Peal library we publish alongside the paper. With a public dictionary and a pretrained decoder, all that remains is a cheap linear distillation of the classifier and its own fine-tuning.

</details>


### [355] [When Do Biological Reasoning Models Use Their Biological Inputs?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00898)
*Ada Fang,Nikitha Thoduguli,Lukas Fesser,Hanlin Zhang,Sham M. Kakade,Marinka Zitnik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文检验了"生物推理模型的高准确率意味着LLM真正基于生物输入进行推理"这一假设，发现多数模型（如BioReason、BioReason-Pro）的性能提升主要来自文本而非生物基础模型表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生物推理模型通过后训练将LLM与生物基础模型表征及生物文本连接起来，学界普遍将其基准准确率视为LLM能够对生物输入进行推理的证据。作者希望验证这一假设是否成立。

Method: 在6个生物推理模型上跨DNA、蛋白质和单细胞任务进行测试。方法包括：扰动单一生物输入同时固定查询和其他输入；构造证据冲突（将一个基因组/蛋白/细胞的表征与另一个的文本配对）；对语言模型接收到的表征拟合线性探针；并结合生物输入分析推理轨迹。

Result: Evo2和ESM3对BioReason/BioReason-Pro的性能贡献很小；打乱DNA序列几乎不改变BioReason疾病预测准确率；在证据冲突中两模型分别有97.9%和99.7%的情况跟随文本。线性探针可从Evo2/ESM3表征预测任务目标，说明其编码了相关信息但贡献有限。相反，基础模型输入对ChatNT、Prot2Text-V2、CellWhisperer有贡献，差异表达基因对Cell2Sentence-Scale有贡献。在BioReason-Pro的SFT和RL检查点及42个BioReason检查点中，准确率提升并不代表生物输入贡献变大。BioReason轨迹错误陈述核苷酸变化，BioReason-Pro轨迹描述了在冲突下最终预测中被省略的功能。

Conclusion: 当前的后训练策略无法保证基础模型表征对任务性能产生实际贡献，基准准确率不应被直接作为LLM基于生物输入推理的证据。

Abstract: Biological reasoning models use post-training to connect LLMs to biological foundation model representations and biological text. Their benchmark accuracy is taken as evidence that LLMs reason over these inputs. We test this assumption in six biological reasoning models across DNA, protein, and single-cell tasks. We perturb one biological input while holding the query and other inputs fixed, construct evidence conflicts that pair the foundation model representation of one genome, protein, or cell with the text of another, fit linear probes to the representations the language model receives, and analyze reasoning traces against the biological inputs. Evo2 and ESM3 contribute little to BioReason and BioReason-Pro performance on the evaluated tasks. Shuffling the DNA sequence barely changes BioReason disease prediction accuracy, and in evidence conflicts the two models follow the text in 97.9% and 99.7% of cases. Linear probes trained on the Evo2 and ESM3 representations predict the task targets, so these foundation models encode information relevant to the task, but provide limited overall performance improvement to BioReason and BioReason-Pro. In contrast, foundation model inputs contribute to ChatNT, Prot2Text-V2, and CellWhisperer performance, and differentially expressed genes in the gene sentence contribute to Cell2Sentence-Scale performance. Across SFT and RL checkpoints of BioReason-Pro and 42 BioReason checkpoints, increases in accuracy do not imply greater performance contributions from biological inputs. BioReason traces misstate nucleotide changes, while BioReason-Pro traces describe functions omitted from final predictions under evidence conflicts. We find that current post-training strategies do not ensure that foundation model representations contribute to task performance.

</details>


### [356] [Sharpen Before You Adapt: Data-Free Entry-State Sharpening for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00903)
*Zhanming Zhang,Vinoth Selvendran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"入口状态锐化"（entry-state sharpening）：在TTRL之前用无数据训练把通用检查点调整到更有利于后续无标签自适应利用的状态，并用入口策略熵作为无标签控制信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TTRL依赖模型自身采样产生监督信号，因此检查点的"入口状态"至关重要：若策略分布分散，自监督噪声大，有限的自适应预算可能被消耗在集中概率质量上，而非可靠地表达模型已有能力。

Method: 在TTRL之前施加无数据（data-free）训练以准备检查点；该方法不绑定特定训练配方，不同无数据目标可将同一基座模型推到不同入口状态。基于Qwen3-4B得到五个无数据检查点，在统一的15步TTRL协议下评估，并加入域内无标签自蒸馏干预验证入口状态可被有意锐化。

Result: 入口策略熵与终点转换效率（可靠性-可达性度量）呈强秩相关（Spearman ρ=-0.90；控制入口可达性后ρ=-0.99）。R-Zero入口仍分散（3.39 nats），在MATH、GPQA、AMC的6/6配对比较中低于未调优基座；SPIRAL达0.07 nats，尽管其自博弈阶段未用数学数据，仍在MATH和GPQA上取得最高TTRL后准确率。

Conclusion: 应把检查点准备视为"状态控制问题"：用无数据训练提升TTRL就绪度，以入口熵作为无标签控制信号，以可达能力作为约束条件。

Abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) adapts language models on unlabeled test problems using supervision derived from their own samples. This makes the checkpoint's \emph{entry state} consequential: a diffuse policy provides noisier self-supervision and may spend much of a limited adaptation budget merely concentrating probability mass before reliably expressing capability it already possesses. We propose \textbf{entry-state sharpening}: use data-free training \emph{before} TTRL to prepare a general-purpose checkpoint in a state that subsequent label-free adaptation can exploit more efficiently. The idea is not tied to one training recipe; different data-free objectives can move the same base model to different entry states. Across five data-free checkpoints derived from Qwen3-4B and evaluated under an identical 15-step TTRL protocol, entry policy entropy strongly rank-orders endpoint conversion efficiency, a reliability-to-reachability measure (Spearman $ρ=-0.90$; $ρ=-0.99$ after controlling for entry reachability). The contrast across objectives is striking: R-Zero remains diffuse at $3.39$ nats and finishes below the untuned base in 6/6 matched comparisons across MATH, GPQA, and AMC, whereas SPIRAL reaches $0.07$ nats and achieves the highest post-TTRL accuracy on MATH and GPQA despite its self-play stage using no math training data. An in-domain label-free self-distillation intervention further shows that the entry state can be deliberately sharpened. These results motivate treating checkpoint preparation as a \emph{state-control problem}: use data-free training to improve TTRL readiness, with entry entropy as a label-free control signal and reachable capability as the constraint.

</details>


### [357] [Rate-Optimal Algorithm for Adversarial Linear CMDPs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00927)
*Kihyun Yu,Honghao Wei,Dabeen Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究了转移未知的回合制对抗性线性约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），提出新的原始-对偶算法，将遗憾和累积约束违反从 Õ(K^{3/4}) 改进到最优的 Õ(√K)，且无需 Slater 条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有最优算法仅达到 Õ(K^{3/4}) 的遗憾与累积约束违反，与理论最优的 Õ(√K) 存在差距。核心难点在于：学习线性 CMDP 需要对值函数类做一致集中，而约束在线学习中的策略混合等标准技术会增大该函数类的复杂度，使一致集中难以实现。

Method: 提出新的原始-对偶算法，结合自适应 Follow the Regularized Leader（FTRL）、收缩值估计（contracted value estimation）和指数 Lyapunov 函数。自适应对偶正则项抵消原始遗憾界中对对偶权重的依赖，从而避免策略混合。FTRL 更新中的归一化使策略参数界独立于对偶权重量级，保证策略类与一致集中兼容。

Result: 在无需 Slater 条件下，同时实现 Õ(√K) 的遗憾和累积约束违反，填补了与最优 K 依赖之间的差距。在特征访问模型下，计算复杂度与状态空间大小无关。

Conclusion: 该工作通过自适应 FTRL 与 Lyapunov 正则化设计，关闭了对抗性线性 CMDP 中 Õ(K^{3/4}) 与 Õ(√K) 之间的理论缺口，并揭示了归一化对保持策略类可集中性的关键作用。

Abstract: We study episodic adversarial linear constrained Markov decision processes (CMDPs) with unknown transitions, where both the loss and constraint functions may vary adversarially across episodes. The best previous algorithm achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(K^{3/4})$ regret and cumulative constraint violation, leaving a gap to the optimal $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ dependence on the number of episodes $K$. We close this gap by proposing a new primal dual algorithm that achieves $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{K})$ regret and cumulative constraint violation without assuming Slater's condition. The main challenge is that learning linear CMDPs requires uniform concentration over a value function class with a controlled covering number, whereas standard techniques in constrained online learning, such as policy mixing, can make this class more complex. Our algorithm combines adaptive Follow the Regularized Leader (FTRL), contracted value estimation, and an exponential Lyapunov function. An adaptive dual regularizer offsets the dependence on the dual weights in the primal regret bound, removing the need for policy mixing. We further show that the normalization in the FTRL update bounds the policy parameters independently of the magnitudes of the dual weights, which explains why the resulting policy class remains compatible with uniform concentration. Under feature access, the computational complexity is independent of the size of the state space.

</details>


### [358] [Platonic Task Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00929)
*Junghwan Park,Woojin Cho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出"柏拉图任务向量"假设，并设计"通用任务描述符"（UTD），实现跨异构模型的无需标签的任务知识迁移与组合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对同一任务的专用模型虽行为相似，但参数更新不共享坐标系统，导致权重空间的任务算术被限制在单一模型内、无法跨架构迁移的问题。

Method: 借助柏拉图洞穴寓言，假设模型特定更新是同一模型无关对象（柏拉图任务向量）的影子；为使其实用化，提出UTD——形状与架构和嵌入维度无关的矩阵，记录任务功能效应并支持矩阵加减。迁移时通过让目标模型在无标签探针图像和类名提示上复现该描述符来完成编辑，分两种实现：一是将描述符分解为图像嵌入上的平移场，最小二乘求解线性算子并折入目标末层权重，可线性组合；二是训练低秩适配器，可触及所有层并联合拟合组合。

Result: 异构模型仅部分共享该对象，模型特定残差的范数与共享分量相当，但跨模型迁移仍保留目标自身描述符增益的74-80%；在六个模型家族、八项分类任务及音频-文本设置上验证任务知识可跨异构模型迁移和组合。

Conclusion: 任务知识可在异构模型间迁移和组合，两种实现方式均有效，支持柏拉图任务向量作为跨架构共享的模型无关对象的假设。

Abstract: Models specialized for the same task converge to similar behavior, yet the parameter updates that produce it share no common coordinate system, so weight-space task arithmetic stays confined to a single model and cannot cross architectures without a structural correspondence. Drawing on Plato's allegory of the cave, we hypothesize that these model-specific updates are shadows of one shared, model-agnostic object, which we call the platonic task vector. To make it operational for models that pair an image or audio encoder with a text encoder, we introduce Universal Task Descriptors: matrices whose shape is independent of architecture and embedding dimension, which record a task's functional effect and support addition and negation as matrix operations. Transferring a descriptor into a target means editing the target until it reproduces the descriptor on the task's unlabeled probe images and class-name prompts, requiring no per-image labels. We realize this edit in two ways. First, the descriptor factorizes into a shift field on image embeddings, so a single least-squares solve yields a linear operator that folds into the target's last layer as a weight edit; by linearity, a bank of such operators admits any composition at any strength as a signed sum. Second, a low-rank adapter trained on the same objective reaches every layer and fits compositions jointly, at the cost of one optimization per edit. Heterogeneous models share this object only partially, with a model-specific residual comparable in norm to the shared component, yet cross-model transfer still retains 74-80 percent of the gain of the target's own descriptors. Experiments across six model families, eight classification tasks, and an audio-text setting show that task knowledge transfers and composes across heterogeneous models under both realizations.

</details>


### [359] [GUI-HARVEST: Self-Improving GUI Agents through Evidence-Driven Harness Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00948)
*Geyi Yang,Zikun Qu,Xiang Li,Zhiyong Wang,Min Zhang,Shipei Zeng,Zhongxiang Dai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GUI-HARVEST 是一种自动优化GUI智能体执行框架（harness）的方法，可在冻结主干模型的情况下实现自我改进，并通过对齐动作效果、处理执行变异性和归纳可复用失败模式来提升跨任务泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: GUI模型的执行框架（harness）决定了观察如何组装、动作如何执行以及验证、恢复和终止如何控制。与非GUI智能体的harness优化相比，自动优化GUI harness面临三个耦合挑战：调和模型意图与观察到的视觉效果、在多变执行结果下诊断失败、以及识别跨任务的重复失败模式并转化为可复用的运行时修改。因此需要一种能自我改进GUI智能体的自动harness优化器。

Method: 提出GUI-HARVEST自动harness优化器，支持冻结主干模型下的自我改进。方法包括三点：1）将模型输出与执行动作对齐前后截图，使诊断扎根于具体界面过渡；2）将同一任务的重复运行视为联合证据单元，通过任务内比较定位与结果相关的行为差异；3）将跨任务验证的发现整合为重复失败模式，映射为有界源代码编辑，并在评估前记录预测，通过重复执行检查预测行为效果与任务性能。

Result: 在OSWorld-Verified上，六种通用开源、GUI专用开源和专有主干模型均取得一致的留出集增益；Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct在全套测试中提升12.33分。冻结harness迁移使GPT-5在WindowsAgentArena上50步设置下无需进一步优化即提升13.87个百分点。在相同主干和初始harness下，GUI-HARVEST优于Self-Harness和Meta-Harness。

Conclusion: GUI-HARVEST通过GUI特定的诊断与验证机制，使harness改进能够泛化到未见任务，验证了其自动优化GUI执行框架的有效性。代码已开源。

Abstract: The executable harness surrounding a GUI model determines how observations are assembled, actions are executed, and verification, recovery, and termination are controlled. Compared with harness optimization for non-GUI agents, automatically optimizing this harness poses three coupled challenges: reconciling model intent with observed visual effects, diagnosing failures under variable execution outcomes, and identifying recurrent failure patterns across tasks and translating them into reusable runtime changes. We introduce GUI-HARVEST, an automatic harness optimizer that enables self-improving GUI agents with frozen backbone models. First, to ground diagnosis in observed action effects, it aligns model outputs and executed actions with before-and-after screenshots, tying findings to specific interface transitions. Second, to account for execution variability, it treats repeated runs of the same task as a joint evidence unit, using within-task comparisons to locate outcome-relevant behavioral differences. Third, it consolidates verified findings across tasks into recurring failure patterns, maps them to bounded source-code edits with predictions recorded before evaluation, and checks the predicted behavioral effects alongside task performance through repeated execution. Experiments on OSWorld-Verified show consistent held-out gains across six general-purpose open, GUI-specialized open, and proprietary backbone models; Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct gains 12.33 points on the full suite. Frozen-harness transfer improves GPT-5 by 13.87 percentage points on WindowsAgentArena at 50 steps without further optimization. With the same backbone and initial harness, GUI-HARVEST outperforms Self-Harness and Meta-Harness, suggesting that GUI-specific diagnosis and validation help harness improvements generalize to unseen tasks. The code is available at https://github.com/GaryYang12345/GUI-HARVEST.

</details>


### [360] [Structure-agnostic Causal Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00968)
*Arman Behnam,Binghui Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SaCRL 框架在无先验因果结构知识下，联合识别因果结构并学习对应的不变表示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果表示学习方法需预先指定因果结构，而不同结构要求根本互不兼容的不变性约束，错误指定会导致表示丢弃预测信息。

Method: 将结构选择建模为对候选不变性的软优化，采用基于 HSIC 的违背度量，并配合自适应权重自动聚焦于可实现的的结构。

Result: 在合成与半合成贝叶斯网络基准上恢复真实结构；在 Colored MNIST 上优于固定不变性基线；在 PACS、VLCS、OfficeHome 三个 DomainBed 基准上取得最优精度；在结构误设和环境多样性有限时性能平滑退化。

Conclusion: SaCRL 无需先验结构即可联合识别因果结构并学习不变表示，具备结构识别、不变性满足与分布外泛化的理论保证，且实证表现稳健。

Abstract: Causal representation learning aims to discover robust features by exploiting the causal structure underlying data generation. Existing methods require specifying the causal structure a priori, yet different structures demand fundamentally incompatible invariance constraints, and misspecification leads to representations that discard predictive information. We introduce SaCRL, a framework that jointly identifies the causal structure and learns the corresponding invariant representation without prior structural knowledge. Our approach formulates structure selection as a soft optimization over candidate invariances using HSIC-based violation metrics, with adaptive weights that automatically concentrate on the achievable structure. We provide theoretical guarantees for structure identification, including under random-feature approximation, invariance satisfaction, and out-of-distribution generalization. Empirically, SaCRL recovers the true structure on synthetic and semi-synthetic Bayesian-network benchmarks, outperforms fixed-invariance baselines on Colored MNIST, achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on three DomainBed benchmarks (PACS, VLCS, OfficeHome), and degrades gracefully under structural misspecification and limited environment diversity. Code is available at: https://github.com/ArmanBehnam/sacrl.

</details>


### [361] [Variational Streaming Flow: Probabilistic Forecasting in Physical Time](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00976)
*Hans Hao-Hsun Hsu,Minseon Gwak,Soon Hoe Lim,Pan Li,N. Benjamin Erichson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出变分流匹配（VSF），在保持流式流模型物理时间生成效率的同时实现概率预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 概率预测对复杂动力系统很重要，因为内在随机性和观测不完整会使同一观测状态演化出多种未来。流匹配灵活但计算昂贵，流式流（SF）虽高效却只能给出确定性单条轨迹。

Method: VSF在流式流基础上学习一个以目标动力为条件的隐变量分布，从而在物理时间中直接生成，实现概率预测并保留计算效率。

Result: 在确定性与随机动力系统上，VSF的预测精度与分布保真度均更优；在超过1000步的长时程推演和分岔动力学场景中展现优势。

Conclusion: VSF可作为即插即用预测器集成到基于JEPA的世界模型中，提升时间动态建模及导航、运动规划、操作任务的成功率。

Abstract: Probabilistic forecasting is important for predicting complex dynamical systems because intrinsic randomness and incomplete observations can cause the same observed state to evolve into multiple plausible futures. While flow matching is a flexible approach for probabilistic forecasting, it is computationally expensive. Streaming flow (SF) reformulates this approach to model temporal evolution efficiently by learning a continuous velocity field directly in physical time. However, SF learns a deterministic velocity field. Thus, it provides only a single future trajectory for a given fixed initial state and observation history. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Variational Streaming Flow (VSF). Our approach learns a latent distribution that is conditioned on the dynamics of interest. In turn, this enables probabilistic forecasting. Importantly, we retain the computational efficiency of SF by generating in physical time. Across deterministic and stochastic dynamical systems, VSF demonstrates superior predictive accuracy and distributional fidelity. We demonstrate the advantage for both long-horizon rollouts exceeding 1,000 steps, and settings with bifurcating dynamics. Moreover, VSF can be integrated into existing Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA)-based world models as a plug-and-play predictor to improve temporal dynamics and goal-directed success rate in navigation, motion planning, and manipulation.

</details>


### [362] [Generalist Representation, Specialist Detection: TS-Router for Time-Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00978)
*Tian Lan,Yifei Gao,Yimeng Lu,Xuming An,Meng Wang,Yue Pan,Wenjun He,Chenghao Liu,Chen Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TS-Router框架，用预训练时序基础模型表征来估计异构异常检测器的相对能力，并为每条目标序列选择合适专家，实现通用表征+专家检测的时序异常检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序异常检测难以跨数据集泛化，因为异构时间动态意味着不同的"正常"定义与不同的检测准则。时序基础模型虽提供可迁移表征，但配合固定的异常打分机制会忽略这种差异。因此需要换一种视角：用基础模型去协调多种专门的异常准则，而非直接施加统一准则。

Method: 提出TS-Router，一种"通用表征、专家检测"的框架。它从预训练时序表征中估计异构异常检测器的相对能力，并为每个目标序列选择合适的专家。为避免依赖真实任务中的专家性能标签，利用专家在带标签模拟任务上的相对表现来构造软能力监督。部署时路由不需要目标异常标签，只有被选中的专家在目标序列上以无监督方式拟合。理论上在表征覆盖与条件能力稳定性假设下给出了Top-k集合能力遗憾界。

Result: 在16个真实世界基准和四个互补评价指标上，TS-Router取得最佳整体平均排名。使用多个冻结TSFM编码器的受控消融实验进一步支持用预训练表征进行能力估计与自适应专家选择的有效性。

Conclusion: TS-Router表明，基础模型在时序异常检测中的价值不必是直接给出统一打分，而可以是协调多个专门检测准则；用预训练表征估计专家能力并自适应选择专家，可在无需目标标签的情况下跨数据集取得更优、更稳健的整体表现。

Abstract: Time-series anomaly detection (TSAD) is difficult to generalize across datasets because heterogeneous temporal dynamics imply different notions of normality and favor different detection criteria. While time-series foundation models provide transferable representations, coupling them with a fixed anomaly-scoring mechanism can overlook this variation. This motivates a different perspective on foundation-model-based TSAD: using foundation models to coordinate specialized anomaly criteria rather than directly imposing a universal one. Based on this view, we propose \textbf{TS-Router}, a generalist-representation, specialist-detection framework that estimates the relative competence of heterogeneous anomaly detectors from pretrained temporal representations and selects suitable specialists for each target series. To avoid relying on specialist-performance labels from real tasks, we derive soft competence supervision from specialists' relative performance on labeled simulated tasks. At deployment, routing requires no target anomaly labels, and only the selected specialists are fitted unsupervisedly on the target series. We bound Top-\(k\) set-competence regret under representation coverage and conditional competence stability. Across 16 real-world benchmarks and four complementary evaluation metrics, TS-Router achieves the best overall average rank. Controlled ablations with multiple frozen TSFM encoders further support the use of pretrained representations for competence estimation and adaptive specialist selection. The code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TS-Router-D8FF.

</details>


### [363] [HADRec: A Hierarchy-Aware Drug Recommendation Framework by Fusing Molecular Knowledge and Electronic Health Record](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00984)
*Junke Wang,Hongshun Ling,Li Zhang,Jinjing Wu,Tong Shao,Fang Wang,Yuan Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出HADRec框架，融合分子知识与EHR，并利用ATC层级结构约束，实现高性能、可解释的药物推荐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有药物推荐方法存在两大局限：一是将药物抽象为离散token，忽略其分子结构与药理机制；二是采用"扁平"推荐范式，未能利用国际标准ATC分类体系的层级逻辑。

Method: HADRec用LLaMA-7B编码临床笔记获得患者表征，用ChemBERTa编码药物SMILES字符串构建全球分子知识库；通过交叉注意力机制实现患者状态与药物特征的深度多模态融合；并引入层级预测器与一致性约束损失，强制遵循ATC逻辑依赖。

Result: 在MIMIC-III上，Jaccard、F1、PR-AUC均达到SOTA；在MIMIC-IV外部验证显示分布偏移下的强泛化能力，校准良好（ECE=0.04，Brier=0.06）；反事实评估显示推理与临床一致，能分离疾病特异性治疗与一般护理。

Conclusion: HADRec是高性能、可解释、临床落地的药物推荐路径，有助于安全可靠的AI驱动用药决策。

Abstract: Accurate medication recommendation is central to clinical decision-making, directly determining therapeutic efficacy and patient safety. However, existing methods suffer from two key limitations: drugs are often abstracted as discrete tokens, ignoring their molecular structures and pharmacological mechanisms, and the commonly used "flat" recommendation paradigm fails to leverage the hierarchical logic of the internationally standardized Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) classification system. To address these issues, we propose HADRec, a Hierarchy-Aware Drug Recommendation framework that integrates molecular knowledge with electronic health records (EHRs). HADRec employs LLaMA-7B to encode clinical notes for rich patient representations and ChemBERTa to encode drug Simplified Molecular Input Line Entry System strings, building a global molecular knowledge base. A cross-attention mechanism then performs deep multimodal fusion between patient states and drug features. The framework further incorporates a hierarchical predictor and a novel consistency constraint loss to enforce strict adherence to ATC logical dependencies. Extensive experiments on MIMIC-III demonstrate that HADRec achieves state-of-the-art performance across Jaccard, F1, and PR-AUC. External validation on MIMIC-IV confirms strong generalization under distribution shifts, and calibration analysis shows well-calibrated predictive confidence on MIMIC-IV with ECE = 0.04, and Brier = 0.06. Counterfactual evaluation reveals clinically aligned reasoning, disentangling disease-specific treatments from general care. Together, these results establish HADRec as a high-performance, interpretable, and clinically grounded pathway toward safe and reliable AI-driven medication recommendation.

</details>


### [364] [Neural scaling laws and evolution of learnable activation functions of Kolmogorov-Arnold networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00985)
*Tilen Cadez,Sanghoon Lee,Kyoung-Min Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了Kolmogorov-Arnold网络(KAN)的神经缩放定律及其可学习激活函数随数据量增加的结构演化，发现测试损失呈现"破损神经缩放律"(BNSL)行为，且数据集扩展会驱动激活函数从简单线性近似向稳定的可解释符号形式转变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KAN作为MLP的替代方案，因将激活函数作为可学习元素而具有更强的可解释性，适合科学领域应用。然而，其神经缩放定律以及数据量扩大时激活函数的结构演化尚未被充分研究，作者希望填补这一空白，为KAN的高效应用提供量化指导。

Method: 评估了三种KAN变体（BSRBF-KAN、Gottlieb-KAN、Faster-KAN）在标准图像分类基准（MNIST、Fashion-MNIST）以及一个专门的科学回归任务（从莫尔磁纹理的域图像估计磁参数）上的缩放行为。分析测试损失随数据集规模N_D的变化，并对激活函数复杂度随数据量增加的结构演化进行结构化分析。

Result: 测试损失随数据集规模N_D呈现破损神经缩放律(BNSL)行为：经过随机猜测区后，损失遵循依赖架构和任务的缩放行为。在图像分类任务中，损失从快速缩放分支（L∝N_D^(-α)）过渡到慢速缩放分支（L∝N_D^(-β)，α>β），指数α在0.4~1.5之间，β在0.06~0.6之间，且强烈依赖网络架构和数据规模区间。在磁参数回归任务中，损失遵循单一缩放律，指数范围为1.28~2.59。结构分析表明，数据集扩展驱动激活函数从简单的类线性近似向稳定、可解释的符号形式转变。

Conclusion: KAN的神经缩放行为具有架构与任务依赖性，其激活函数会随数据量增长而演化出更稳定、可解释的形式。这些发现为KAN的高效应用提供了量化路线图，有助于在模型表达能力和计算开销之间进行权衡。

Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) represent a compelling alternative to traditional Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP)-based neural networks. By employing activation functions as learnable elements, KANs offer superior interpretability, making them suited for scientific domains. In this work, we investigate the neural scaling laws of KANs and the structural evolution of their learnable activation functions under dataset expansion. Specifically, we evaluate the scaling behavior of three KAN variants---BSRBF-KAN, Gottlieb-KAN, and Faster-KAN---across standard image classification benchmarks (MNIST and Fashion-MNIST) and a specialized scientific regression task (magnetic parameter estimation from domain images of moiré magnetic textures). Our results demonstrate that the test loss ${\cal L}$ exhibits a broken neural scaling law (BNSL) behavior as a function of the dataset size $N_D$. After passing through a random-guess regime, the loss follows architecture- and task-dependent scaling behavior. The loss crosses from a faster- to a slower-scaling branch, ${\cal L}\propto N_D^{-α}$ and ${\cal L}\propto N_D^{-β}$ with $α>β$ for image classification tasks. The exponents $α$ and $β$ depend strongly on both the specific network architecture and the dataset-size regime, ranging from 0.4 to 1.5 and from 0.06 to 0.6, respectively. For the magnetic parameter-regression task, the loss follows a single scaling law with its exponent ranging from 1.28 to 2.59. Additionally, we provide a structural analysis of how activation functions refine their complexity as data volume increases, finding that dataset expansion drives a transition from simple linear-like approximations toward stable, interpretable symbolic forms. These findings provide a quantitative roadmap for the efficient application of KANs while managing the trade-off between model expressivity and computational overhead.

</details>


### [365] [Auditable Algebraic Counting Field for Cryptic-Pocket Detection from Apo Structures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00988)
*Shan Yu,Xuening Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出监督式代数计数场（ACF），从无配体（apo）结构预测隐蔽口袋残基，通过整数加权查找表实现可检查的预测路径，在外部数据上略优于P2Rank。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 隐蔽配体结合口袋在实验测定的apo结构中并不明显，难以从无配体受体几何中识别；同时，现有预测方法缺乏可直观检查的结构测量与学习证据。

Method: 构建监督式代数计数场（ACF），将显式几何、物理化学与拓扑特征编译为紧凑的整数加权查找表；预测分数可由特征值、训练计数、表权重与空间聚合重构，推理时无需序列搜索、结构模板迁移或蛋白质语言模型。在CryptoBench及两个锁定外部集合上评估，区分排序性能与残基判定预算的影响。

Result: 在57个post-CryptoBench apo-holo单元的外部集上，ACF在平均配对ROC-AUC上比P2Rank高+0.044（多重性校正95% CI [+0.010, +0.079]）。优势依数据集而定：官方折ROC-AUC及匹配预算F1与P2Rank的差异未确定，第二次外部评估未证实添加结构特征带来增益。

Conclusion: ACF提供了一个紧凑、具有外部验证信号的预测器，并给出从结构测量与训练计数到残基分数的可检查路径。

Abstract: Cryptic ligand-binding pockets are not apparent in experimentally determined apo structures, making them difficult to identify from unbound receptor geometry. A complementary challenge is to make the structural measurements and learned evidence behind each prediction directly inspectable. We introduce a supervised algebraic counting field (ACF) for predicting cryptic-pocket residues from apo structures. ACF compiles explicit geometric, physicochemical, and topological features into compact, integer-weighted lookup tables. Each prediction score can be reconstructed from feature values, training counts, table weights, and spatial aggregation, without sequence search, structural-template transfer, or a protein language model at inference. We evaluate ACF on CryptoBench and two locked external collections, separating ranking performance from the effects of residue-calling budgets. On an external set of 57 post-CryptoBench apo-holo units, ACF exceeded P2Rank by +0.044 in mean paired ROC-AUC (multiplicity-adjusted 95% CI [+0.010, +0.079]). The advantage was dataset-dependent: official-fold ROC-AUC and matched-budget F1 differences against P2Rank remained unresolved, and a second external evaluation did not confirm gains from added structural features. ACF thus provides a compact predictor with externally validated signal and an inspectable path from structural measurements and training counts to residue scores.

</details>


### [366] [Adapter Thickets: Splitting an RLVR Budget Beats Concentrating It](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00991)
*Jonathan Williams,Esin Tureci Karthik R. Narasimhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出"RLVR训练+多样本投票"的标准组合是有损的：RLVR使策略样本错误高度相关，损害投票效果；将同一预算分散训练多个LoRA适配器（adapter thicket）可改善投票表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流测试时扩展流程是先训练单一策略再采样投票，但投票只能纠正投票者不共享的错误，而RLVR会锐化策略使样本趋于犯相同错误，因此这种组合可能存在性能损失，作者希望揭示并解决该问题。

Method: 在1.5B-8B多个模型上，每个问题采样160个completion，比较全RLVR预算训练单个LoRA适配器与将同样数据/预算分散到K个LoRA适配器（各自随机不重叠数据分片，即adapter thicket）的多数投票效果；并设置早停单适配器作为对照。

Result: 全预算单适配器提升了单样本准确率，但在4个模型中的3个上使多数投票低于未训练基座模型，最多低4.8点；训练中投票准确率早期达峰后最多下降7.0点。Thicket在全部16个(模型,K)设置中胜过全训练适配器，K≥4时保持在基座0.8点以内或以上；投票数从16增至160时，thicket相对全训练适配器的优势由1.3点扩大到3.3点。

Conclusion: 当计划采样并投票时，RLVR预算应"广而浅"而非"深而窄"：将预算分散到多个独立LoRA适配器比集中训练单一适配器更有效，原因是避免了样本错误的相关性集中。

Abstract: Majority voting over sampled completions is the workhorse of test-time scaling, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is the workhorse for making each completion better. The standard pipeline composes the two: train one policy with RLVR, then sample it many times and vote. We show that this composition is lossy. A vote can only overturn mistakes that its voters do not share, and RLVR sharpens a policy so that its samples increasingly make the same mistakes. With every method drawing exactly $160$ completions per problem, training a single LoRA adapter on the full RLVR budget raises single-sample accuracy on every model we test ($1.5$B-$8$B). Yet on three of four models it leaves the majority vote below that of the untrained base model, by up to $4.8$ points. The damage builds during training: voter errors grow steadily more correlated, and the majority vote accuracy peaks early before falling by up to $7.0$ points. The cause is concentration, not RLVR itself. We split the same data and training budget across $K$ LoRA adapters, each trained on its own random disjoint shard, and call the result an adapter thicket. Thickets out-vote the fully trained adapter in all $16$ (model, $K$) settings, and for $K{\geq}4$ they stay within $0.8$ points of the base model or above it. A single adapter stopped early, at a thicket member's step count, is a strong control that matches thickets for small $K$. For $K{\geq}8$, thickets keep more of RLVR's single-sample gain and out-vote this control in six of eight settings. The cost of concentration also grows with the number of votes: from $16$ to $160$ votes, the thicket's lead over the fully trained adapter widens from $1.3$ to $3.3$ points. When the plan is to sample and vote, an RLVR budget is better spent broad than deep.

</details>


### [367] [Reliability-aware short-term roll prediction for unmanned surface vehicles via multi-task learning and adaptive centralization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00996)
*Kaizhen Li,Xi Zhou,Zihao Wang,Dan Zhang,Jianjian Liu,Xiaowei Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种可靠性感知的无人船横摇预测范式，通过多任务学习同时输出预测值与置信度，并在真实海况数据集上验证了有效性与泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有横摇预测研究主要关注提升预测精度，而对预测可靠性的量化关注不足。可靠预测对无人船航行安全与自主决策至关重要，因此需要将置信度评估融入预测流程。

Method: 采用多任务学习结构：共享特征提取骨干网络连接双头，回归头负责精确横摇预测，量化头负责置信度评分；并引入面向短期实时横摇预测的自适应中心化策略以提升不同工况下的泛化能力。

Result: 在真实海况数据集上的实验表明，该方法能有效量化预测结果的可靠性，并在不同条件下保持较优的泛化性能。

Conclusion: 该可靠性感知预测范式可为风险敏感的下游任务提供预测值及对应置信度，具有实际工程应用潜力。

Abstract: Reliable roll prediction of unmanned surface vehicles (USVs) is essential for ensuring navi?gational safety and enhancing autonomous decision-making. While existing studies primarily focus on improving prediction accuracy, the quantification of prediction reliability remains insufficiently addressed. To bridge this gap, this paper proposes a reliability-aware prediction paradigm that integrates confidence assessment into the predictive pipeline. The architecture utilizes a multi-task learning structure where a shared feature extraction backbone feeds into dual heads: a regression head for precise roll prediction and a quantification head for confidence scoring. This configuration provides accurate prediction and corresponding confidence for risk?sensitive downstream tasks. In addition, an adaptive centralization strategy tailored for short?term real-time roll prediction is introduced to improve model generalization under varying operational conditions. Experiments conducted on a real-sea dataset demonstrate that the proposed method effectively quantifies the reliability of prediction results and maintains superior generalization under varying conditions, offering significant potential for practical engineering applications.

</details>


### [368] [Optimal Transport Reweighting for Robust Learning under Spurious Correlations and Label Noise](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01028)
*Sung Ho Jo,Seonghwi Kim,Wonsang Yun,Minwoo Chae*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出POTER框架，基于最优传输从样本级传输几何推导样本重要性重加权，在子群偏移与标签噪声共存场景下提升最差组准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型在子群偏移下性能下降，虚假相关使模型依赖无法跨子群泛化的捷径特征。已有工作用基于损失的信号识别有效样本，但在标签噪声下这些信号严重失真：误标样本也会产生大损失，污染后续重加权或再训练。该交叉问题尚未被充分探索。
